# ==============================================================================
# 2. Heuristic Business Name & Domain Classification
# ==============================================================================

def extract_business_name(prompt: str) -> str:
    """Attempts to pull a business/project name from the prompt."""
    m = re.search(r'''["']([A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9 \-]{2,40})["']''', prompt)
    if m:
        return m.group(1).strip()

    m = re.search(
        r'''(?:for|called|named)\s+["']?([A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9&]*(?:\s+[A-Za-z0-9&][a-zA-Z0-9&]*)*)["']?(?:\s*$|\s*,|\s*\.)''',
        prompt
    )
    if m:
        name = m.group(1).strip()
        words = name.split()
        for i, w in enumerate(words):
            if w.lower() in {"featuring", "showcasing", "with", "including"}:
                words = words[:i]
                break
        _TRAIL_STOP = {"showcase", "website", "landing", "page", "app", "platform", "tool", "site"}
        while words and words[-1].lower() in _TRAIL_STOP:
            words = words[:-1]
        if words:
            return " ".join(words)

    STOP = {
        "Write", "Create", "Build", "Make", "Design", "Generate", "Develop",
        "A", "An", "The", "My", "Our", "New", "React", "TypeScript", "Website",
        "Page", "Site", "Landing", "Full", "Complete", "Modern", "Beautiful",
        "Restaurant", "Portfolio", "SaaS", "Blog", "Event", "Shop", "Store",
    }
    words = re.findall(r'[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]+', prompt)
    candidates = [w for w in words if w not in STOP]
    if len(candidates) >= 2:
        return " ".join(candidates[:3])
    if candidates:
        return candidates[0]

    return "My Business"


def detect_business_type(prompt: str) -> str:
    """
    Detects the business type from prompt using weighted confidence scoring.
    Covers all 15+ domains in the unified registry with deterministic priority.
    """
    prompt_lower = prompt.lower()
    scores: dict[str, int] = {k: 0 for k in _BUSINESS_TYPE_WEIGHTS}

    for btype, kw_weights in _BUSINESS_TYPE_WEIGHTS.items():
        for kw, weight in kw_weights.items():
            if re.search(r'\b' + re.escape(kw) + r'\b', prompt_lower):
                scores[btype] += weight

    best_type = max(scores, key=scores.get)
    if scores[best_type] > 0:
        return best_type

    # Fallback to broad keyword scan
    if any(k in prompt_lower for k in ["food", "restaurant", "menu", "cafe", "bistro", "ramen"]):
        return "restaurant"
    if any(k in prompt_lower for k in ["portfolio", "freelance", "resume", "designer"]):
        return "portfolio"
    if any(k in prompt_lower for k in ["payment", "fintech", "banking", "treasury"]):
        return "fintech"
    if any(k in prompt_lower for k in ["dental", "dentistry", "clinic", "doctor", "healthcare"]):
        return "healthcare"
    if any(k in prompt_lower for k in ["villa", "estate", "property", "realty"]):
        return "realestate"
    if any(k in prompt_lower for k in ["charity", "nonprofit", "conservation", "wildlife"]):
        return "nonprofit"
    if any(k in prompt_lower for k in ["bootcamp", "academy", "curriculum", "syllabus", "course"]):
        return "education"
    if any(k in prompt_lower for k in ["architect", "blueprint", "atelier"]):
        return "architecture"
    if any(k in prompt_lower for k in ["coffee", "roast", "beans"]):
        return "coffee"
    if any(k in prompt_lower for k in ["store", "shop", "ecommerce", "cart"]):
        return "ecommerce"
    if any(k in prompt_lower for k in ["gym", "workout", "crossfit", "fitness"]):
        return "fitness"

    return "saas"


def extract_explicit_sections(prompt: str) -> Optional[List[Tuple[str, str]]]:
    """Detect a user-authored numbered/bulleted section list in the prompt.
    Returns [(slug, description), ...] in order, or None if no explicit
    list structure is present (≥2 matches required to count as a list)."""
    if not prompt or not isinstance(prompt, str):
        return None

    # Exclude common non-section bullet headers (e.g. "Design requirements:", "Color palette:")
    NON_SECTION_PREFIXES = {
        "design", "requirement", "requirements", "color", "palette", "typography",
        "font", "button", "card", "styling", "rules", "guidelines", "constraint", "constraints",
        "tech", "stack", "note", "notes", "overview", "theme"
    }

    matches: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []

    # Strategy 1: Check for an explicit "Sections:" or "Pages:" or "Structure:" block
    sec_block_m = re.search(
        r'(?:^|\n)\s*(?:[-*•\u2022]|\d+[\.\)])?\s*(?:Sections?|Pages?|Structure|Components?)\s*:\s*\n([\s\S]+?)(?=\n\s*(?:[A-Z][a-zA-Z\s_-]+:|\Z))',
        prompt,
        re.IGNORECASE
    )
    if sec_block_m:
        block_text = sec_block_m.group(1)
        item_pattern = re.compile(
            r'(?:^|\n)\s*(?:(?:\d+[\.\)\:]|\(\d+\))|[-*•\u2022])\s*([A-Za-z0-9][\w\s/&-]+?)(?:\s*[-:\u2013\u2014]\s*([^\n]+(?:\n(?!\s*(?:(?:\d+[\.\)\:]|\(\d+\))|[-*•\u2022]))[^\n]+)*)|\s*$(?:\n|$))',
            re.MULTILINE
        )
        for m in item_pattern.finditer(block_text):
            raw_name = m.group(1).strip()
            raw_desc = (m.group(2) or "").strip()
            first_word = raw_name.lower().split()[0] if raw_name else ""
            if first_word not in NON_SECTION_PREFIXES and len(raw_name) <= 50:
                matches.append((raw_name, raw_desc or f"Write the {raw_name} section."))

    # Strategy 2: Explicit numbered markers e.g. "1. Header", "1) Header", "(1) Header"
    if len(matches) < 2:
        marker_iter = list(re.finditer(r'(?:^|\n|\s)(?:(?:\d+[\.\)]|\(\d+\)))\s*', prompt))
        if len(marker_iter) >= 2:
            num_matches: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
            for i, m in enumerate(marker_iter):
                start_pos = m.end()
                end_pos = marker_iter[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(marker_iter) else len(prompt)
                item_text = prompt[start_pos:end_pos].strip()
                if "\n\n" in item_text:
                    item_text = item_text.split("\n\n")[0].strip()

                split_m = re.split(r'[:\-–—]\s*', item_text, maxsplit=1)
                if len(split_m) == 2 and split_m[0].strip():
                    label = split_m[0].strip()
                    desc = split_m[1].strip()
                else:
                    label = item_text.strip()
                    desc = f"Write the {label} section."

                first_word = label.lower().split()[0] if label else ""
                if first_word not in NON_SECTION_PREFIXES and 2 <= len(label) <= 50:
                    num_matches.append((label, desc))
            if len(num_matches) >= 2:
                matches = num_matches

    # Strategy 3: Multiline bulleted items e.g. "- Header: ...", "* Header: ...", "• Header: ..."
    if len(matches) < 2:
        bullet_pattern = re.compile(
            r'^\s*[-*•\u2022]\s*([A-Za-z0-9][\w\s/&-]+?)(?:\s*[:\-–—]\s*(.+))?$',
            re.MULTILINE
        )
        bullet_matches: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
        for m in bullet_pattern.finditer(prompt):
            label = m.group(1).strip()
            desc = (m.group(2) or "").strip() or f"Write the {label} section."
            first_word = label.lower().split()[0] if label else ""
            if first_word not in NON_SECTION_PREFIXES and 2 <= len(label) <= 50:
                bullet_matches.append((label, desc))
        if len(bullet_matches) >= 2:
            matches = bullet_matches

    # Strategy 4: Explicit list following "with" or "sections:"
    # e.g. "with Header, Hero, Spatial Products, and Footer."
    if len(matches) < 2:
        with_m = re.search(r'(?:with|sections?\s*:)\s+([A-Z][\w\s/&-]+(?:,\s*(?:and\s+)?[A-Z][\w\s/&-]+)+)', prompt)
        if with_m:
            candidate_list = with_m.group(1)
            items = re.split(r',\s*(?:and\s+)?|\s+and\s+', candidate_list)
            with_cands: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
            for item in items:
                lbl = item.strip().rstrip('.')
                if lbl and len(lbl) <= 50 and lbl.lower() not in NON_SECTION_PREFIXES:
                    with_cands.append((lbl, f"Write the {lbl} section."))
            if len(with_cands) >= 2:
                matches = with_cands

    if len(matches) < 2:
        return None

    def _slugify(text: str) -> str:
        cleaned = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s_-]+', '', text.lower()).strip()
        return re.sub(r'[\s_]+', '-', cleaned).strip('-')

    results: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    seen = set()
    for raw_label, desc in matches:
        slug = _slugify(raw_label)
        if not slug or slug in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(slug)
        results.append((slug, desc))

    # If footer is present, ensure it is at the end
    footer_tuples = [t for t in results if t[0] == "footer"]
    if footer_tuples:
        results = [t for t in results if t[0] != "footer"] + footer_tuples

    return results if len(results) >= 2 else None


def extract_explicit_sections_and_instructions(prompt: str) -> tuple[Optional[list[str]], dict[str, str]]:
    """Legacy compatibility helper returning (slugs_list, instructions_dict)."""
    res = extract_explicit_sections(prompt)
    if not res:
        return None, {}
    slugs = [slug for slug, _ in res]
    instructions = {}
    for slug, desc in res:
        words = [w for w in re.split(r'[-_]', slug) if w]
        pascal_name = "".join(w.capitalize() for w in words)
        raw_name = " ".join(w.capitalize() for w in words)
        full_desc = desc if desc else f"High-quality, responsive {raw_name} section."
        instructions[slug] = (
            f"Write the {raw_name} section: {full_desc} "
            f"Files: src/components/{pascal_name}.tsx + src/components/{pascal_name}.css"
        )
    return slugs, instructions


def extract_explicit_section_instructions(prompt: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Extracts custom section instruction overrides parsed from explicit prompt declarations."""
    _, instrs = extract_explicit_sections_and_instructions(prompt)
    return instrs


def extract_sections_from_prompt(prompt: str, business_type: str) -> list[str]:
    """
    Dynamically infers the required sections from the user prompt and business domain.
    Explicit user-authored section structure always overrides domain-template heuristics.
    """
    explicit = extract_explicit_sections(prompt)
    if explicit:
        return [slug for slug, _ in explicit]

    lower = prompt.lower()

    wants_pricing = any(k in lower for k in ["pricing", "price", "calculator", "tier", "subscription", "billing", "plans"])
    wants_testimonials = any(k in lower for k in ["testimonial", "testimonials", "review", "reviews", "carousel", "quote"])
    wants_features = any(k in lower for k in ["feature", "features", "showcase", "services", "capability", "solutions"])
    wants_contact = any(k in lower for k in ["contact", "contact us", "reach", "hire", "inquiry"])
    wants_cta = any(k in lower for k in ["cta", "signup", "get started", "newsletter", "donate"])

    middle: list[str] = []

    if business_type == "saas":
        middle.append("features")
        if wants_pricing or not any(k in lower for k in ["free only", "no pricing"]):
            middle.append("pricing")
        if wants_testimonials or "carousel" in lower:
            middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("cta" if wants_cta else "contact")

    elif business_type == "restaurant":
        middle.append("menu")
        middle.append("about")
        if wants_testimonials: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("contact")

    elif business_type == "portfolio":
        middle.append("projects")
        middle.append("skills")
        if wants_testimonials: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("contact")

    elif business_type == "ecommerce":
        middle.append("features")
        if wants_pricing: middle.append("pricing")
        if wants_testimonials: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("cta")

    elif business_type == "fintech":
        middle.append("features")
        middle.append("pricing")
        if wants_testimonials or "review" in lower: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("cta")

    elif business_type == "healthcare":
        middle.append("features")
        if wants_testimonials or "review" in lower: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("contact")

    elif business_type == "realestate":
        middle.append("features")
        if wants_pricing: middle.append("pricing")
        if wants_testimonials: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("contact")

    elif business_type == "education":
        middle.append("features")
        middle.append("pricing")
        if wants_testimonials: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("cta")

    elif business_type == "nonprofit":
        middle.append("features")
        if wants_testimonials: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("cta")  # Donate CTA rather than commercial pricing

    elif business_type == "agency":
        middle.append("features")
        if wants_testimonials: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("contact")

    elif business_type == "architecture":
        middle.append("features")
        if wants_testimonials: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("contact")

    elif business_type == "coffee":
        middle.append("features")
        if wants_pricing: middle.append("pricing")
        if wants_testimonials: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("contact")

    elif business_type == "fitness":
        middle.append("features")
        middle.append("pricing")
        if wants_testimonials: middle.append("testimonials")
        middle.append("contact")

    elif business_type == "blog":
        middle.append("features")
        middle.append("cta")  # Newsletter CTA

    else:
        middle = ["features", "testimonials", "contact"]

    seen = {"header", "hero"}
    assembled = ["header", "hero"]
    for sec in middle:
        if sec not in seen:
            seen.add(sec)
            assembled.append(sec)
    assembled.append("footer")
    return assembled


# ==============================================================================
# 3. Heuristic Brief Builder
# ==============================================================================

def _build_heuristic_brief(prompt: str, style_spec: Optional[StyleSpec] = None) -> dict:
    """Builds a rich, domain-tailored structured content brief using the unified domain registry and optional StyleSpec."""
    explicit_sections = extract_explicit_sections(prompt)
    if explicit_sections:
        dynamic_sections = [slug for slug, _ in explicit_sections]
        explicit_instructions = {}
        for slug, desc in explicit_sections:
            words = [w for w in re.split(r'[-_]', slug) if w]
            pascal_name = "".join(w.capitalize() for w in words)
            raw_name = " ".join(w.capitalize() for w in words)
            full_desc = desc if desc else f"High-quality, responsive {raw_name} section."
            if "Files:" not in full_desc:
                full_desc = f"{full_desc} Files: src/components/{pascal_name}.tsx + src/components/{pascal_name}.css"
            explicit_instructions[slug] = full_desc
            explicit_instructions[slug.replace("-", "_")] = full_desc
            explicit_instructions[slug.replace("_", "-")] = full_desc
        business_type = detect_business_type(prompt)
    else:
        business_type = detect_business_type(prompt)
        dynamic_sections = extract_sections_from_prompt(prompt, business_type)
        explicit_instructions = {}

    business_name = extract_business_name(prompt)
    template = dict(_DOMAIN_TEMPLATES.get(business_type, _SAAS_TEMPLATE))
    theme = get_domain_theme(business_type, business_name)

    lower_prompt = prompt.lower()
    if style_spec:
        primary_color = style_spec.get_primary_color()
    elif any(k in lower_prompt for k in ["dark", "black", "night", "obsidian"]):
        primary_color = theme.get("primary_color_dark", theme["primary_color"])
    elif any(k in lower_prompt for k in ["light", "paper", "white", "bright", "clean", "minimal"]):
        primary_color = theme.get("primary_color_light", theme["primary_color"])
    else:
        primary_color = theme["primary_color"]

    accent_color = style_spec.get_accent_color() if style_spec else theme["accent_color"]
    font_heading = style_spec.get_heading_font() if style_spec else theme["font_heading"]
    font_body = style_spec.get_body_font() if style_spec else theme["font_body"]

    res = {
        **template,
        "business_name": business_name,
        "business_type": business_type,
        "sections": dynamic_sections,
        "custom_section_instructions": explicit_instructions,
        "tagline": f"{business_name} - {theme['default_tagline']}",
        "primary_color": primary_color,
        "primary_color_light": theme.get("primary_color_light", "#ffffff"),
        "primary_color_dark": theme.get("primary_color_dark", "#0b0f19"),
        "accent_color": accent_color,
        "accent_secondary": theme.get("accent_secondary", "#6366f1"),
        "font_heading": font_heading,
        "font_body": font_body,
        "border_radius": theme.get("border_radius", "6px"),
        "source": "heuristic",
    }
    if style_spec:
        res["style_spec"] = style_spec
    return res


# ==============================================================================
# 4. LLM-Powered Brief Builder & Public API
# ==============================================================================

_BRIEF_SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You are a web content strategist. Given a one-line website request, produce a structured JSON content brief. "
    "Respond with ONLY valid JSON - no markdown fences, no explanation. "
    "Required keys: business_name, tagline, business_type, primary_color, accent_color, "
    "font_heading, font_body, sections (list), contact (dict). "
    "For restaurants add menu_categories. For SaaS/portfolio add features."
)


def _call_gemini_brief(prompt: str, api_key: str, model: str = "gemini-2.0-flash") -> Optional[dict]:
    import urllib.request
    url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent"
    payload = {
        "system_instruction": {"parts": [{"text": _BRIEF_SYSTEM_PROMPT}]},
        "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": f"Website request: {prompt}"}]}],
        "generationConfig": {"temperature": 0.3, "maxOutputTokens": 1024},
    }
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=data,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "x-goog-api-key": api_key}
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
        body = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    text = body["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
    text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s*```$", "", text)
    return json.loads(text)


def _call_openai_brief(prompt: str, api_key: str, base_url: str = "https://api.openai.com/v1",
                       model: str = "gpt-4o-mini") -> Optional[dict]:
    import urllib.request
    url = f"{base_url.rstrip('/')}/chat/completions"
    payload = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": _BRIEF_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
            {"role": "user", "content": f"Website request: {prompt}"},
        ],
        "temperature": 0.3,
        "max_tokens": 1024,
    }
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url, data=data,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
        body = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    return json.loads(body["choices"][0]["message"]["content"])


def generate_content_brief(
    prompt: str,
    provider: str = "auto",
    style_tokens: Optional[str] = None,
    style_preset: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict:
    """
    Expands a one-line user prompt into a structured content brief for the site pipeline.
    Decouples visual aesthetics by checking for custom style_tokens, style_preset, or prompt :root tokens.
    """
    # 1. Resolve StyleSpec
    resolved_style: Optional[StyleSpec] = None
    if style_tokens and "--" in style_tokens:
        resolved_style = parse_css_tokens(style_tokens, name="Custom Ingested Tokens", source="refero" if "refero" in style_tokens.lower() else "custom")
    elif style_preset and style_preset in PRESET_STYLES:
        resolved_style = PRESET_STYLES[style_preset]
    elif ":root" in prompt and "--" in prompt:
        resolved_style = parse_css_tokens(prompt, name="Prompt Embedded Tokens", source="prompt")
    else:
        # Detect archetype keywords in prompt
        low_prompt = prompt.lower()
        if "refero" in low_prompt or "monopo" in low_prompt or "editorial" in low_prompt:
            resolved_style = PRESET_STYLES["refero_editorial"]
        elif "brutalist" in low_prompt or "brutalism" in low_prompt:
            resolved_style = PRESET_STYLES["neo_brutalist"]
        elif "glassmorphic" in low_prompt or "glassmorphism" in low_prompt:
            resolved_style = PRESET_STYLES["glassmorphic_aurora"]
        elif "luxury" in low_prompt or "champagne" in low_prompt:
            resolved_style = PRESET_STYLES["luxury_minimalist"]
        elif "cyberpunk" in low_prompt:
            resolved_style = PRESET_STYLES["cyberpunk_neon"]

    # 2. Brief synthesis
    explicit_sections = extract_explicit_sections(prompt)

    if provider in ("auto", "gemini"):
        api_key = os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY", "")
        if api_key:
            try:
                brief = _call_gemini_brief(prompt, api_key)
                if brief and "business_name" in brief:
                    brief["source"] = "gemini"
                    if explicit_sections:
                        brief["sections"] = [slug for slug, _ in explicit_sections]
                        brief["custom_section_instructions"] = {
                            slug: desc for slug, desc in explicit_sections if desc
                        }
                    if resolved_style:
                        brief["style_spec"] = resolved_style
                        brief["primary_color"] = resolved_style.get_primary_color()
                        brief["accent_color"] = resolved_style.get_accent_color()
                        brief["font_heading"] = resolved_style.get_heading_font()
                        brief["font_body"] = resolved_style.get_body_font()
                    return brief
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[site_brief] Gemini API call failed, falling back: {e}")

    if provider in ("auto", "openai"):
        api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
        if api_key:
            try:
                base_url = os.environ.get("OPENAI_BASE_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1")
                brief = _call_openai_brief(prompt, api_key, base_url)
                if brief and "business_name" in brief:
                    brief["source"] = "openai"
                    if explicit_sections:
                        brief["sections"] = [slug for slug, _ in explicit_sections]
                        brief["custom_section_instructions"] = {
                            slug: desc for slug, desc in explicit_sections if desc
                        }
                    if resolved_style:
                        brief["style_spec"] = resolved_style
                        brief["primary_color"] = resolved_style.get_primary_color()
                        brief["accent_color"] = resolved_style.get_accent_color()
                        brief["font_heading"] = resolved_style.get_heading_font()
                        brief["font_body"] = resolved_style.get_body_font()
                    return brief
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[site_brief] OpenAI API call failed, falling back: {e}")

    return _build_heuristic_brief(prompt, style_spec=resolved_style)


# ==============================================================================
# 5. XML Serialization for Agent Prompting
# ==============================================================================

def brief_to_xml(brief: dict) -> str:
    """Formats a structured brief into XML tags consumed by the site agent."""
    lines = ["<content_brief>"]
    lines.append(f"  <business_name>{brief.get('business_name', 'My Business')}</business_name>")
    lines.append(f"  <business_type>{brief.get('business_type', 'general')}</business_type>")
    lines.append(f"  <tagline>{brief.get('tagline', '')}</tagline>")

    spec: Optional[StyleSpec] = brief.get("style_spec")
    if spec:
        lines.append(f'  <design_system style_name="{spec.name}" source="{spec.source}">')
        lines.append(f"    <primary_color>{spec.get_primary_color()}</primary_color>")
        lines.append(f"    <accent_color>{spec.get_accent_color()}</accent_color>")
        lines.append(f"    <font_heading>{spec.get_heading_font()}</font_heading>")
        lines.append(f"    <font_body>{spec.get_body_font()}</font_body>")
        lines.append("    <css_variables>")
        lines.append(spec.raw_css if spec.raw_css else spec_to_css_root(spec))
        lines.append("    </css_variables>")
        if spec.dos or spec.donts:
            lines.append("    <design_rules>")
            for d in spec.dos:
                lines.append(f'      <rule type="do">{d}</rule>')
            for d in spec.donts:
                lines.append(f'      <rule type="dont">{d}</rule>')
            lines.append("    </design_rules>")
        lines.append("  </design_system>")
    else:
        lines.append("  <design_system>")
        lines.append(f"    <primary_color>{brief.get('primary_color', '#0f172a')}</primary_color>")
        lines.append(f"    <accent_color>{brief.get('accent_color', '#38bdf8')}</accent_color>")
        if brief.get("accent_secondary"):
            lines.append(f"    <accent_secondary>{brief['accent_secondary']}</accent_secondary>")
        lines.append(f"    <font_heading>{brief.get('font_heading', 'Inter')}</font_heading>")
        lines.append(f"    <font_body>{brief.get('font_body', 'Inter')}</font_body>")
        lines.append("  </design_system>")

    lines.append("  <sections>")
    for sec in brief.get("sections", ["header", "hero", "features", "footer"]):
        lines.append(f"    <section>{sec}</section>")
    lines.append("  </sections>")

    if "features" in brief and brief["features"]:
        lines.append("  <features>")
        for feat in brief["features"]:
            icon = feat.get('icon', 'bolt')
            title = feat.get('title', '')
            desc = feat.get('description', '')
            lines.append(f'    <feature icon="{icon}" title="{title}">{desc}</feature>')
        lines.append("  </features>")

    if "pricing_tiers" in brief and brief["pricing_tiers"]:
        lines.append("  <pricing_tiers>")
        for tier in brief["pricing_tiers"]:
            rec = ' recommended="true"' if tier.get('recommended') else ''
            t_name = tier.get('name', '')
            t_price = tier.get('price', '')
            t_period = tier.get('period', 'month')
            lines.append(f'    <tier name="{t_name}" price="{t_price}" period="{t_period}"{rec}>')
            for f in tier.get("features", []):
                lines.append(f"      <item>{f}</item>")
            lines.append("    </tier>")
        lines.append("  </pricing_tiers>")

    if "testimonials" in brief and brief["testimonials"]:
        lines.append("  <testimonials>")
        for t in brief["testimonials"]:
            author = t.get('author', 'Verified Client')
            role = t.get('role', '')
            quote = t.get('quote', '')
            rating = t.get('rating', 5)
            lines.append(f'    <testimonial author="{author}" role="{role}" rating="{rating}">')
            lines.append(f"      <quote>{quote}</quote>")
            lines.append("    </testimonial>")
        lines.append("  </testimonials>")

    if "menu_categories" in brief and brief["menu_categories"]:
        lines.append("  <menu>")
        for cat in brief["menu_categories"]:
            cat_name = cat.get('name', '')
            lines.append(f'    <category name="{cat_name}">')
            for item in cat.get("items", []):
                price = item.get('price', '')
                name = item.get('name', '')
                desc = item.get('description', '')
                lines.append(f'      <item name="{name}" price="{price}">{desc}</item>')
            lines.append("    </category>")
        lines.append("  </menu>")

    if "projects" in brief and brief["projects"]:
        lines.append("  <projects>")
        for proj in brief["projects"]:
            name = proj.get('name', '')
            desc = proj.get('description', '')
            tech = ", ".join(proj.get('tech', []))
            lines.append(f'    <project name="{name}" tech="{tech}">{desc}</project>')
        lines.append("  </projects>")

    if "skills" in brief and brief["skills"]:
        lines.append(f"  <skills>{', '.join(brief['skills'])}</skills>")

    if "contact" in brief and brief["contact"]:
        lines.append("  <contact>")
        for k, v in brief["contact"].items():
            lines.append(f"    <{k}>{v}</{k}>")
        lines.append("  </contact>")

    lines.append("</content_brief>")
    return "\n".join(lines)

"""
visual_judge.py - Playwright Visual Judge for the Site Pipeline

Takes a built site directory, starts a Vite dev server, takes a screenshot,
and scores it using heuristic checks (and optionally an LLM vision judge).

This is a soft-dependency module: if Playwright is not installed, all functions
degrade gracefully and return a neutral score without raising.

Install:
    pip install playwright
    playwright install chromium
"""

import os
import re
import json
import time
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

# ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

VISUAL_JUDGE_PORT = 5174   # separate from main dev server (5173) to avoid conflicts
_PLAYWRIGHT_AVAILABLE = None  # lazily set

def _check_playwright() -> bool:
    global _PLAYWRIGHT_AVAILABLE
    if _PLAYWRIGHT_AVAILABLE is None:
        try:
            import playwright  # noqa: F401
            _PLAYWRIGHT_AVAILABLE = True
        except ImportError:
            _PLAYWRIGHT_AVAILABLE = False
    return _PLAYWRIGHT_AVAILABLE


# ── Heuristic image scoring (no LLM required) ─────────────────────────────────

def _score_screenshot_heuristic(screenshot_path: Path) -> dict:
    """
    Scores a screenshot using pixel-level heuristics.
    Returns a dict with score (0-5), issues list, and pass bool.

    Checks:
    1. Not a blank white/single-color page (most common failure)
    2. Content height implies multiple sections (not just a title)
    3. Multiple distinct colors visible (nav + content + footer pattern)
    4. Text-heavy regions in expected positions
    """
    try:
        # Try to use PIL/Pillow if available
        from PIL import Image
        import colorsys

        img = Image.open(screenshot_path).convert("RGB")
        width, height = img.size

        issues = []
        score = 5

        # --- Check 1: Blank page detection ---
        # Sample a grid of pixels and check color variance
        pixels = []
        step = max(1, width // 20)
        for x in range(0, width, step):
            for y in range(0, height, step):
                pixels.append(img.getpixel((x, y)))

        if pixels:
            r_vals = [p[0] for p in pixels]
            g_vals = [p[1] for p in pixels]
            b_vals = [p[2] for p in pixels]

            # Check if >85% of pixels are nearly white (blank page)
            white_count = sum(1 for p in pixels if p[0] > 240 and p[1] > 240 and p[2] > 240)
            white_ratio = white_count / len(pixels)
            if white_ratio > 0.85:
                issues.append(f"Page appears blank ({white_ratio:.0%} near-white pixels)")
                score -= 3

            # Check color variance (distinct regions = layout present)
            r_range = max(r_vals) - min(r_vals)
            g_range = max(g_vals) - min(g_vals)
            b_range = max(b_vals) - min(b_vals)
            color_range = max(r_range, g_range, b_range)

            if color_range < 30:
                issues.append("Very low color variance - likely single-background page")
                score -= 2
            elif color_range < 80:
                issues.append("Low color diversity - may lack header/footer contrast")
                score -= 1

        # --- Check 2: Rendered height ---
        # A multi-section page should have content extending beyond the viewport
        # We can't check scroll height from a screenshot, but we can check
        # if the bottom rows of the image are non-white (footer present)
        bottom_strip = []
        for x in range(0, width, step):
            bottom_strip.append(img.getpixel((x, height - 1)))
        bottom_white = sum(1 for p in bottom_strip if p[0] > 240 and p[1] > 240 and p[2] > 240)
        if bottom_white / max(len(bottom_strip), 1) > 0.9:
            issues.append("Bottom of page is blank - footer may be missing")
            score -= 1

        # --- Check 3: Dark header region (nav bar) ---
        # Top 10% of page should have a darker background color
        top_strip = []
        top_height = max(1, height // 10)
        for x in range(0, width, step):
            for y in range(0, top_height, max(1, top_height // 5)):
                top_strip.append(img.getpixel((x, y)))
        if top_strip:
            top_brightness = sum(p[0] + p[1] + p[2] for p in top_strip) / (len(top_strip) * 3)
            if top_brightness > 220:
                issues.append("Header area appears very light - may lack navigation bar")
                score -= 1

        score = max(0, score)
        return {
            "score": score,
            "max_score": 5,
            "pass": score >= 3,
            "issues": issues,
            "method": "heuristic_pixel",
        }

    except ImportError:
        # PIL not available - return neutral score with note
        return {
            "score": 3,
            "max_score": 5,
            "pass": True,
            "issues": ["PIL/Pillow not available for pixel analysis - install with: pip install Pillow"],
            "method": "unavailable",
        }
    except Exception as e:
        return {
            "score": 2,
            "max_score": 5,
            "pass": False,
            "issues": [f"Heuristic scoring failed: {e}"],
            "method": "error",
        }


def _score_screenshot_llm(screenshot_path: Path) -> Optional[dict]:
    """
    Sends the screenshot to Gemini vision for a 1-5 quality score.
    Returns None if no API key is available.
    """
    api_key = os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        return None

    try:
        import base64
        import urllib.request

        with open(screenshot_path, "rb") as f:
            img_b64 = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8")

        prompt = (
            "Rate this website screenshot on a scale of 1-5 for visual completeness:\n"
            "1 = Blank or near-blank page (just a title or white background)\n"
            "2 = Minimal content, no real layout or styling\n"
            "3 = Basic layout present but missing sections or has visual issues\n"
            "4 = Good layout with multiple sections, real content and styling\n"
            "5 = Excellent: full website with header, hero, content sections, footer, and polished design\n\n"
            "Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {\"score\": N, \"reasoning\": \"...one sentence...\"}"
        )

        url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash:generateContent"
        payload = {
            "contents": [{
                "parts": [
                    {"text": prompt},
                    {"inline_data": {"mime_type": "image/webp", "data": img_b64}}
                ]
            }],
            "generationConfig": {"temperature": 0.1, "maxOutputTokens": 128},
        }
        data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            data=data,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "x-goog-api-key": api_key}
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp:
            body = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
        text = body["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
        # Strip markdown fences
        text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*", "", text)
        text = re.sub(r"\s*```$", "", text)
        result = json.loads(text)
        return {
            "score": int(result.get("score", 3)),
            "max_score": 5,
            "pass": int(result.get("score", 3)) >= 3,
            "reasoning": result.get("reasoning", ""),
            "method": "llm_vision_gemini",
        }
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[VisualJudge] LLM scoring failed: {e}")
        return None


# ── Playwright screenshot + scoring ───────────────────────────────────────────

def take_screenshot(
    project_dir: Path,
    port: int = VISUAL_JUDGE_PORT,
    output_path: Optional[Path] = None,
    timeout_ms: int = 12000,
) -> Optional[Path]:
    """
    Starts a Vite dev server in project_dir, takes a screenshot with Playwright,
    stops the server, and returns the screenshot path.
    Returns None if Playwright is unavailable or the server fails to start.
    """
    if not _check_playwright():
        print("[VisualJudge] Playwright not installed. Skipping screenshot. "
              "Install with: pip install playwright && playwright install chromium")
        return None

    if not (project_dir / "package.json").exists():
        print(f"[VisualJudge] No package.json in {project_dir} - skipping screenshot")
        return None

    if output_path is None:
        output_path = project_dir / "screenshot.webp"

    vite_proc = None
    try:
        from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

        # Start Vite dev server on the judge port
        env = {**os.environ, "PORT": str(port)}
        vite_proc = subprocess.Popen(
            ["npm", "run", "dev", "--", "--port", str(port), "--no-open"],
            cwd=str(project_dir),
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            env=env,
        )

        # Wait for dev server to be ready (poll for up to 15s)
        url = f"http://localhost:{port}"
        import urllib.request as _req
        for _ in range(30):
            time.sleep(0.5)
            try:
                _req.urlopen(url, timeout=1)
                break
            except Exception:
                continue

        # Take screenshot
        with sync_playwright() as p:
            browser = p.chromium.launch()
            page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 900})
            page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=timeout_ms)
            page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # let animations settle
            page.screenshot(path=str(output_path), type="webp")
            browser.close()

        print(f"[VisualJudge] Screenshot saved to {output_path}")
        return output_path

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[VisualJudge] Screenshot failed: {e}")
        return None
    finally:
        if vite_proc:
            vite_proc.terminate()
            try:
                vite_proc.wait(timeout=3)
            except Exception:
                vite_proc.kill()


# ── Public API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def score_visual(
    project_dir: Path,
    port: int = VISUAL_JUDGE_PORT,
    use_llm: bool = True,
) -> dict:
    """
    Full visual scoring pipeline for a generated site:
    1. Takes a Playwright screenshot
    2. Scores with pixel heuristics
    3. Optionally upgrades with Gemini LLM judge

    Always returns a dict with at least:
        score (int 0-5), pass (bool), issues (list), method (str), screenshot_path (str|None)

    Degrades gracefully if Playwright/PIL/Gemini are unavailable.
    """
    result = {
        "score": 3,
        "max_score": 5,
        "pass": True,
        "issues": [],
        "method": "skipped",
        "screenshot_path": None,
    }

    screenshot_path = take_screenshot(project_dir, port=port)
    if screenshot_path and screenshot_path.exists():
        result["screenshot_path"] = str(screenshot_path)

        # Heuristic scoring
        heuristic = _score_screenshot_heuristic(screenshot_path)
        result.update(heuristic)

        # LLM upgrade (if Gemini key available and heuristic didn't already catch blank page)
        if use_llm and result["score"] >= 2:
            llm_result = _score_screenshot_llm(screenshot_path)
            if llm_result:
                # Blend: LLM is more reliable than heuristic, but keep issues list
                issues = result.get("issues", [])
                result.update(llm_result)
                result["issues"] = issues + (
                    [f"LLM reasoning: {llm_result.get('reasoning', '')}"] if llm_result.get("reasoning") else []
                )
    else:
        result["issues"].append("Screenshot unavailable (Playwright not installed or server failed to start)")

    return result


# ── Visual Regression Baselines ────────────────────────────────────────────────

BASELINES_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "visual_baselines"


def save_as_baseline(screenshot_path: Path, template_name: str) -> Path:
    """Saves a known-good screenshot as the visual regression baseline for a template."""
    BASELINES_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    baseline_dest = BASELINES_DIR / f"{template_name}_baseline.webp"
    import shutil
    shutil.copy2(screenshot_path, baseline_dest)
    print(f"[VisualJudge] Saved baseline snapshot for '{template_name}' to {baseline_dest}")
    return baseline_dest


def compare_visual_baseline(
    screenshot_path: Path,
    baseline_path: Path,
    max_diff_percent: float = 5.0,
    diff_output_path: Optional[Path] = None,
) -> dict:
    """
    Compares a candidate screenshot against a known-good baseline screenshot using pixel-level diffing.
    Returns diff percentage and whether it passes regression tolerance.
    """
    if not screenshot_path.exists():
        return {"passed": False, "error": f"Screenshot not found: {screenshot_path}", "diff_percent": 100.0}
    if not baseline_path.exists():
        return {"passed": False, "error": f"Baseline not found: {baseline_path}", "diff_percent": 100.0}

    try:
        from PIL import Image, ImageChops

        img_actual = Image.open(screenshot_path).convert("RGB")
        img_baseline = Image.open(baseline_path).convert("RGB")

        # Resize if dimensions differ slightly due to viewport
        if img_actual.size != img_baseline.size:
            img_actual = img_actual.resize(img_baseline.size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)

        diff = ImageChops.difference(img_actual, img_baseline)
        
        # Calculate bounding box and pixel difference ratio
        bbox = diff.getbbox()
        if not bbox:
            return {"passed": True, "diff_percent": 0.0, "identical": True}

        diff_data = list(diff.getdata())
        total_pixels = len(diff_data)
        changed_pixels = sum(1 for r, g, b in diff_data if (r + g + b) > 30)
        diff_percent = (changed_pixels / total_pixels) * 100.0

        if diff_output_path:
            diff_output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            diff.save(diff_output_path)

        passed = diff_percent <= max_diff_percent
        return {
            "passed": passed,
            "diff_percent": round(diff_percent, 2),
            "max_allowed_diff": max_diff_percent,
            "changed_pixels": changed_pixels,
            "total_pixels": total_pixels,
            "diff_path": str(diff_output_path) if diff_output_path else None,
        }
    except ImportError:
        return {"passed": True, "skipped": True, "reason": "Pillow not installed; pixel diff skipped."}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"passed": False, "error": str(e), "diff_percent": 100.0}

# ── Observation helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def obs_ok(files, next_instruction):
    lines = ['<observation status="ok">']
    lines.append("[Files accepted]:")
    for p in files:
        lines.append(f"  \u2713 {p}")
    lines.append(f"\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: {next_instruction}")
    lines.append('Write ONE <tool_call name="write_site"> with exactly one .tsx file and one .css file for this section.')
    lines.append("</observation>")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def obs_done(files):
    lines = ['<observation status="complete">']
    lines.append("[SITE BUILD COMPLETE]: All required sections have been written successfully.")
    lines.append("[Files written in this session]:")
    for p in files:
        lines.append(f"  \u2713 {p}")
    lines.append("Output a <finish> tag with a brief summary of the site you built.")
    lines.append("</observation>")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def write_site(tsx_path, tsx_code, css_path, css_code):
    return (
        f'<tool_call name="write_site">\n'
        f'<file path="{tsx_path}">\n{tsx_code}\n</file>\n'
        f'<file path="{css_path}">\n{css_code}\n</file>\n'
        f'</tool_call>'
    )

def thought(text):
    return f"<thought>\n{text}\n</thought>"

def finish(text):
    return f"<finish>\n{text}\n</finish>"

def assistant(thought_text, action_text):
    return thought_text + "\n" + action_text

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import './Header.css';

export function Header() {
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fn = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 10);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', fn, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', fn);
  }, []);

  return (
    <header className={`fs-header${scrolled ? ' fs-header--bg' : ''}`} role="banner">
      <div className="fs-header__inner">
        <a href="#" className="fs-header__logo" aria-label="FlowSync home">
          <svg className="fs-header__logo-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M13 2L3 14h9l-1 8 10-12h-9l1-8z" fill="#6366f1" stroke="#6366f1" strokeWidth="0.5"/>
          </svg>
          FlowSync
        </a>

        <nav className="fs-header__nav" aria-label="Main navigation">
          <a href="#hero" className="fs-nav__link">Overview</a>
          <a href="#features" className="fs-nav__link">Features</a>
          <a href="#footer" className="fs-nav__link">Support</a>
        </nav>

        <div className="fs-header__actions">
          <a href="#" className="fs-btn fs-btn--ghost">Log In</a>
          <a href="#" className="fs-btn fs-btn--primary">Start Free Trial</a>
        </div>

        <button
          className="fs-header__burger"
          aria-label="Toggle menu"
          aria-expanded={menuOpen}
          onClick={() => setMenuOpen(o => !o)}
        >
          <span /><span /><span />

          <a href="#features" className="fs-nav__link" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Features</a>
          <a href="#footer" className="fs-nav__link" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Support</a>

    </header>
  );

# MAIN: generate and write JSONL

def main():
    try:
        from site_trajectories_batch2 import ALL_TRAJECTORY_FUNCTIONS as BATCH_2_TRAJECTORIES
    except ImportError:
        BATCH_2_TRAJECTORIES = []

    generators = [
        trajectory_restaurant_01,
        trajectory_saas_01,
        trajectory_portfolio_01,
    ] + BATCH_2_TRAJECTORIES

    output_path = Path("site_trajectories.jsonl")
    written = 0
    with output_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for gen in generators:
            record = gen()
            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=True) + "\n")
            n_turns = len([m for m in record["messages"] if m["role"] == "assistant"])
            print(f"  Wrote: {record['task_id']} ({n_turns} assistant turns)")
            written += 1

    print(f"\nDone: {written} trajectories written to {output_path}")
    print(f"File size: {output_path.stat().st_size:,} bytes")
    print()
    print("Next step: run  python dataset_merge_trajectories.py  to fold into training_data.jsonl")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);

    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
  }, []);

  return (
    <header className={`ds-header${scrolled ? ' ds-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>
      <div className="ds-header__inner">
        <a href="#" className="ds-header__logo">DevSummit<span className="ds-header__year">2025</span></a>

}"""

import React from 'react';
import './Schedule.css';

interface Track { name: string; time: string; description: string; }

const TRACKS: Track[] = [
  { name: 'Morning Keynotes', time: '9:00am - 12:00pm', description: 'Opening keynotes on the future of developer tooling and platform engineering.' },

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import './Header.css';

export function Header() {
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 10);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
  }, []);

  return (
    <header className={`pr-header${scrolled ? ' pr-header--bg' : ''}`}>
      <div className="pr-header__inner">
        <a href="#" className="pr-header__logo">Prose<span className="pr-header__logo-dot">.ai</span></a>

        </nav>

      </div>
    </header>
  );
}"""

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import './Header.css';

export function Header() {
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 30);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
  }, []);

  return (
    <header className={`bl-header${scrolled ? ' bl-header--solid' : ''}`}>
      <div className="bl-header__inner">
        <a href="#" className="bl-header__logo">BLANC STUDIO</a>
        <nav className="bl-header__nav" aria-label="Main navigation">
          <a href="#hero" className="bl-header__link">Home</a>
          <a href="#products" className="bl-header__link">Collection</a>
          <a href="#footer" className="bl-header__link">Contact</a>
        </nav>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}"""

interface PlanTier {

  },

    price: '$249',
    period: '/month',
    desc: 'For scaling tech companies with international suppliers & teams.',

    features: [

    ],

  },
  {

  }
];

        <div className="nexus-pricing__grid">

            <div 
              key={tier.name} 
              className={`nexus-price-card ${tier.highlight ? 'nexus-price-card--highlight' : ''}`}
            >
              {tier.highlight && <div className="nexus-price-card__badge">MOST POPULAR</div>}
              <h3 className="nexus-price-card__name">{tier.name}</h3>

                    {feat}

          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import './Header.css';

export function Header() {
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 20);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
  }, []);

  return (
    <header className={`lumina-header ${scrolled ? 'lumina-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>
      <div className="lumina-header__container">
        <a href="#" className="lumina-header__logo" aria-label="Lumina Dental Home">

    </header>
  );

import './Hero.css';

export function Hero() {
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (name && phone) setSubmitted(true);
  };

  return (
    <section className="lumina-hero" id="hero">
      <div className="lumina-hero__container">
        <div className="lumina-hero__content">
          <span className="lumina-hero__eyebrow">AESTHETIC &amp; RESTORATIVE EXCELLENCE</span>

            <em>gentle touch</em>, and radiant smiles.
          </h1>
          <p className="lumina-hero__subtitle">
            Experience state-of-the-art private suite dentistry in Midtown Manhattan. 
            From painless laser hygiene to bespoke porcelain veneers, your comfort is our priority.
          </p>

          <div className="lumina-hero__perks">
            <div className="lumina-perk">
              <span className="lumina-perk__icon">✨</span>
              <span>Painless Waterlase Technology</span>
            </div>
            <div className="lumina-perk">
              <span className="lumina-perk__icon">🔬</span>
              <span>3D Digital iTero Scanners</span>
            </div>
            <div className="lumina-perk">
              <span className="lumina-perk__icon">☕</span>
              <span>Private Patient Lounges</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="lumina-hero__card-wrap">
          <div className="lumina-booking-card">
            <h3 className="lumina-booking-card__title">Request Smile Consultation</h3>
            <p className="lumina-booking-card__sub">Complimentary 30-min digital smile simulation.</p>

            {submitted ? (
              <div className="lumina-booking-card__success">
                <span className="lumina-success-icon">✓</span>
                <h4>Thank you, {name}!</h4>
                <p>Our concierge team will call you within 2 hours to confirm your preferred suite time.</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="lumina-booking-form">
                <label className="lumina-label">
                  Your Full Name
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    required 
                    placeholder="e.g. Jessica Miller" 
                    value={name} 
                    onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} 
                    className="lumina-input"
                  />
                </label>
                <label className="lumina-label">
                  Phone Number
                  <input 
                    type="tel" 
                    required 
                    placeholder="(212) 000-0000" 
                    value={phone} 
                    onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)} 
                    className="lumina-input"
                  />
                </label>
                <label className="lumina-label">
                  Primary Interest
                  <select className="lumina-select" defaultValue="veneers">
                    <option value="veneers">Cosmetic Porcelain Veneers</option>
                    <option value="invisalign">Invisalign Clear Aligners</option>
                    <option value="whitening">Laser Teeth Whitening</option>
                    <option value="hygiene">Comprehensive Checkup &amp; Clean</option>
                  </select>
                </label>
                <button type="submit" className="lumina-btn lumina-btn--teal lumina-btn--block">
                  Confirm Free Assessment
                </button>
              </form>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

        """import React, { useState } from 'react';
import './CodePreview.css';

const SAMPLE_CODE = `import { Swarm, AgentRunner } from '@omnimind/core';

// Initialize self-correcting agent loop
const swarm = new Swarm({
  planner: 'claude-3-5-sonnet',
  coder: 'qwen-2.5-coder-3b',
  sandbox: { runtime: 'vitest-in-memory', timeoutMs: 5000 }
});

const result = await swarm.executeTask({
  task: 'Build responsive pricing table with toggle',
  maxIterations: 3
});

console.log(result.verifiedSolution);`;

export function CodePreview() {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(SAMPLE_CODE);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <section className="omni-code" id="code">
      <div className="omni-code__container">
        <div className="omni-code__card">
          <div className="omni-code__top">
            <span className="omni-code__file">agent_runner.ts</span>
            <button onClick={handleCopy} className="omni-code__copy">
              {copied ? '✓ Copied' : 'Copy Snippet'}
            </button>
          </div>
          <pre className="omni-code__block">
            <code>{SAMPLE_CODE}</code>
          </pre>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', fn);
  }, []);

  );

        """import React, { useState } from 'react';
import './Catalog.css';

interface Coffee {
  name: string;
  origin: string;
  process: string;
  notes: string;
  price: string;
  altitude: string;
}

const COFFEES: Coffee[] = [
  {
    name: 'Yirgacheffe Floral',
    origin: 'Gedeo Zone, Ethiopia',
    process: 'Washed',
    notes: 'Bergamot, jasmine, candied lemon zest',
    price: '$22.00',
    altitude: '2,100 MASL'
  },
  {
    name: 'Huila Pink Bourbon',
    origin: 'San Agustin, Colombia',
    process: 'Anaerobic 72h',
    notes: 'Blood orange, guava, cacao nibs',
    price: '$26.00',
    altitude: '1,850 MASL'
  },
  {
    name: 'Antigua Peaberry',
    origin: 'Finca Medina, Guatemala',
    process: 'Sun-Dried Natural',
    notes: 'Dark chocolate, marzipan, spiced plum',
    price: '$20.00',
    altitude: '1,600 MASL'
  }
];

export function Catalog() {
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleAdd = (name: string) => {
    setAdded(name);
    setTimeout(() => setAdded(null), 1800);
  };

  return (
    <section className="solace-catalog" id="catalog">
      <div className="solace-catalog__container">
        <div className="solace-catalog__header">
          <span className="solace-tag">DIRECT TRADE RELEASES</span>
          <h2 className="solace-catalog__title">Single-Origin Roast Index</h2>
          <p className="solace-catalog__sub">Each 250g bag shipped in nitrogen-flushed compostable valve bags.</p>
        </div>

        <div className="solace-catalog__grid">
          {COFFEES.map((c) => (
            <div key={c.name} className="solace-card">
              <div className="solace-card__header">
                <span className="solace-card__process">{c.process}</span>
                <span className="solace-card__alt">{c.altitude}</span>
              </div>
              <h3 className="solace-card__title">{c.name}</h3>
              <div className="solace-card__origin">📍 {c.origin}</div>
              <div className="solace-card__notes">
                <strong>Tasting Notes:</strong> {c.notes}
              </div>
              <div className="solace-card__footer">
                <span className="solace-card__price">{c.price}</span>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => handleAdd(c.name)} 
                  className="solace-btn solace-btn--orange"
                >
                  {added === c.name ? '✓ Added' : 'Add to Bag'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
""",

#### `app.py`

"""
app.py — ReactAgent SLM Local Web UI
Serves a premium web interface for interacting with my-react-agent-lora.

Usage:
    python app.py
    # or via unified CLI:
    python slm.py serve
    # Then open http://localhost:5000 in your browser

The model is loaded ONCE at startup and shared across all requests.
Requests are queued — only one generation runs at a time (GPU constraint).
Live output is streamed to the browser via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
"""

import hashlib
import hmac
import html

import time

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Optional, Dict, List

# ── Paths & Environment ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BASE_DIR   = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
STATIC_DIR = BASE_DIR / "web_ui_static"
HISTORY_FILE = BASE_DIR / "web_ui_history.json"
MODEL_PATH = str(BASE_DIR / "my-react-agent-lora")

sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

from flask import Flask, Response, jsonify, request, send_from_directory

# ── App State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=str(STATIC_DIR))

# Per-session authentication token for WebSocket PTY server (CSWSH defense)
_SHELL_AUTH_TOKEN = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

def _mint_shell_ticket() -> str:
    """Mints a short-lived (30s) single-use HMAC-SHA256 authenticated ticket for the shell WebSocket."""
    timestamp = int(time.time())
    nonce = secrets.token_hex(16)
    payload = f"{timestamp}:{nonce}"
    sig = hmac.new(_SHELL_AUTH_TOKEN.encode("utf-8"), payload.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return f"{timestamp}.{nonce}.{sig}"

# Per-task SSE queues: task_id -> queue.Queue
task_queues: dict[str, queue.Queue] = {}
task_results: dict[str, dict] = {}
MAX_CACHED_RESULTS = 100
MAX_CACHED_QUEUES = 100

def _register_task_queue(task_id: str, q: queue.Queue):
    """Registers task queue with bounded eviction to prevent memory leaks."""
    global task_queues
    task_queues[task_id] = q
    while len(task_queues) > MAX_CACHED_QUEUES:
        oldest_id = next(iter(task_queues))
        task_queues.pop(oldest_id, None)

def _store_task_result(task_id: str, data: dict):
    """Stores result in memory cache bounded to MAX_CACHED_RESULTS, evicting oldest."""
    global task_results
    task_results[task_id] = data
    while len(task_results) > MAX_CACHED_RESULTS:
        oldest_k = next(iter(task_results))
        task_results.pop(oldest_k, None)

def _get_task_result(task_id: str) -> dict | None:
    """Retrieves result from memory cache, falling back to disk history if evicted."""
    if task_id in task_results:
        return task_results[task_id]
    for entry in _load_history():
        if entry.get("task_id") == task_id:
            task_results[task_id] = entry
            return entry
    return None

def _sanitize_identifier(name: str, default: str = "Component") -> str:
    """
    Enforces strict identifier syntax: ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$
    Completely eliminates directory traversal (e.g. ../../) and template injection.
    """
    raw = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_]', '_', (name or "").strip())
    cleaned = re.sub(r'_+', '_', raw).strip('_')
    if not cleaned or not re.match(r'^[A-Za-z]', cleaned):
        cleaned = default if (default and re.match(r'^[A-Za-z]', default)) else f"Safe_{cleaned}"
    return cleaned[:64]

# Tasks that have been cancelled by the user
cancelled_tasks: set = set()

# Global model runner (loaded once)
_runner = None
_runner_lock = threading.Lock()
_model_status = "loading"  # loading | ready | busy
_generation_queue: queue.Queue = queue.Queue()

def _load_model():

def _auto_test(symbol: str, is_hook: bool) -> str:

# ── Intent classifier ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_SITE_KEYWORDS = [
    "website", "web site", "landing page", "full page", "homepage", "home page",
    "site for", "site for a", "page for", "build me a", "build a site",
    "restaurant site", "restaurant page", "portfolio site", "portfolio page",
    "portfolio for", "make a portfolio", "build a portfolio", "portfolio of",
    "saas site", "saas page", "blog site", "event page", "event site",
    "multi-section", "multi section", "full website", "complete website",
    "storefront", "ecommerce site", "online store", "agency site", "brand site", "showcase site",
    "dashboard with", "admin panel", "analytics portal", "multi-page", "multi page",
    "web application", "web app for",
]

_SITE_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r'\b(?:build|create|make|generate|design)\s+(?:a|an|the|me\s+a)?\s*(?:modern|responsive|clean|full|complete)?\s*(?:website|web\s+site|landing\s+page|homepage|portfolio|storefront|showcase|portal|dashboard)\b', re.I),
    re.compile(r'\bportfolio\s+(?:for|of)\s+[A-Za-z]+', re.I),
    re.compile(r'\b(?:restaurant|cafe|coffee\s+shop|bakery|bar|salon|spa|agency|hotel|fitness|gym|clinic)\s+(?:website|page|site)\b', re.I),
    re.compile(r'\bdashboard\s+(?:with|for)\s+\d+\s+(?:widgets|charts|panels|cards)\b', re.I),
]

def _classify_intent_with_confidence(prompt: str) -> tuple[str, float]:
    """
    Returns ('site' | 'component', confidence) where confidence is between 0.0 and 1.0.
    """
    lower = prompt.lower()
    for pat in _SITE_PATTERNS:
        if pat.search(prompt):
            return "site", 0.95

    for kw in _SITE_KEYWORDS:
        if kw in lower:
            return "site", 0.90

    comp_indicators = ["component", "button", "input", "modal", "dialog", "hook", "use", "slider", "switch", "toggle", "card", "dropdown", "navbar", "footer", "badge", "avatar"]
    for kw in comp_indicators:
        if re.search(rf'\b{kw}\b', lower):
            return "component", 0.85

    return "component", 0.60


def _classify_intent(prompt: str) -> str:
    """Returns 'site' if the prompt looks like a full-page/website request, 'component' otherwise."""
    mode, _ = _classify_intent_with_confidence(prompt)
    return mode


def _extract_component_name(prompt: str) -> str:
    """Extract PascalCase or camelCase component/hook/project name from prompt with case-insensitive fallback."""
    # 1. Look for backtick/quote/<tags> wrapped names: `useCounter`, <PinInput>, 'MyCard', "AURA Spatial Audio"
    m = re.search(r'[`\'"“<]([a-zA-Z0-9\s_-]{2,50})[`\'"”>]', prompt)
    if m:
        raw_val = m.group(1).strip()
        words = re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z0-9]+', raw_val)
        if words and not all(w.lower() in ("a", "an", "the", "for", "with", "and", "or", "in", "of", "to") for w in words):
            if len(words) == 1 and words[0].startswith("use") and len(words[0]) > 3:
                return "use" + words[0][3:].capitalize()
            return "".join(w.capitalize() for w in words)

    # 2. Look for any useX hook name anywhere in the prompt
    m = re.search(r'\b(use[A-Za-z0-9]+)\b', prompt, re.I)
    if m:
        val = m.group(1)
        return "use" + val[3:].capitalize() if len(val) > 3 else "useHook"

    # 3. Look for PascalCase words that are NOT common English verbs/instructions
    STOP_WORDS = {
        "Write", "Create", "Build", "Implement", "Make", "Generate", "Design",
        "Add", "Fix", "Update", "Modify", "Refactor", "Test", "Please", "A", "An", "The"
    }
    candidates = re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]+\b', prompt)
    for c in candidates:
        if c not in STOP_WORDS:
            return c

    # 4. Smart lowercase fallback: detect compound component noun phrases
    # e.g., "dark mode toggle button", "user profile card", "search bar"
    m = re.search(
        r'\b(?:a|an|the)?\s*([a-z0-9_-]+(?:\s+[a-z0-9_-]+){0,2})\s+'
        r'(?:component|widget|element|hook|button|modal|card|form|table|dropdown|menu|bar|input|switch|slider|dialog|drawer|toast|alert|badge|tabs?|accordion|picker|view|player|nav)\b',
        prompt,
        re.I
    )
    if m:
        phrase = m.group(0).strip()
        words = [w.capitalize() for w in re.split(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', phrase) if w.lower() not in {"a", "an", "the", "build", "make", "create"}]
        if words:
            return "".join(words)[:64]

    # 5. Extract non-stop words from prompt and title-case
    GENERIC_STOP = {
        "a", "an", "the", "build", "create", "make", "implement", "design", "write", "generate",
        "me", "for", "with", "and", "or", "in", "to", "of", "from", "at", "by", "that", "this",
        "modern", "clean", "responsive", "simple", "good", "nice", "interactive", "reusable"
    }
    tokens = [w.capitalize() for w in re.findall(r'\b[a-zA-Z0-9]+\b', prompt) if w.lower() not in GENERIC_STOP]
    if tokens:
        return "".join(tokens[:3])[:64]

    return "Component"


def _extract_project_name(prompt: str) -> str:
    """
    Extracts a project/business name from a site-mode prompt with case-insensitive support.
    Prefers explicit 'for <Name>' patterns; falls back to domain-specific slugs or title-cased words.
    Guaranteed to return a valid filesystem-safe slug.
    """
    # 1. Quoted name (e.g. "AURA Spatial Audio", 'FlowSync AI')
    m = re.search(r"[\"']([a-zA-Z0-9\s_-]{2,40})[\"']", prompt)
    if m:
        raw = m.group(1).strip()
        words = [w.capitalize() for w in re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z0-9]+', raw) if w.lower() not in {"a", "an", "the"}]
        if words:
            return "_".join(words)[:64]

    # 2. Explicit 'for <Name>' or 'called <Name>' (case-insensitive with title-casing)
    m = re.search(
        r"(?:for|called|named)\s+[\"']?([a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9 ]{0,39}?)(?:$|,|\.|\s+(?:with|using|and|in|featuring)\b)",
        prompt,
        re.I
    )
    if m:
        raw = m.group(1).strip()
        words = [w.capitalize() for w in re.split(r'\s+', raw) if w.lower() not in {"a", "an", "the"}]
        if words:
            return "_".join(words)[:64]

    # 3. Domain keyword fallback (e.g. restaurant, cafe, bakery, portfolio, dashboard)
    domain_match = re.search(r'\b(restaurant|cafe|coffee|bakery|bar|salon|spa|agency|hotel|fitness|gym|clinic|portfolio|storefront|shop|saas|blog|dashboard)\b', prompt, re.I)
    if domain_match:
        return f"{domain_match.group(1).capitalize()}_Site"

    # 4. Sequence of TitleCase words (not stop words)
    STOP = {
        "Write", "Create", "Build", "Make", "Design", "Generate", "Develop",
        "A", "An", "The", "My", "Our", "New", "React", "TypeScript", "Website",
        "Page", "Site", "Landing", "Full", "Complete", "Modern", "Beautiful",
    }
    words = re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]+\b', prompt)
    candidates = [w for w in words if w not in STOP]
    if candidates:
        return "_".join(candidates[:2])

    return "MySite"

# ── Generation Worker ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_current_task: Optional[dict] = None

def _worker():
    """Background thread: drains _generation_queue one task at a time."""
    global _model_status, _current_task
    while True:
        task = _generation_queue.get()
        if task is None:
            break
        task_id = task["task_id"]
        q = task_queues.get(task_id)

        # Skip tasks that were cancelled while waiting in the queue
        if task_id in cancelled_tasks:
            cancelled_tasks.discard(task_id)
            if q:
                q.put({"type": "cancelled", "text": "Generation cancelled."})
                q.put({"type": "done"})
            _generation_queue.task_done()
            continue

        try:
            _model_status = "busy"
            _current_task = task
            with _runner_lock:
                task_err = []
                def _run_target():
                    try:
                        if task.get("is_follow_up"):
                            _run_session_edit_turn(task, q)
                        elif task.get("mode") == "site":
                            _run_site_generation(task, q)
                        else:
                            _run_generation(task, q)
                    except Exception as err:
                        task_err.append(err)

                worker_t = threading.Thread(target=_run_target, daemon=True)
                worker_t.start()
                max_turns_est = task.get("max_turns", 14)
                timeout_s = max(2400.0, max_turns_est * 200.0)  # 40-minute guard for multi-turn site pipelines
                worker_t.join(timeout=timeout_s)

                if worker_t.is_alive():
                    raise TimeoutError(f"Task {task_id} timed out after {int(timeout_s)} seconds.")
                if task_err:
                    raise task_err[0]
        except Exception as e:
            if q:
                q.put({"type": "error", "text": str(e)})
                q.put({"type": "done"})
        finally:
            _current_task = None
            _model_status = "ready"
            cancelled_tasks.discard(task_id)
            _generation_queue.task_done()

threading.Thread(target=_worker, daemon=True).start()


_stdout_context = threading.local()


class _ThreadScopedStdout:
    """Routes print() calls to the active task Queue as SSE events ONLY for the generation thread."""
    def __init__(self, original):
        self._original = original

    def write(self, text):
        try:
            self._original.write(text)
        except UnicodeEncodeError:
            self._original.write(text.encode("ascii", errors="replace").decode("ascii"))
        try:
            self._original.flush()
        except Exception:
            pass
        active_q = getattr(_stdout_context, "active_queue", None)
        if active_q and text.strip():
            active_q.put({"type": "log", "text": text.rstrip()})

    def flush(self):
        self._original.flush()


sys.stdout = _ThreadScopedStdout(sys.stdout)


def _link_node_modules(target_nm: Path, source_nm: Path):
    """Creates a directory junction (Windows) or symlink (POSIX) to node_modules with clear diagnostics."""
    if not source_nm.exists() or target_nm.exists():
        return
    try:
        if os.name == "nt":
            import subprocess
            res = subprocess.run(
                ["cmd.exe", "/c", "mklink", "/J", str(target_nm), str(source_nm)],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
            )
            if res.returncode != 0:
                try:
                    os.symlink(str(source_nm), str(target_nm), target_is_directory=True)
                except Exception as sym_err:
                    print(f"[Scaffold] Warning: Could not create Windows junction or symlink: {res.stderr.strip() or sym_err}")
        else:
            try:
                os.symlink(str(source_nm), str(target_nm), target_is_directory=True)
            except Exception as sym_err:
                print(f"[Scaffold] Warning: Could not symlink node_modules on POSIX: {sym_err}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Scaffold] Warning: Error while linking node_modules: {e}")
