  if (testToggle) testToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = testArea.classList.toggle('open');
    if (testToggle) testToggle.classList.toggle('active', open);
    testToggle.textContent = open ? 'Hide test' : 'Custom test';
  });

  // ── Prompt Auto-resize & Shortcuts
  promptInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
    promptInput.style.height = 'auto';
    promptInput.style.height = Math.min(promptInput.scrollHeight, 200) + 'px';
  });
  promptInput.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      generateBtn.click();
    }
  });

  // ── Status Polling
  function updateStatus(s, q) {
    modelStatus = s;
    statusPill.className = s;
    const labels = {
      loading: 'Loading model',
      ready:   'Model ready',
      busy:    'Generating (click to stop)',
      error:   'Model error'
    };
    statusText.textContent = labels[s] || s;
    if (s === 'busy') {
      statusPill.title = 'Click to halt active generation and clear queue';
    } else {
      statusPill.title = '';
    }
    queueBadge.classList.toggle('visible', q > 0);
    if (q > 0) {
      queueCount.textContent = q;
      queueBadge.title = `Queue: ${q} task(s). Click to clear entire queue`;
    }
  }

  async function pollStatus() {
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/status');
      const d = await r.json();
      updateStatus(d.model_status, d.queue_depth || 0);
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  pollStatus();
  setInterval(pollStatus, 3000);

  // Clear queue by clicking queue pill
  queueBadge.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const ok = await showConfirmModal({
      title: 'Clear Queue',
      message: 'Clear all queued tasks and halt generation?',
      confirmText: 'Clear Queue',
      danger: true
    });
    if (!ok) return;
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/queue/clear', { method: 'POST' });
      const d = await r.json();
      showToast(`Cleared ${d.cleared_count || 0} queued task(s).`, 'info');
      _setGenerating(false);
      finishProgress();
      pollStatus();
    } catch (_) {
      showToast('Failed to clear queue.', 'error');
    }
  });

  // Halt active generation by clicking status pill
  statusPill.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (modelStatus !== 'busy') return;
    const ok = await showConfirmModal({
      title: 'Halt Generation',
      message: 'Halt active generation and clear queue?',
      confirmText: 'Halt Generation',
      danger: true
    });
    if (!ok) return;
    try {
      if (currentTaskId) {
        await fetch('/api/cancel/' + currentTaskId, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ clear_queue: true }),
        });
      }
      await fetch('/api/queue/clear', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('Generation halted and queue cleared.', 'warn');
      _setGenerating(false);
      finishProgress();
      pollStatus();
    } catch (_) {
      showToast('Could not halt generation.', 'error');
    }
  });

  // ── Toast System ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const toastContainer = $('toast-container');
  function showToast(message, type = 'info', duration = 3500) {
    if (!toastContainer) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'toast ' + type;
    t.innerHTML = '<div class="toast-dot"></div><span>' + esc(String(message ?? '')) + '</span>';
    toastContainer.appendChild(t);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => t.classList.add('show')));
    setTimeout(() => {
      t.classList.remove('show');
      t.classList.add('hide');
      setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 300);
    }, duration);
  }

  // ── Additional DOM Refs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const cancelBtn        = $('cancel-btn');
  const regenBtn         = $('regen-btn');
  const editPromptBtn    = $('edit-prompt-btn');
  const fullscreenBtn    = $('fullscreen-btn');
  const fullscreenOverlay= $('fullscreen-overlay');
  const fullscreenClose  = $('fullscreen-close');
  const fullscreenCodeEl = $('fullscreen-code');
  const fullscreenFilename = $('fullscreen-filename');
  const historySearch    = $('history-search');
  const historyClearBtn  = $('history-clear-btn');
  const charCounter      = $('char-counter');
  const templatesToggle  = $('templates-toggle');
  const templateChips    = $('template-chips');
  const styleSystemToggle = $('style-system-toggle');
  const styleSystemBody   = $('style-system-body');
  const stylePresetSelect = $('style-preset-select');
  const styleTokensInput  = $('style-tokens-input');
  const pasteReferoBtn    = $('paste-refero-btn');
  const clearTokensBtn    = $('clear-tokens-btn');
  const clearLogsBtn     = $('clear-logs-btn');
  const genTimer         = $('gen-timer');
  const shortcutsBtn     = $('shortcuts-btn');
  const shortcutsModal   = $('shortcuts-modal');
  const shortcutsClose   = $('shortcuts-close');

  // ── Code Display with Line Numbers ──────────────────────────────────────────
  function addLineNumbers(pre) {
    const code = pre.querySelector('code');
    if (!code) return;
    const lines = code.innerHTML.split('\n');
    const gutter = document.createElement('div');
    gutter.className = 'code-gutter';
    gutter.innerHTML = lines.map((_, i) => '<span>' + (i + 1) + '</span>').join('');
    const content = document.createElement('div');
    content.className = 'code-lines';
    content.innerHTML = code.innerHTML;
    pre.innerHTML = '';
    pre.classList.add('with-gutter');
    pre.appendChild(gutter);
    pre.appendChild(content);
  }

  function showCode(code, filename) {
    currentCode = code;
    if (!code) {
      codeView.innerHTML = '<div id="code-empty"><div><div id="code-empty-title">No code generated yet</div><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3);margin-top:4px">Run a generation to see the output here</div></div></div>';
      codeFilename.textContent = '';
      copyBtn.disabled = true;
      downloadBtn.disabled = true;
      return;
    }
    codeFilename.textContent = filename || 'Component.tsx';
    const pre = document.createElement('pre');
    const code_el = document.createElement('code');
    code_el.className = 'language-typescript';
    code_el.textContent = code;
    pre.appendChild(code_el);
    codeView.innerHTML = '';
    codeView.appendChild(pre);
    if (window.hljs) hljs.highlightElement(code_el);
    addLineNumbers(pre);
    copyBtn.disabled = false;
    downloadBtn.disabled = false;
  }

  // ── Terminal Log Functions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function classifyLog(text) {
    const t = text.toLowerCase();
    if (t.includes('[thought]') || t.startsWith('thought:')) return 'thought';
    if (t.includes('[action]')  || t.startsWith('action:'))  return 'action';
    if (t.includes('passed') || t.includes('tests passed'))  return 'passed';
    if ((t.includes('failed') || t.includes('error')) && !t.startsWith('[server]')) return 'failed';
    if (t.includes('warn')) return 'warn';
    if (t.match(/\[turn\s*\d+/i) || t.startsWith('===') || t.startsWith('---')) return 'turn';
    if (t.startsWith('[server]') || t.startsWith('#')) return 'header';
    if (!text.trim()) return 'dim';
    return 'default';
  }

  function appendLog(text) {
    const logEmpty = $('log-empty');
    if (logEmpty) logEmpty.remove();
    if (logCursor && logCursor.parentNode) logContent.removeChild(logCursor);
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'log-line ' + classifyLog(text);
    const now = new Date();
    const ts = now.toTimeString().slice(0,8);
    const tsSpan = document.createElement('span');
    tsSpan.className = 'log-ts';
    tsSpan.textContent = ts;
    span.appendChild(tsSpan);
    span.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
    logContent.appendChild(span);
    if (logCursor) logContent.appendChild(logCursor);
    const scroll = $('term-scroll');
    if (scroll) scroll.scrollTop = scroll.scrollHeight;
  }

  function clearLog() {
    logContent.innerHTML = '';
    if (logCursor) logContent.appendChild(logCursor);
  }
  if (clearLogsBtn) {
    clearLogsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      clearLog();
      showToast('Agent logs cleared.', 'info', 1500);
    });
  }

  // ── Progress Bar & Timer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let progressVal = 0, progressInterval = null;
  let genStartTime = 0, genTimerInterval = null;

  function startProgress() {
    progressBar.classList.add('active');
    progressVal = 5; progressBar.style.width = '5%';
    clearInterval(progressInterval);
    progressInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (progressVal < 88) {
        progressVal += (88 - progressVal) * 0.04;
        progressBar.style.width = progressVal + '%';
      }
    }, 400);

    // Generation timer
    genStartTime = Date.now();
    if (genTimer) {
      genTimer.style.display = 'inline-block';
      genTimer.textContent = '0.0s';
      clearInterval(genTimerInterval);
      genTimerInterval = setInterval(() => {
        const sec = ((Date.now() - genStartTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
        genTimer.textContent = sec + 's';
      }, 100);
    }
  }

  function finishProgress() {
    clearInterval(progressInterval);
    progressBar.style.width = '100%';
    setTimeout(() => {
      progressBar.classList.remove('active');
      progressBar.style.width = '0%';
    }, 700);

    clearInterval(genTimerInterval);
  }

  // ── Generating State Toggle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function _setGenerating(isGenerating) {
    if (isGenerating) {
      generateBtn.disabled = true;
      generateBtn.classList.add('generating');
      btnLabel.textContent = 'Generating';
      cancelBtn.style.display = 'block';
      regenBtn.style.display = 'none';
      if (editPromptBtn) editPromptBtn.style.display = 'none';
      if (logCursor) logCursor.classList.add('active');
    } else {
      generateBtn.disabled = false;
      generateBtn.classList.remove('generating');
      btnLabel.textContent = 'Generate';
      cancelBtn.style.display = 'none';
      if (logCursor) logCursor.classList.remove('active');
      if (_activeHistoryItem) {
        regenBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
        if (editPromptBtn) editPromptBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Cancel Button ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try {
      if (currentTaskId) {
        await fetch('/api/cancel/' + currentTaskId, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ clear_queue: true }),
        });
      }
      await fetch('/api/queue/clear', { method: 'POST' });
      showToast('Generation cancelled and queue cleared.', 'warn');
      finishProgress();
      _setGenerating(false);
      pollStatus();
    } catch (_) {
      showToast('Could not cancel task.', 'error');
    }
  });

  // ── Code Pane Action Buttons (Edit Prompt & Regenerate) ────────────────────
  if (editPromptBtn) {
    editPromptBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (_activeHistoryItem) {
        loadItemForEditing(_activeHistoryItem);
      } else if (promptInput.value.trim()) {
        highlightPromptInput();
        promptInput.focus();
      }
    });
  }

  regenBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (_activeHistoryItem) {
      regenerateItem(_activeHistoryItem);
    } else {
      generateBtn.click();
    }
  });

  // ── Generate Handler ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  generateBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const prompt = promptInput.value.trim();
    if (!prompt) { promptInput.focus(); return; }
    if (modelStatus === 'loading') {
      showToast('Model is currently loading into GPU memory. Please wait until "Model ready" appears.', 'warn', 4000);
      return;
    }
    if (modelStatus === 'error') {
      showToast('Model failed to load. Check server terminal logs.', 'error', 5000);
      return;
    }

    _setGenerating(true);
    resultBadge.className = '';
    resultBadge.textContent = '';
    turnBadge.style.display = 'none';
    clearLog();
    showCode('', '');
    startProgress();

    setRightSubtab('term');
    setView('split');

    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          prompt,
          symbol:       symbolInput.value.trim(),
          test_code:    testInput.value.trim(),
          max_turns:    parseInt($('max-turns').value, 10),
          max_tokens:   parseInt($('max-tokens').value, 10),
          style_tokens: styleTokensInput ? styleTokensInput.value.trim() : '',
          style_preset: stylePresetSelect ? stylePresetSelect.value : '',
        }),
      });
      const d = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d.error || 'Generation failed');
      currentTaskId = d.task_id;
      currentSymbol = d.symbol;
      codeFilename.textContent = d.symbol + '.tsx';
      streamTask(d.task_id, d.symbol);
    } catch (err) {
      finishProgress();
      _setGenerating(false);
      appendLog('[Error] ' + err.message);
      showToast(err.message, 'error');
    }
  });

  // ── Markdown Summary Renderer ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  function formatInlineMarkdown(text) {
    if (!text) return '';
    let out = esc(text);
    // Inline code: `code`
    out = out.replace(/`([^`]+?)`/g, '<code class="inline-code" style="padding:1.5px 5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);border-radius:3px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--accent);">$1</code>');
    // Bold: **text** or __text__
    out = out.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong style="color:var(--text-1);font-weight:600;">$1</strong>');
    out = out.replace(/__(.+?)__/g, '<strong style="color:var(--text-1);font-weight:600;">$1</strong>');
    // Italic: *text* or _text_
    out = out.replace(/\*([^\*]+?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');
    out = out.replace(/_([^_]+?)_/g, '<em>$1</em>');
    // Links: [label](url)
    out = out.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<a href="$2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color:var(--accent);text-decoration:underline;">$1</a>');
    return out;
  }

  function renderMarkdownSummary(mdText) {
    if (!mdText) return '';
    const lines = mdText.split('\n');
    let html = '';
    let inList = false;
    let inCode = false;
    let codeLang = '';
    let codeBuffer = [];

    for (let rawLine of lines) {
      const line = rawLine.trimEnd();

      // Check fenced code block boundaries
      if (line.trim().startsWith('```')) {
        if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; }
        if (!inCode) {
          inCode = true;
          codeLang = line.trim().slice(3).trim().toLowerCase();
          codeBuffer = [];
        } else {
          inCode = false;
          const rawCode = codeBuffer.join('\n');
          let highlighted = '';
          if (window.hljs) {
            try {
              if (codeLang && hljs.getLanguage(codeLang)) {
                highlighted = hljs.highlight(rawCode, { language: codeLang }).value;
              } else {
                highlighted = hljs.highlightAuto(rawCode).value;
              }
            } catch (_) {
              highlighted = esc(rawCode);
            }
          } else {
            highlighted = esc(rawCode);
          }

          html += '<div class="chat-code-block">' +
            '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:4px 10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:11px;color:var(--text-3);">' +
              '<span>' + esc(codeLang || 'code') + '</span>' +
              '<button type="button" class="tool-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:11px;" onclick="copyChatCode(this)" aria-label="Copy code snippet">Copy</button>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<pre><code class="' + (codeLang ? 'language-' + esc(codeLang) : '') + '">' + highlighted + '</code></pre>' +
          '</div>';
          codeBuffer = [];
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (inCode) {
        codeBuffer.push(rawLine);
        continue;
      }

      if (!line.trim()) {
        if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; }
        continue;
      }

      if (line.startsWith('### ')) {
        if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; }
        html += `<h3>${formatInlineMarkdown(line.slice(4).trim())}</h3>`;
      } else if (line.startsWith('## ')) {
        if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; }
        html += `<h2>${formatInlineMarkdown(line.slice(3).trim())}</h2>`;
      } else if (line.startsWith('# ')) {
        if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; }
        html += `<h2>${formatInlineMarkdown(line.slice(2).trim())}</h2>`;
      } else if (line.startsWith('- ') || line.startsWith('* ') || line.startsWith('• ')) {
        if (!inList) { html += '<ul style="margin:4px 0 8px 18px;padding:0;">'; inList = true; }
        const content = formatInlineMarkdown(line.replace(/^[-*•]\s*/, '').trim());
        html += `<li>${content}</li>`;
      } else {
        if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; }
        html += `<p>${formatInlineMarkdown(line)}</p>`;
      }
    }
    if (inList) html += '</ul>';
    if (inCode && codeBuffer.length) {
      const rawCode = codeBuffer.join('\n');
      html += '<div class="chat-code-block"><pre><code>' + esc(rawCode) + '</code></pre></div>';
    }
    return html;
  }

  // ── Structured Summary Agent Card ──────────────────────────────────────────
  function appendAgentSummaryCard(summaryText, meta = {}) {
    if (chatEmpty) chatEmpty.style.display = 'none';
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'chat-card-agent';

    const now = new Date();
    const timeStr = now.toTimeString().slice(0, 5);

    let visualBadgeHtml = '';
    if (meta.visual_score !== undefined && meta.visual_score !== null) {
      const vs = Number(meta.visual_score);
      visualBadgeHtml = `<span class="turn-badge score-badge">&#x2605; ${vs.toFixed(1)}/5 Visual Score</span>`;
    }

    let recoveryBadgeHtml = '';
    if (meta.auto_recovered) {
      recoveryBadgeHtml = `<span class="turn-badge recovery-badge">&#x26A0; Auto-recovered</span>`;
    }

    let filesHtml = '';
    if (meta.files && meta.files.length) {
      filesHtml = '<span class="chat-files-label">Touched:</span>';
      meta.files.forEach(f => {
        filesHtml += `<span class="chat-file-tag" data-file="${esc(f)}">${esc(f)}</span>`;
      });
    }

    let renderedHtml = `
      <div class="chat-turn-header">
        <div class="turn-agent-badge">&#x2728; SiteAgent</div>
        ${visualBadgeHtml}
        ${recoveryBadgeHtml}
        ${meta.turn_num ? `<span style="font-size:0.6875rem;color:var(--text-3);font-family:var(--font-mono);">${meta.turn_num} turns</span>` : ''}
        <span class="turn-time">${timeStr}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="summary-rendered">${renderMarkdownSummary(summaryText)}</div>
      <div class="chat-turn-footer">
        ${filesHtml ? `<div class="chat-files-list">${filesHtml}</div>` : ''}
        <div class="chat-turn-actions">
          <button class="chat-action-btn primary card-act-preview" type="button" aria-label="Open live preview of current session">Live Preview &#x2197;</button>
          <button class="chat-action-btn card-act-code" type="button" aria-label="Open code in editor drawer">&lt;/&gt; View Code</button>
          <button class="chat-action-btn card-act-diff" type="button" aria-label="Open workspace checkpoint diffs">&Delta; View Diff</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    card.innerHTML = renderedHtml;

    const btnPreview = card.querySelector('.card-act-preview');
    if (btnPreview) btnPreview.addEventListener('click', () => openSlideover('preview'));

    const btnCode = card.querySelector('.card-act-code');
    if (btnCode) btnCode.addEventListener('click', () => {
      openSlideover('code');
      if (meta.files && meta.files.length && currentSessionFiles[meta.files[0]]) {
        showCode(currentSessionFiles[meta.files[0]], meta.files[0]);
      }
    });

    const btnDiff = card.querySelector('.card-act-diff');
    if (btnDiff) btnDiff.addEventListener('click', () => openSlideover('diff'));

    card.querySelectorAll('.chat-file-tag').forEach(tag => {
      tag.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const fname = tag.getAttribute('data-file');
        openSlideover('code');
        if (fname && currentSessionFiles[fname]) {
          showCode(currentSessionFiles[fname], fname);
        }
      });
    });

    if (chatScroll) {
      chatScroll.appendChild(card);
      chatScroll.scrollTop = chatScroll.scrollHeight;
    }
  }

  // ── User Chat Bubble ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function appendUserChatBubble(text) {
    if (chatEmpty) chatEmpty.style.display = 'none';
    const b = document.createElement('div');
    b.className = 'chat-bubble-user';
    const now = new Date();
    const timeStr = now.toTimeString().slice(0, 5);
    b.innerHTML = `<div>${esc(text)}</div><div class="chat-bubble-meta">${timeStr}</div>`;
    if (chatScroll) {
      chatScroll.appendChild(b);
      chatScroll.scrollTop = chatScroll.scrollHeight;
    }
  }

  // ── Live Plan Widget & Checklist ───────────────────────────────────────────
  let currentPlanState = { sections: [], completed: [], current: '', max_turns: 0, turn_num: 0, auto_recovered: false };

  function updatePlanWidget(data) {
    if (!livePlanWidget || !planItems || !planBudget) return;
    livePlanWidget.style.display = 'flex';

    if (data.sections) currentPlanState.sections = data.sections;
    if (data.max_turns) currentPlanState.max_turns = data.max_turns;
    if (data.turn_num !== undefined) currentPlanState.turn_num = data.turn_num;
    if (data.completed_sections) currentPlanState.completed = data.completed_sections;
    if (data.current_section !== undefined) currentPlanState.current = data.current_section;
    if (data.auto_recovered !== undefined) currentPlanState.auto_recovered = data.auto_recovered;

    planBudget.textContent = `Turns: ${currentPlanState.turn_num} / ${currentPlanState.max_turns || '?'}`;

    planItems.innerHTML = '';
    (currentPlanState.sections || []).forEach(sec => {
      const item = document.createElement('span');
      const isCompleted = currentPlanState.completed.includes(sec);
      const isCurrent = currentPlanState.current === sec && !isCompleted;

      if (isCompleted) {
        item.className = 'plan-item status-completed';
        item.innerHTML = `<span>✓</span><span>${esc(sec)}</span>`;
      } else if (isCurrent) {
        if (currentPlanState.auto_recovered) {
          item.className = 'plan-item status-auto_recovered';
          item.innerHTML = `<span>⚠️</span><span>${esc(sec)} (auto-recovered)</span>`;
        } else {
          item.className = 'plan-item status-active';
          item.innerHTML = `<span>⏳</span><span>${esc(sec)}</span>`;
        }
      } else {
        item.className = 'plan-item status-pending';
        item.innerHTML = `<span>⏸</span><span>${esc(sec)}</span>`;
      }
      planItems.appendChild(item);
    });
  }

  // ── Multi-file Tabs Strip ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderFileTabs(files, activeFilename) {
    if (!fileTabsStrip) return;
    fileTabsStrip.innerHTML = '';
    const fileKeys = Object.keys(files || {});
    if (fileKeys.length <= 1) {
      fileTabsStrip.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }
    fileTabsStrip.style.display = 'flex';

    fileKeys.forEach(fname => {
      const chip = document.createElement('button');
      chip.type = 'button';
      chip.className = 'file-tab' + (fname === activeFilename ? ' active' : '');
      chip.textContent = fname;
      chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.file-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
        chip.classList.add('active');
        currentActiveFile = fname;
        showCode(files[fname], fname);
      });
      fileTabsStrip.appendChild(chip);
    });
  }

  // ── @Mention Pills for Chat Composer ───────────────────────────────────────
  function updateMentionPills(files) {
    if (!chatMentionPills) return;
    chatMentionPills.innerHTML = '';
    const fileNames = Object.keys(files || {});
    if (!fileNames.length) return;

    fileNames.forEach(f => {
      const pill = document.createElement('span');
      pill.className = 'mention-pill';
      pill.textContent = '@' + f;
      pill.title = 'Click to reference ' + f + ' in chat prompt';
      pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (!chatInput) return;
        const val = chatInput.value;
        const ref = '@' + f + ' ';
        chatInput.value = val ? (val.endsWith(' ') ? val + ref : val + ' ' + ref) : ref;
        chatInput.focus();
      });
      chatMentionPills.appendChild(pill);
    });
  }

  // ── Checkpoints & Diffs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function loadSessionCheckpoints(sessionId) {
    if (!sessionId) return;
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/sessions/' + sessionId);
      if (!r.ok) return;
      const data = await r.json();
      const session = data.session;
      if (!session || !session.history) return;

      if (diffCheckpointSelect) {
        diffCheckpointSelect.innerHTML = '';
        session.history.forEach((turn) => {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = turn.turn_num;
          const promptSnippet = (turn.instruction || 'Initial generation').slice(0, 32);
          opt.textContent = `Turn ${turn.turn_num} — ${promptSnippet}`;
          diffCheckpointSelect.appendChild(opt);
        });
        diffCheckpointSelect.value = session.current_turn;
        if (diffRevertBtn) {
          diffRevertBtn.disabled = session.history.length <= 1;
        }
      }

      if (session.history.length > 0) {
        const latestTurn = session.history[session.history.length - 1];
        renderDiff(latestTurn.diffs || {});
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load session checkpoints', err);
    }
  }

  function renderDiff(diffMap) {
    if (!diffScroll) return;
    diffScroll.innerHTML = '';
    const files = Object.keys(diffMap || {});
    if (!files.length) {
      diffScroll.innerHTML = '<div id="diff-empty" style="color:var(--text-3);font-size:12px;padding:20px;text-align:center;">No file differences recorded for this turn.</div>';
      return;
    }

    files.forEach(f => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'diff-file-card';
      card.innerHTML = `<div class="diff-file-header"><span>${esc(f)}</span><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-3);">Modified</span></div>`;
      const pre = document.createElement('pre');
      pre.className = 'diff-pre';

      const diffLines = (diffMap[f] || '').split('\n');
      diffLines.forEach(line => {
        const span = document.createElement('span');
        if (line.startsWith('+') && !line.startsWith('+++')) {
          span.className = 'diff-line-add';
        } else if (line.startsWith('-') && !line.startsWith('---')) {
          span.className = 'diff-line-del';
        } else if (line.startsWith('@@')) {
          span.className = 'diff-line-hdr';
        } else {
          span.className = 'diff-line-ctx';
        }
        span.textContent = line;
        pre.appendChild(span);
      });

      card.appendChild(pre);
      diffScroll.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  if (diffRevertBtn) {
    diffRevertBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!currentSessionId || !diffCheckpointSelect) return;
      const targetTurn = parseInt(diffCheckpointSelect.value, 10);
      if (!targetTurn) return;

      const ok = await showConfirmModal({
        title: 'Revert Workspace',
        message: `Revert workspace back to Turn ${targetTurn}? Any unsaved edits from later turns will be undone.`,
        confirmText: 'Revert Workspace',
        danger: true
      });
      if (!ok) return;

      try {
        const r = await fetch(`/api/sessions/${currentSessionId}/revert/${targetTurn}`, { method: 'POST' });
        const data = await r.json();
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Revert failed');

        showToast(`Reverted back to Turn ${targetTurn}!`, 'success');
        currentSessionFiles = data.files || {};
        const fileNames = Object.keys(currentSessionFiles);
        if (fileNames.length) {
          renderFileTabs(currentSessionFiles, fileNames[0]);
          showCode(currentSessionFiles[fileNames[0]], fileNames[0]);
        }
        if (previewFrame) previewFrame.src = '/preview/' + currentSessionId + '?t=' + Date.now();
        loadSessionCheckpoints(currentSessionId);
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Revert failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
      }
    });
  }

  if (diffCheckpointSelect) {
    diffCheckpointSelect.addEventListener('change', async () => {
      if (!currentSessionId) return;
      const turnVal = diffCheckpointSelect.value;
      try {
        const r = await fetch(`/api/sessions/${currentSessionId}/diff/${turnVal}`);
        if (r.ok) {
          const data = await r.json();
          renderDiff(data.diffs || {});
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    });
  }

  // ── Auto-Resize Chat Input ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function autoResizeChatInput() {
    if (!chatInput) return;
    chatInput.style.height = 'auto';
    const newHeight = Math.min(Math.max(chatInput.scrollHeight, 38), 160);
    chatInput.style.height = newHeight + 'px';
  }

  // ── Agentic Chat Follow-Up Sender ──────────────────────────────────────────
  async function sendChatFollowUp() {
    const text = (chatInput ? chatInput.value : '').trim();
    if (!text) {
      if (chatInput) chatInput.focus();
      return;
    }
    if (!currentSessionId) {
      showToast('No active session yet. Run an initial generation first.', 'warn');
      return;
    }
    if (generateBtn.classList.contains('generating')) {
      showToast('Generation already in progress.', 'warn');
      return;
    }

    appendUserChatBubble(text);
    chatInput.value = '';
    autoResizeChatInput();
    showChatThinking(true);

    _setGenerating(true);
    startProgress();
    appendLog(`[Chat Turn] Follow-up: "${text}"`);

    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          session_id: currentSessionId,
          prompt: text,
          max_turns: parseInt($('max-turns').value, 10),
        })
      });
      const d = await r.json();
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(d.error || 'Follow-up generation failed');
      currentTaskId = d.task_id;
      streamTask(d.task_id, currentSymbol || 'Component');
    } catch (err) {
      showChatThinking(false);
      finishProgress();
      _setGenerating(false);
      appendLog('[Error] ' + err.message);
      showToast(err.message, 'error');
    }
  }

  if (chatSendBtn) chatSendBtn.addEventListener('click', sendChatFollowUp);
  if (chatInput) {
    if (chatInput) chatInput.addEventListener('input', autoResizeChatInput);
    if (chatInput) chatInput.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        if (e.shiftKey) {
          // Shift+Enter inserts newline normally
          return;
        }
        // Plain Enter or Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter sends follow-up
        e.preventDefault();
        sendChatFollowUp();
      }
    });
  }

  // ── Preview Viewport Controls ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  document.querySelectorAll('.viewport-toggles .vp-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.viewport-toggles .vp-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      if (previewFrame) previewFrame.style.width = btn.dataset.vp || '100%';
    });
  });

  if (previewOpenExtBtn) {
    previewOpenExtBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (currentSessionId) {
        window.open('/preview/' + currentSessionId, '_blank');
      } else {
        showToast('No active session preview to open yet.', 'info');
      }
    });
  }

  // ── Visual Quality Badge ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function updateVisualBadge(score, issues = []) {
    const badge = $('visual-badge');
    if (!badge) return;
    if (score === null || score === undefined) {
      badge.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }
    const num = parseFloat(score);
    badge.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    badge.className = '';
    if (num >= 4) {
      badge.classList.add('high');
    } else if (num >= 3) {
      badge.classList.add('medium');
    } else {
      badge.classList.add('low');
    }
    badge.textContent = `Visual: ${num.toFixed(1)}/5`;
    if (issues && issues.length) {
      badge.title = 'Visual Quality Issues:\n• ' + issues.join('\n• ');
    } else {
      badge.title = `Visual quality score: ${num.toFixed(1)}/5 (passed heuristic check)`;
    }
  }

  // ── SSE Task Stream with Exponential Backoff & Fallback Polling ───────────
  function streamTask(taskId, symbol) {
    let retryCount = 0;
    const maxRetries = 5;
    let es = null;
    let closed = false;

    function cleanup() {
      closed = true;
      if (es) {
        es.close();
        es = null;
      }
      showChatThinking(false);
      _setGenerating(false);
    }

    async function pollFallback() {
      try {
        const r = await fetch(`/api/generation/${taskId}/status`);
        if (!r.ok) return false;
        const resData = data.result || data.data;
        if (data.status === 'completed' && resData) {
          handleTaskResult(resData, symbol);
          cleanup();
          return true;
        } else if (data.status === 'error') {
          appendLog('[Error] ' + (data.error || 'Generation failed'));
          showToast(data.error || 'Generation error.', 'error');
          finishProgress();
          cleanup();
          return true;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
      return false;
    }

    function handleTaskResult(res, sym) {
      _activeHistoryItem = res;
      currentSymbol = res.symbol || sym;
      if (res.session_id) currentSessionId = res.session_id;

      if (res.files && Object.keys(res.files).length > 0) {
        currentSessionFiles = res.files;
        const fKeys = Object.keys(res.files);
        currentActiveFile = fKeys[0];
        renderFileTabs(res.files, fKeys[0]);
        showCode(res.files[fKeys[0]], fKeys[0]);
        updateMentionPills(res.files);
      } else {
        showCode(res.code, currentSymbol + '.tsx');
      }

      if (res.summary) {
        appendAgentSummaryCard(res.summary, {
          files: Object.keys(res.files || {}),
          turn_num: res.turns_used,
          passed: res.final_passed
        });
      }

      if (res.visual_score !== undefined && res.visual_score !== null) {
        updateVisualBadge(res.visual_score, res.visual_issues || []);
      }

      if (currentSessionId && previewFrame) {
        previewFrame.src = '/preview/' + currentSessionId + '?t=' + Date.now();
      }

      if (currentSessionId) {
        loadSessionCheckpoints(currentSessionId);
      }

      resultBadge.className = res.final_passed ? 'pass' : 'fail';
      resultBadge.textContent = res.final_passed ? 'Tests passed' : 'Tests failed';
      turnBadge.textContent = res.turns_used + ' turn' + (res.turns_used !== 1 ? 's' : '');
      turnBadge.style.display = 'block';
      finishProgress();
      loadHistory();
      regenBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
      if (editPromptBtn) editPromptBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
      if (res.final_passed) {
        showToast('Completed successfully!', 'success');
      } else {
        showToast('Completed with issues.', 'warn');
      }
    }

    function connect() {
      if (closed) return;
      es = new EventSource('/api/stream/' + taskId);

      es.onopen = () => {
        retryCount = 0;
        statusText.textContent = 'Generating…';
        statusPill.className = 'status-badge active';
      };

      es.onmessage = e => {
        showChatThinking(false);
        const msg = JSON.parse(e.data);

        if (msg.type === 'log') {
          appendLog(msg.text || '');
        }
        if (msg.type === 'plan') {
          updatePlanWidget(msg);
          if (msg.session_id) currentSessionId = msg.session_id;
        }
        if (msg.type === 'plan_update') {
          updatePlanWidget(msg);
        }
        if (msg.type === 'summary') {
          appendAgentSummaryCard(msg.summary || '', {
            files: msg.files,
            turn_num: msg.turn_num,
            passed: msg.passed
          });
          setRightSubtab('chat');
        }
        if (msg.type === 'result') {
          handleTaskResult(msg.data, symbol);
        }
        if (msg.type === 'cancelled') {
          appendLog('[Cancelled] ' + (msg.text || 'Generation cancelled by user.'));
          showToast('Generation cancelled.', 'warn');
          finishProgress();
        }
        if (msg.type === 'done') {
          cleanup();
        }
        if (msg.type === 'error') {
          appendLog('[Error] ' + (msg.text || 'Unknown error'));
          showToast(msg.text || 'Generation error.', 'error');
          finishProgress();
          cleanup();
        }
      };

      es.onerror = async () => {
        if (closed) return;
        if (es) {
          es.close();
          es = null;
        }

        const resolved = await pollFallback();
        if (resolved) return;

        if (retryCount < maxRetries) {
          retryCount++;
          const delay = Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(2, retryCount - 1), 8000);
          statusText.textContent = `Reconnecting (${retryCount}/${maxRetries})…`;
          statusPill.className = 'status-badge busy';
          appendLog(`[Stream] Disconnected. Reconnecting in ${delay / 1000}s (attempt ${retryCount}/${maxRetries})…`);
          setTimeout(connect, delay);
        } else {
          const finalPoll = await pollFallback();
          if (!finalPoll) {
            appendLog('[Stream] Lost connection to generation stream after 5 attempts.');
            showToast('Lost connection to generation server.', 'error');
            finishProgress();
            cleanup();
          }
        }
      };
    }

    connect();
  }

  // ── Copy & Download Code Buttons ────────────────────────────────────────────
  copyBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (!currentCode) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentCode);
      copyBtn.textContent = 'Copied';
      copyBtn.classList.add('success');
      showToast('Code copied to clipboard!', 'info', 2000);
      setTimeout(() => {
        copyBtn.textContent = 'Copy';
        copyBtn.classList.remove('success');
      }, 1800);
    } catch (_) {
      showToast('Failed to copy to clipboard.', 'error');
    }
  });

  downloadBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!currentCode) return;
    const blob = new Blob([currentCode], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
    const url  = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a    = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = (currentSymbol || 'Component') + '.tsx';
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    showToast('Download started: ' + (currentSymbol || 'Component') + '.tsx', 'info', 2000);
  });

  // ── Fullscreen Code View ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function openFullscreen() {
    if (!currentCode) return;
    fullscreenFilename.textContent = (currentSymbol || 'Component') + '.tsx';
    const pre = document.createElement('pre');
    const code_el = document.createElement('code');
    code_el.className = 'language-typescript';
    code_el.textContent = currentCode;
    pre.appendChild(code_el);
    fullscreenCodeEl.innerHTML = '';
    fullscreenCodeEl.appendChild(pre);
    if (window.hljs) hljs.highlightElement(code_el);
    addLineNumbers(pre);
    fullscreenOverlay.classList.add('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }

  function closeFullscreen() {
    fullscreenOverlay.classList.remove('active');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  fullscreenBtn.addEventListener('click', openFullscreen);
  fullscreenClose.addEventListener('click', closeFullscreen);

  // ── Shortcuts Modal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function toggleShortcuts(show) {
    if (!shortcutsModal) return;
    if (show === undefined) {
      shortcutsModal.classList.toggle('active');
    } else if (show) {
      shortcutsModal.classList.add('active');
    } else {
      shortcutsModal.classList.remove('active');
    }
  }

  if (shortcutsBtn) shortcutsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => toggleShortcuts());
  if (shortcutsClose) shortcutsClose.addEventListener('click', () => toggleShortcuts(false));
  if (shortcutsModal) {
    shortcutsModal.addEventListener('click', e => {
      if (e.target === shortcutsModal) toggleShortcuts(false);
    });
  }

  // ── Keyboard Shortcuts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (fullscreenOverlay && fullscreenOverlay.classList.contains('active')) closeFullscreen();
      if (shortcutsModal && shortcutsModal.classList.contains('active')) toggleShortcuts(false);
    }
    const active = document.activeElement;
    const isEditing = active && (
      active.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
      active.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
      active.tagName === 'SELECT' ||
      active.isContentEditable ||
      (active.closest && active.closest('#xterm-container') !== null)
    );
    if (isEditing) return;

    // View switching shortcuts with Alt
    if (e.altKey && e.key === '1') { setView('split'); }
    else if (e.altKey && e.key === '2') { setView('code'); }
    else if (e.altKey && e.key === '3') { setView('term'); setRightSubtab('term'); }
    else if (e.altKey && e.key === '4') { setView('shell'); setRightSubtab('shell'); }
    else if (e.altKey && (e.key === 'e' || e.key === 'E')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (_activeHistoryItem) loadItemForEditing(_activeHistoryItem);
    }
    else if (e.altKey && (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (_activeHistoryItem) regenerateItem(_activeHistoryItem);
    }
    else if (e.altKey && (e.key === 'f' || e.key === 'F')) {
      if (currentCode) openFullscreen();
    }
    else if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && (e.key === '/' || e.key === '?')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleShortcuts();
    }
  });

  // ── Prompt Templates ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  templatesToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = templateChips.classList.toggle('open');
    templatesToggle.classList.toggle('open', open);
  });

  // ── Design System & Style Tokens ──────────────────────────────────────────
  if (styleSystemToggle && styleSystemBody) {
    styleSystemToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const open = styleSystemBody.classList.toggle('open');
      styleSystemToggle.classList.toggle('open', open);
    });
  }

  const REFERO_MONOPO_TOKENS = `:root {
  /* Colors */
  --color-obsidian: #000000;
  --color-paper: #ffffff;
  --color-inkstone: #181818;
  --color-felt-gray: #6d6d6d;
  --color-slate-pill: #636363;
  --color-ash-mist: #9a9a9a;
  --color-pewter: #808080;
  --color-iridescent-fade: #a02d25;
  --gradient-iridescent-fade: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(160, 224, 171), rgb(255, 172, 46) 50%, rgb(165, 45, 37));

  /* Typography — Font Families */
  --font-roobert: 'Roobert', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  --font-raleway: 'Raleway', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  --font-heading: 'Raleway', sans-serif;
  --font-body: 'Roobert', sans-serif;

  /* Typography — Scale */
  --text-caption: 12px;
  --text-body: 18px;
  --text-subheading: 39px;
  --text-heading: 78px;
  --text-display: 120px;

  /* Spacing */
  --spacing-8: 8px;
  --spacing-12: 12px;
  --spacing-28: 28px;
  --spacing-48: 48px;
  --spacing-68: 68px;

  /* Layout */
  --page-max-width: 1078px;
  --section-gap: 46px;
  --card-padding: 34px;

  /* Named Radii */
  --radius-tags: 75px;
  --radius-cards: 0px;
  --radius-images: 0px;
  --radius-inputs: 0px;
  --radius-buttons: 75px;

  /* Surfaces */
  --surface-paper: #ffffff;
  --surface-obsidian: #000000;
  --surface-slate-pill: #636363;
  --surface-ash-mist: #9a9a9a;
}`;

  if (pasteReferoBtn && styleTokensInput) {
    pasteReferoBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      styleTokensInput.value = REFERO_MONOPO_TOKENS;
      if (stylePresetSelect) stylePresetSelect.value = 'refero_editorial';
      if (styleSystemBody && !styleSystemBody.classList.contains('open')) {
        styleSystemBody.classList.add('open');
        if (styleSystemToggle) styleSystemToggle.classList.add('open');
      }
      showToast('Monopo Saigon tokens loaded!', 'success');
    });
  }

  if (clearTokensBtn && styleTokensInput) {
    clearTokensBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      styleTokensInput.value = '';
      if (stylePresetSelect) stylePresetSelect.value = '';
      showToast('Design tokens cleared', 'info');
    });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.tpl-chip').forEach(chip => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
      promptInput.value = chip.dataset.prompt;
      symbolInput.value = chip.dataset.symbol;
      if (chip.dataset.preset && stylePresetSelect) {
        stylePresetSelect.value = chip.dataset.preset;
        if (styleSystemBody && !styleSystemBody.classList.contains('open')) {
          styleSystemBody.classList.add('open');
          if (styleSystemToggle) styleSystemToggle.classList.add('open');
        }
      }
      if (chip.dataset.turns && $('max-turns')) $('max-turns').value = chip.dataset.turns;
      if (chip.dataset.tokens && $('max-tokens')) $('max-tokens').value = chip.dataset.tokens;
      promptInput.style.height = 'auto';
      promptInput.style.height = Math.min(promptInput.scrollHeight, 200) + 'px';
      updateCharCounter();
      templateChips.classList.remove('open');
      templatesToggle.classList.remove('open');
      promptInput.focus();
    });
  });

  // ── Auto-Resize & Char Counter ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  function autoResizePrompt() {
    if (!promptInput) return;
    promptInput.style.height = 'auto';
    const newHeight = Math.min(Math.max(promptInput.scrollHeight, 86), 260);
    promptInput.style.height = newHeight + 'px';
  }

  function updateCharCounter() {
    const len = promptInput.value.length;
    charCounter.textContent = len + ' chars';
    charCounter.className = len > 5000 ? 'over' : len > 3000 ? 'warn' : '';
  }
  promptInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
    autoResizePrompt();
    updateCharCounter();
  });

  function highlightPromptInput() {
    const wrap = $('prompt-wrap');
    if (wrap) {
      wrap.classList.remove('prompt-highlight');
      void wrap.offsetWidth; // force CSS reflow to re-trigger keyframe animation
      wrap.classList.add('prompt-highlight');
      setTimeout(() => wrap.classList.remove('prompt-highlight'), 1400);
    }
  }

  function loadItemForEditing(item, options = {}) {
    if (!item) return;
    promptInput.value = item.prompt || '';
    if (item.symbol) {
      symbolInput.value = item.symbol;
    }
    if (item.test_code && testInput) {
      testInput.value = item.test_code;
      if (testArea && !testArea.classList.contains('open')) {
        testArea.classList.add('open');
        if (testToggle) testToggle.classList.add('active');
      }
    }
    if (item.style_preset && stylePresetSelect) {
      stylePresetSelect.value = item.style_preset;
    }
    if (item.style_tokens && styleTokensInput) {
      styleTokensInput.value = typeof item.style_tokens === 'string'
        ? item.style_tokens
        : JSON.stringify(item.style_tokens, null, 2);
      if (styleSystemBody && !styleSystemBody.classList.contains('open')) {
        styleSystemBody.classList.add('open');
        if (styleSystemToggle) {
          const arrow = styleSystemToggle.querySelector('.arrow');
          if (arrow) arrow.textContent = '▼';
        }
      }
    }
    if (item.turns_used && $('max-turns')) {
      const turnsSelect = $('max-turns');
      for (let opt of turnsSelect.options) {
        if (parseInt(opt.value, 10) >= item.turns_used) {
          turnsSelect.value = opt.value;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    autoResizePrompt();
    updateCharCounter();

    if (!options.silent) {
      highlightPromptInput();
      promptInput.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      promptInput.focus();
      const len = promptInput.value.length;
      promptInput.setSelectionRange(len, len);
      showToast('Prompt loaded into editor. Make changes and click Generate.', 'info', 3000);
    }
  }

  function regenerateItem(item) {
    if (!item) return;
    if (generateBtn.disabled || generateBtn.classList.contains('generating')) {
      showToast('Generation already in progress.', 'warn', 3000);
      return;
    }
    loadItemForEditing(item, { silent: true });
    showToast('Regenerating "' + (item.symbol || 'Component') + '"...', 'info', 2000);
    generateBtn.click();
  }

  function selectHistoryItem(item, div) {
    _activeHistoryItem = item;
    currentCode   = item.code || '';
    currentSymbol = item.symbol || 'Component';
    currentTaskId = item.task_id;
    if (item.session_id) currentSessionId = item.session_id;

    if (item.files && Object.keys(item.files).length > 0) {
      currentSessionFiles = item.files;
      const fKeys = Object.keys(item.files);
      currentActiveFile = fKeys[0];
      renderFileTabs(item.files, fKeys[0]);
      showCode(item.files[fKeys[0]], fKeys[0]);
      updateMentionPills(item.files);
    } else {
      if (fileTabsStrip) fileTabsStrip.style.display = 'none';
      showCode(item.code, (item.symbol || 'Component') + '.tsx');
    }

    if (item.visual_score !== undefined && item.visual_score !== null) {
      updateVisualBadge(item.visual_score, item.visual_issues || []);
    } else {
      updateVisualBadge(null);
    }

    if (currentSessionId && previewFrame) {
      previewFrame.src = '/preview/' + currentSessionId + '?t=' + Date.now();
    }
    if (currentSessionId) {
      loadSessionCheckpoints(currentSessionId);
    }

    resultBadge.className = item.final_passed ? 'pass' : 'fail';
    resultBadge.textContent = item.final_passed ? 'Tests passed' : 'Tests failed';
    turnBadge.textContent = (item.turns_used || '?') + ' turns';
    turnBadge.style.display = 'block';

    if (!generateBtn.classList.contains('generating')) {
      regenBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
      if (editPromptBtn) editPromptBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.history-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
    if (div) div.classList.add('active');
    setView('split');
  }

  // ── History & Search & Deletion ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  let _allHistoryItems = [];

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
  }

  async function loadHistory() {
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/history');
      const items = await r.json();
      _allHistoryItems = items || [];
      filterHistory();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  function filterHistory() {
    const q = (historySearch ? historySearch.value : '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) {
      renderHistory(_allHistoryItems);
    } else {
      renderHistory(_allHistoryItems.filter(item =>
        (item.symbol || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (item.prompt || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      ));
    }
  }

  if (historySearch) {
    historySearch.addEventListener('input', filterHistory);
  }

  if (historyClearBtn) {
    historyClearBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!_allHistoryItems.length) return;
      const ok = await showConfirmModal({
        title: 'Clear History',
        message: 'Clear all generation history? This action cannot be undone.',
        confirmText: 'Clear History',
        danger: true
      });
      if (!ok) return;
      try {
        await fetch('/api/history', { method: 'DELETE' });
        _allHistoryItems = [];
        renderHistory([]);
        showToast('History cleared.', 'info', 2000);
      } catch (_) {
        showToast('Failed to clear history.', 'error');
      }
    });
  }

  function renderHistory(items) {
    historyList.innerHTML = '';
    if (!items || items.length === 0) {
      historyList.innerHTML = '<div class="history-empty" id="history-empty-state"><div class="history-empty-title">No generations found</div><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3);line-height:1.5;margin-top:4px">Describe a React component or hook below and click Generate.</div></div>';
      return;
    }
    items.forEach(item => {
      let visualBadgeHtml = '';
      if (item.visual_score !== undefined && item.visual_score !== null) {
        const vs = parseFloat(item.visual_score);
        const vsClass = vs >= 4 ? 'high' : (vs >= 3 ? 'medium' : 'low');
        const vsTitle = item.visual_issues && item.visual_issues.length
          ? esc('Visual Issues:\n• ' + item.visual_issues.join('\n• '))
          : ('Visual Quality: ' + vs.toFixed(1) + '/5');
        visualBadgeHtml = `<span class="hi-visual-score ${vsClass}" title="${vsTitle}">★ ${vs.toFixed(1)}</span>`;
      }

      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'history-item' + (item.task_id === currentTaskId ? ' active' : '');
      div.innerHTML =
        '<div class="hi-top">' +
          '<span class="hi-name">' + esc(item.symbol || 'Component') + '</span>' +
          visualBadgeHtml +
          '<span class="hi-badge ' + (item.final_passed ? 'pass' : 'fail') + '">' + (item.final_passed ? 'Pass' : 'Fail') + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="hi-prompt">' + esc(item.prompt || '') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="hi-meta">' +
          '<span class="hi-date">' + esc(item.timestamp || '') + '</span>' +
          '<span class="hi-turns">' + (item.turns_used || '?') + ' turns</span>' +
          '<div class="hi-actions">' +
            '<button class="hi-btn hi-edit" data-tid="' + esc(item.task_id) + '" type="button" aria-label="Load prompt into editor to modify" title="Load prompt into editor to modify">✏️ Edit</button>' +
            '<button class="hi-btn hi-regen" data-tid="' + esc(item.task_id) + '" type="button" aria-label="Regenerate this prompt" title="Regenerate this prompt">↺ Rerun</button>' +
            (item.code ? '<button class="hi-btn hi-dl" data-tid="' + esc(item.task_id) + '" data-sym="' + esc(item.symbol || 'Component') + '" type="button" aria-label="Download ' + esc(item.symbol || 'Component') + '.tsx" title="Download .tsx">DL</button>' : '') +
            '<button class="hi-btn hi-del" data-tid="' + esc(item.task_id) + '" type="button" aria-label="Delete ' + esc(item.symbol || 'Component') + ' from history" title="Delete from history">&times;</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';

      div.addEventListener('click', async e => {
        if (e.target.classList.contains('hi-edit')) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          loadItemForEditing(item);
          return;
        }
        if (e.target.classList.contains('hi-regen')) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          regenerateItem(item);
          return;
        }
        if (e.target.classList.contains('hi-dl')) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          downloadItem(e.target.dataset.tid, e.target.dataset.sym);
          return;
        }
        if (e.target.classList.contains('hi-del')) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          const tid = e.target.dataset.tid;
          try {
            await fetch('/api/history/' + tid, { method: 'DELETE' });
            _allHistoryItems = _allHistoryItems.filter(h => h.task_id !== tid);
            if (_activeHistoryItem && _activeHistoryItem.task_id === tid) {
              _activeHistoryItem = null;
              if (editPromptBtn) editPromptBtn.style.display = 'none';
              if (regenBtn) regenBtn.style.display = 'none';
            }
            filterHistory();
            showToast('Item deleted from history.', 'info', 1500);
          } catch (_) {
            showToast('Could not delete item.', 'error');
          }
          return;
        }
        selectHistoryItem(item, div);
      });
      historyList.appendChild(div);
    });
  }

  async function downloadItem(taskId, symbol) {
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/download/' + taskId);
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error();
      const blob = await r.blob();
      const url  = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a    = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = (symbol || 'Component') + '.tsx';
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      showToast('Download started.', 'info', 2000);
    } catch (_) {
      showToast('Download failed.', 'error');
    }
  }

  // ── Mobile Navigation Controls (screens <= 640px) ──────────────────────────
  document.querySelectorAll('#mobile-nav .mob-nav-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('#mobile-nav .mob-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      btn.classList.add('active');
      const v = btn.dataset.view;
      if (v === 'chat') {
        setView('term');
        setRightSubtab('chat');
      } else if (v === 'code') {
        setView('code');
      } else if (v === 'term') {
        setView('term');
        setRightSubtab('term');
      } else if (v === 'preview') {
        setView('term');
        setRightSubtab('preview');
      }
    });
  });

  // ── Initial load & Restore Preferences ─────────────────────────────────────
  const savedView = loadPref('view_mode', null);
  if (savedView) setView(savedView);

### 3.5 Fine-Tuning & Evaluation Benchmark Pipeline

#### `train.py`

- **Path**: `file:///c:/Users/AYUSH/Documents/slm/train.py`
- **Lines**: 265 | **Size**: 10,928 bytes
- **Description**: Unsloth QLoRA 4-bit fine-tuning pipeline with PEFT configuration, target projections, and gradient checkpointing.

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
train.py - Fine-Tune Qwen2.5-Coder-3B into an Agentic SLM with QLoRA
Tuned for: RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (6GB VRAM), 24GB DDR5 RAM.

The trainer only accepts the leak-free XML-agent corpus generated by
build_expanded_dataset.py. It withholds part of that corpus for checkpoint
selection, rather than selecting a model against the benchmark.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys

if os.path.exists("./base-model"):
    os.environ.setdefault("HF_HUB_OFFLINE", "1")
    os.environ.setdefault("TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE", "1")
os.environ.setdefault("PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF", "expandable_segments:True")

import torch
from datasets import load_dataset
from agent_protocol import format_chatml, DEFAULT_MAX_SEQ_LENGTH


def check_benchmark_disjointness(training_file: str, eval_file: str = "react_ts_css_eval_set_combined.jsonl"):
    """
    Enforces absolute disjointness between the training dataset and the benchmark evaluation set.
    Raises RuntimeError if any prompt or target symbol overlap is detected.
    """
    if not os.path.exists(eval_file):
        print(f"[Disjointness] Note: Benchmark eval set {eval_file} not found; skipping disjointness check.")
        return

    eval_prompts = set()
    with open(eval_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                item = json.loads(line)
                p = item.get("prompt", "").strip().lower()
                if p:
                    eval_prompts.add(p[:60])
            except Exception:
                pass

    leak_count = 0
    with open(training_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f, 1):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                rec = json.loads(line)
                for m in rec.get("messages", []):
                    if m.get("role") == "user":
                        u = m.get("content", "").strip().lower()
                        if u[:60] in eval_prompts:
                            print(f"[Disjointness Failure] Line {i}: Prompt matches held-out eval set item: {u[:50]}...")
                            leak_count += 1
            except Exception:
                pass

    if leak_count > 0:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Pre-flight data integrity check FAILED: {leak_count} training examples collide with held-out eval set!"
        )
    print(f"[Disjointness Verified] 0 leaks detected between {training_file} and {eval_file}.")


def train(
    dataset_path: str = None,
    epochs: int = 3,
    rank: int = 16,
    lora_alpha: int = None,
    learning_rate: float = 1e-4,
    lora_dropout: float = 0.0,
    validation_split: float = 0.0,
    min_trajectories: int = 10,
    max_seq_length: int = DEFAULT_MAX_SEQ_LENGTH,
    neftune_noise_alpha: float = 0.0,
):
    print("=" * 75)
    print("         TRAINING AGENTIC SLM (Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct)          ")
    print("         Target Hardware: RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (6GB VRAM)           ")
    print("=" * 75)

    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
        print("Error: CUDA GPU not detected. Training requires an NVIDIA GPU.")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Detected GPU: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}")
    print(f"Allocated VRAM: {torch.cuda.memory_allocated(0)/(1024**2):.1f} MB")

    if dataset_path:
        trajectory_file = dataset_path
    elif os.path.exists("training_data.jsonl"):
        trajectory_file = "training_data.jsonl"
    elif os.path.exists("train_trajectories_agentic.jsonl"):
        trajectory_file = "train_trajectories_agentic.jsonl"
    else:
        trajectory_file = ""

    if not os.path.exists(trajectory_file):
        print(f"Error: {trajectory_file} not found.")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"\n1. Validating dataset integrity & disjointness...")
    check_benchmark_disjointness(trajectory_file)

    print(f"\n2. Loading leak-free multi-turn dataset: {trajectory_file}...")
    raw_dataset = load_dataset("json", data_files=trajectory_file, split="train")
    print(f"Loaded {len(raw_dataset)} training trajectories.")
    if len(raw_dataset) < min_trajectories:
        print(
            f"Error: only {len(raw_dataset)} leak-free trajectories are available; "
            f"need at least {min_trajectories}. Generate more verified STaR rollouts first."
        )
        sys.exit(1)

    from unsloth import FastLanguageModel
    from trl import SFTTrainer, SFTConfig

    model_name = "./base-model" if os.path.exists("./base-model") else "unsloth/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct"

    print(f"\n2. Loading 4-bit base model from: {model_name} (max_seq_length={max_seq_length})...")
    model, tokenizer = FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained(
        model_name=model_name,
        max_seq_length=max_seq_length,
        load_in_4bit=True,
    )

    actual_alpha = lora_alpha if lora_alpha is not None else rank
    print(f"\n3. Attaching LoRA adapters (rank={rank}, alpha={actual_alpha}, dropout={lora_dropout})...")
    model = FastLanguageModel.get_peft_model(
        model,
        r=rank,
        target_modules=[
            "q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj", "o_proj",
            "gate_proj", "up_proj", "down_proj"
        ],
        lora_alpha=actual_alpha,
        lora_dropout=lora_dropout,
        bias="none",
        use_gradient_checkpointing="unsloth",
        random_state=42,
    )

    # Serialize with the identical ChatML formatter used at inference time.
    def format_chatml_trajectory(example):
        text = format_chatml(example["messages"], add_generation_prompt=False) + tokenizer.eos_token
        return {"text": text}

    dataset = raw_dataset.map(format_chatml_trajectory)

    def is_within_context(example):
        return len(tokenizer(example["text"], add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"]) <= max_seq_length

    before_length_filter = len(dataset)
    dataset = dataset.filter(is_within_context)
    dropped = before_length_filter - len(dataset)
    if dropped:
        print(f"Dropped {dropped} trajectories that would truncate past {max_seq_length} tokens.")
    if len(dataset) < min_trajectories:
        print("Error: too few trajectories remain after length validation.")
        sys.exit(1)

    has_eval = (validation_split > 0.0 and len(dataset) >= 20)
    if has_eval:
        splits = dataset.train_test_split(test_size=validation_split, seed=42)
        train_dataset = splits["train"]
        eval_dataset = splits["test"]
        print(f"Train/validation split: {len(train_dataset)}/{len(eval_dataset)} trajectories.")
    else:
        train_dataset = dataset
        eval_dataset = None
        print(f"Training on all {len(train_dataset)} trajectories (evaluation disabled for small dataset).")

    print("\n4. Configuring SFTTrainer...")
    output_dir = "agent_lora_output"
    sft_kwargs = dict(
        output_dir=output_dir,
        per_device_train_batch_size=1,        # 1 sample per step fits 6GB VRAM
        gradient_accumulation_steps=4,
        warmup_ratio=0.05,
        num_train_epochs=epochs,
        learning_rate=learning_rate,
        fp16=not torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(),
        bf16=torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(),
        logging_steps=1,
        optim="adamw_8bit",                    # 8-bit optimizer saves 1.5GB VRAM
        weight_decay=0.01,
        lr_scheduler_type="cosine",
        eval_strategy="epoch" if has_eval else "no",
        eval_accumulation_steps=1,             # Chunks eval logits to prevent 5.6GB FP32 OOM on 152k vocab
        save_strategy="epoch",
        save_total_limit=2,
        load_best_model_at_end=has_eval,
        metric_for_best_model="eval_loss" if has_eval else None,
        greater_is_better=False,
        prediction_loss_only=True,
        report_to="none",
        seed=42,
    )
    if neftune_noise_alpha > 0:
        sft_kwargs["neftune_noise_alpha"] = neftune_noise_alpha
    sft_config = SFTConfig(**sft_kwargs)

    from unsloth.chat_templates import train_on_responses_only

    trainer = SFTTrainer(
        model=model,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=eval_dataset,
        dataset_text_field="text",
        max_seq_length=max_seq_length,
        args=sft_config,
    )

    print("\n5. Applying Response-Only Loss Masking (ignoring system prompt, user prompt, & observations)...")
    trainer = train_on_responses_only(
        trainer,
        instruction_part="<|im_start|>user\n",
        response_part="<|im_start|>assistant\n",
    )

    print("\n6. Starting Agentic LoRA Training...")
    trainer.train()

    save_path = "my-react-agent-lora"
    print("\n7. Training complete! Saving LoRA adapter to '{save_path}'...")
    model.save_pretrained(save_path)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(save_path)
    print(f"Saved successfully to: {os.path.abspath(save_path)}")
    print("\nNext step: Merge LoRA or run eval with: python agent.py --model my-react-agent-lora")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Fine-tune Qwen2.5-Coder-3B into an Agentic SLM")
    parser.add_argument("--dataset", type=str, default=None, help="Leak-free XML-agent dataset JSONL.")
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=3, help="Number of training epochs (default: 3).")
    parser.add_argument("--rank", type=int, default=16, choices=[8, 16, 32, 64], help="LoRA rank for the sweep (default: 16).")
    parser.add_argument("--lora-alpha", type=int, default=None, help="LoRA alpha (default: matches rank).")
    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=1e-4, help="LoRA learning rate (default: 1e-4).")
    parser.add_argument("--lora-dropout", type=float, default=0.0, help="LoRA dropout (default: 0.0 for Unsloth fast patching).")
    parser.add_argument("--validation-split", type=float, default=0.0, help="Held-out trajectory split for checkpoint selection (default: 0.0 to prevent 15GB FP32 logits OOM during eval on 6GB VRAM).")
    parser.add_argument("--min-trajectories", type=int, default=10, help="Minimum trajectories required.")
    parser.add_argument("--max-seq-length", type=int, default=DEFAULT_MAX_SEQ_LENGTH, help=f"Maximum sequence length for multi-turn trajectories (default: {DEFAULT_MAX_SEQ_LENGTH}).")
    parser.add_argument("--neftune-noise-alpha", type=float, default=0.0, help="Disabled by default to preserve protocol-token fidelity.")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    train(
        dataset_path=args.dataset,
        epochs=args.epochs,
        rank=args.rank,
        lora_alpha=args.lora_alpha,
        learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
        lora_dropout=args.lora_dropout,
        validation_split=args.validation_split,
        min_trajectories=args.min_trajectories,
        max_seq_length=args.max_seq_length,
        neftune_noise_alpha=args.neftune_noise_alpha,
    )

#### `train_dpo.py`

- **Path**: `file:///c:/Users/AYUSH/Documents/slm/train_dpo.py`
- **Lines**: 192 | **Size**: 7,270 bytes
- **Description**: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) training pipeline using TRL DPOTrainer and Unsloth memory-efficient patching, with sequence length parity (`DEFAULT_MAX_SEQ_LENGTH = 9216`) ensuring multi-section site preferences are fully trained without length truncation.

```python
"""
train_dpo.py — Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for ReactAgent SLM
Fine-tunes my-react-agent-lora using verified self-correction preference pairs
(e.g., dpo_pairs_verified.jsonl) to boost 1-shot pass rate from ~51% to 60%+.

Usage:
    python train_dpo.py --dataset dpo_pairs_verified.jsonl --epochs 1 --beta 0.1
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

from agent_protocol import AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, format_chatml, DEFAULT_MAX_SEQ_LENGTH


def wrap_completion(code_or_xml: str) -> str:
    """Ensures response is wrapped in standard XML tool_call format if bare code."""
    if "<tool_call" in code_or_xml:
        return code_or_xml.strip()
    return (
        f"<thought>\nImplementing component according to specification.\n</thought>\n"
        f'<tool_call name="write_component">\n'
        f"<tsx>\n{code_or_xml.strip()}\n</tsx>\n"
        f"</tool_call>"
    )


def load_dpo_dataset(dataset_path: str, tokenizer):
    """Loads and formats verified preference pairs into DPO format: prompt, chosen, rejected."""
    from datasets import Dataset

    if not os.path.exists(dataset_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"DPO dataset not found: {dataset_path}")

    raw_items = []
    with open(dataset_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if line:
                try:
                    raw_items.append(json.loads(line))
                except Exception:
                    continue

    if not raw_items:
        raise ValueError(f"No valid DPO items loaded from {dataset_path}")

    formatted_data: Dict[str, List[str]] = {
        "prompt": [],
        "chosen": [],
        "rejected": [],
    }

    for item in raw_items:
        user_prompt = item.get("prompt", "")
        chosen_code = item.get("chosen", "")
        rejected_code = item.get("rejected", "")

        if not user_prompt or not chosen_code or not rejected_code:
            continue

        # Format conversation prompt up to assistant generation prefix
        messages = [
            {"role": "system", "content": AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
            {"role": "user", "content": f"Write a React component in TypeScript with CSS Modules for: {user_prompt}"},
        ]
        prompt_text = format_chatml(messages, add_generation_prompt=True)

        chosen_text = wrap_completion(chosen_code) + tokenizer.eos_token
        rejected_text = wrap_completion(rejected_code) + tokenizer.eos_token

        formatted_data["prompt"].append(prompt_text)
        formatted_data["chosen"].append(chosen_text)
        formatted_data["rejected"].append(rejected_text)

    print(f"Loaded {len(formatted_data['prompt'])} verified DPO training pairs from {dataset_path}.")
    return Dataset.from_dict(formatted_data)


def train_dpo(
    dataset_path: str = "dpo_pairs_verified.jsonl",
    model_path: str = "my-react-agent-lora",
    output_dir: str = "my-react-agent-lora-dpo",
    epochs: int = 1,
    beta: float = 0.1,
    learning_rate: float = 5e-5,
    max_seq_length: int = DEFAULT_MAX_SEQ_LENGTH,
    batch_size: int = 1,
    gradient_accumulation_steps: int = 4,
):
    print("=" * 75)
    print("       DPO PREFERENCE ALIGNMENT TRAINING (ReactAgent SLM)           ")
    print("=" * 75)

    import torch

    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
        print("Error: CUDA GPU not detected. DPO training requires an NVIDIA GPU.")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Detected GPU: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}")
    print(f"Allocated VRAM: {torch.cuda.memory_allocated(0)/(1024**2):.1f} MB")

    from unsloth import FastLanguageModel, PatchDPOTrainer
    from trl import DPOTrainer, DPOConfig

    # Enable Unsloth memory-efficient DPO patching
    try:
        PatchDPOTrainer()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Note]: PatchDPOTrainer note: {e}")

    print(f"\n1. Loading model from {model_path} (max_seq_length={max_seq_length})...")
    model, tokenizer = FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained(
        model_name=model_path,
        max_seq_length=max_seq_length,
        load_in_4bit=True,
    )

    print("\n2. Loading and preparing DPO pairs...")
    dpo_dataset = load_dpo_dataset(dataset_path, tokenizer)
    if len(dpo_dataset) < 2:
        print("Error: insufficient DPO pairs for training (need at least 2).")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"\n3. Configuring DPO Trainer (epochs={epochs}, beta={beta}, lr={learning_rate})...")
    dpo_config = DPOConfig(
        output_dir=output_dir,
        num_train_epochs=epochs,
        per_device_train_batch_size=batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=gradient_accumulation_steps,
        learning_rate=learning_rate,
        beta=beta,
        fp16=not torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(),
        bf16=torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(),
        logging_steps=1,
        save_strategy="no",
        optim="adamw_8bit",
        seed=42,
    )

    trainer = DPOTrainer(
        model=model,
        ref_model=None,  # Implicit reference model supported by PEFT LoRA
        args=dpo_config,
        beta=beta,
        train_dataset=dpo_dataset,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
        max_length=max_seq_length,
        max_prompt_length=max_seq_length // 2,
    )

    print("\n4. Starting DPO Training...")
    trainer.train()

    print(f"\n5. DPO Training Complete! Saving aligned adapter to: {output_dir}...")
    model.save_pretrained(output_dir)
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(output_dir)
    print(f"Saved successfully to: {os.path.abspath(output_dir)}")
    print("\nNext step: evaluate aligned model with:")
    print(f"python evaluate.py --model {output_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run DPO Alignment on ReactAgent SLM")
    parser.add_argument("--dataset", type=str, default="dpo_pairs_verified.jsonl", help="Path to verified DPO pairs JSONL.")
    parser.add_argument("--model-path", type=str, default="my-react-agent-lora", help="Path to base LoRA adapter.")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=str, default="my-react-agent-lora-dpo", help="Output directory for aligned LoRA.")
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=1, help="Number of training epochs (default: 1).")
    parser.add_argument("--beta", type=float, default=0.1, help="DPO beta parameter (default: 0.1).")
    parser.add_argument("--learning-rate", type=float, default=5e-5, help="Learning rate (default: 5e-5).")
    parser.add_argument("--max-seq-length", type=int, default=DEFAULT_MAX_SEQ_LENGTH, help=f"Max sequence length (default: {DEFAULT_MAX_SEQ_LENGTH}).")
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=1, help="Batch size per device (default: 1).")
    parser.add_argument("--grad-accum", type=int, default=4, help="Gradient accumulation steps (default: 4).")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    train_dpo(
        dataset_path=args.dataset,
        model_path=args.model_path,
        output_dir=args.output_dir,
        epochs=args.epochs,
        beta=args.beta,
        learning_rate=args.learning_rate,
        max_seq_length=args.max_seq_length,
        batch_size=args.batch_size,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=args.grad_accum,
    )

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
evaluate.py - High-Performance Vitest + jsdom + RTL Evaluation Driver
for React + TypeScript + CSS SLMs (Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct / fine-tuned LoRA).

Features:
- Enforces exact named export matching in prompt instructions to eliminate import-mismatch false negatives.
- Auto-binds named exports + default export fallback in generated test files.
- Splits TSX component code and CSS modules into separate files.
- Evaluates across all 4 check variants:
    * tsc_only
    * tsc_and_render
    * tsc_render_a11y
    * tsc_render_interact
- Supports both fast Batch Mode (runs entire suite in 10-15s) and Sequential Mode.
- Stratified subsampling (--subset N) for rapid Step 9 retraining feedback loops.
- Mock mode (--mock) for instant pipeline and harness testing without GPU inference.
- Saves detailed results to JSON for error taxonomy and Step 9 failure analysis.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple


# Built-in RTL and testing utilities that should not be treated as component exports
STANDARD_TEST_IDENTIFIERS = {
    "it", "test", "describe", "expect", "render", "screen", "fireEvent",
