def extract_expected_symbols(prompt: str, test_code: str) -> Tuple[List[str], Optional[str]]:
    """
    Extract expected exported symbols (components, hooks, functions) from prompt and test_code.
    Returns (all_detected_symbols, primary_symbol).
    """
    # Identify local declarations inside test_code to avoid collision with imported bindings
    declared_in_test = set(re.findall(r'\b(?:function|class|const|let|var)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)', test_code))
    # Also capture destructured bindings: const [a, b] = ... or const { c, d } = ...
    for m in re.finditer(r'\b(?:const|let|var)\s*(?:\[([^\]]+)\]|\{([^}]+)\})', test_code):
        group_text = m.group(1) or m.group(2) or ""
        for var in re.findall(r'\b([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\b', group_text):
            declared_in_test.add(var)

    # 1. JSX tags <PascalCase
    jsx_tags = (
        set(re.findall(r'<([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)', test_code))
        - declared_in_test
        - STANDARD_TEST_IDENTIFIERS
    )
    # 2. Hooks: use[A-Z]... (excluding object methods like vi.useFakeTimers)
    hooks = set(re.findall(r'(?<!\.)\b(use[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\b', test_code)) - declared_in_test - STANDARD_TEST_IDENTIFIERS
    # 3. Functions called directly: fnName(...)
    raw_calls = set(re.findall(r'(?<!\.)\b([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*\(', test_code))
    target_calls = {c for c in raw_calls if c not in STANDARD_TEST_IDENTIFIERS and not c.startswith("on")} - declared_in_test

    # 4. Backticks in prompt (e.g., `Tooltip`, `useInterval(callback: () => void, ...)` )
    backticks = re.findall(r'`([^`]+)`', prompt)
    prompt_symbols_ordered: List[str] = []
    for bt in backticks:
        # Split on opening parenthesis or generic bracket to handle nested callback signatures
        clean = bt.split('(')[0].split('<')[0].split(':')[0].split('.')[0].strip()
        if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', clean) and len(clean) > 1:
            if clean not in {'string', 'number', 'boolean', 'any', 'void', 'null', 'true', 'false', 'T', 'K', 'V', 'P'}:
                if clean not in prompt_symbols_ordered:
                    prompt_symbols_ordered.append(clean)
    prompt_symbols = set(prompt_symbols_ordered)

    valid_exports: Set[str] = set()
    for s in (jsx_tags | hooks | target_calls | prompt_symbols):
        if s in STANDARD_TEST_IDENTIFIERS or s in declared_in_test:
            continue
        # Exported React symbol must be PascalCase (Component), a Hook (use[A-Z]...), or a function directly invoked in test
        if re.match(r'^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', s) or re.match(r'^use[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', s) or s in target_calls:
            valid_exports.add(s)

    detected = sorted(list(valid_exports))

    # Pick the most prominent primary symbol (respecting prompt mention order)
    primary = None
    if jsx_tags:
        matching_jsx = [s for s in prompt_symbols_ordered if s in jsx_tags]
        primary = matching_jsx[0] if matching_jsx else sorted(list(jsx_tags))[0]
    elif hooks:
        matching_hooks = [s for s in prompt_symbols_ordered if s in hooks]
        primary = matching_hooks[0] if matching_hooks else sorted(list(hooks))[0]
    elif prompt_symbols_ordered:
        prompt_react_symbols = [s for s in prompt_symbols_ordered if s in detected]
        primary = prompt_react_symbols[0] if prompt_react_symbols else prompt_symbols_ordered[0]
    elif detected:
        primary = detected[0]

    if primary and primary not in detected:
        detected.append(primary)
        detected.sort()

    return detected, primary


def resolve_expected_exports(item: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[List[str], Optional[str]]:
    """Uses reviewed dataset metadata instead of fragile source-code heuristics.

    Older eval rows may not yet include metadata, in which case the conservative
    heuristic remains available for backwards compatibility. New or migrated rows
    must carry ``exports`` so a TypeScript generic such as ``HTMLDivElement`` can
    never become a requested component export.
    """
    declared = item.get("exports")
    if declared is not None:
        if not isinstance(declared, list) or not declared:
            raise ValueError("Eval item 'exports' must be a non-empty list")
        exports: List[str] = []
        for symbol in declared:
            if not isinstance(symbol, str) or not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$", symbol):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid export name: {symbol!r}")
            if symbol in STANDARD_TEST_IDENTIFIERS:
                raise ValueError(f"Built-in identifier cannot be an eval export: {symbol}")
            if symbol not in exports:
                exports.append(symbol)
        primary = item.get("primary_export") or exports[0]
        if primary not in exports:
            raise ValueError("Eval item 'primary_export' must appear in 'exports'")
        return exports, primary
    return extract_expected_symbols(item["prompt"], item["test_code"])


def build_augmented_prompt(prompt: str, primary_symbol: Optional[str], all_symbols: List[str]) -> str:
    """
    Appends export instructions to eliminate export-name mismatch false negatives.
    """
    instruction_lines = [prompt.strip()]
    if primary_symbol:
        if len(all_symbols) > 1:
            sym_list = ", ".join(f"`{s}`" for s in all_symbols[:3])
            instruction_lines.append(f"IMPORTANT: Export the following as named exports: {sym_list}.")
        else:
            instruction_lines.append(f"IMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `{primary_symbol}`.")
    else:
        instruction_lines.append("IMPORTANT: Ensure you provide named exports for the requested component/function.")

    full_instruction = "\n".join(instruction_lines)
    return f"### Instruction:\n{full_instruction}\n\n### Response:\n"


def split_code_and_css(generated_text: str) -> Tuple[str, Optional[str]]:
    """
    Splits the generated model output into TSX code and optional CSS/CSS Module code.
    Strips markdown code fences if present.
    """
    clean_text = generated_text.strip()
    
    # Check for markdown code blocks
    if "```" in clean_text:
        # Find tsx or typescript blocks
        tsx_match = re.search(r'```(?:tsx|typescript|jsx|javascript)?\s*\n([\s\S]*?)```', clean_text)
        css_match = re.search(r'```css\s*\n([\s\S]*?)```', clean_text)
        
        tsx_code = tsx_match.group(1).strip() if tsx_match else clean_text
        css_code = css_match.group(1).strip() if css_match else None
        
        # If no css code block, check for comment separator like /* styles.module.css */
        if not css_code and "/* " in tsx_code:
            parts = tsx_code.split("/* ", 1)
            tsx_code = parts[0].strip()
            css_code = "/* " + parts[1].strip()
            
        return tsx_code, css_code

    # If not fenced, split on standard runbook format: /* Component.module.css */
    if "/* " in clean_text:
        parts = clean_text.split("/* ", 1)
        tsx_code = parts[0].strip()
        css_code = "/* " + parts[1].strip()
        return tsx_code, css_code

    return clean_text, None


def strip_test_imports(code: str) -> str:
    """
    Strips top-level imports of React, Vitest, Testing Library, and ./Component
    from test_code to avoid duplicate declaration collisions when prepended with
    the test runner's standard test harness header.
    """
    # 1. Match multi-line or single-line imports from packages we already inject
    import_from_pattern = r'import\s+[\s\S]*?from\s*[\'"][^\'"]+[\'"];?'
    def repl_from(m):
        txt = m.group(0)
        if any(pkg in txt for pkg in ['./Component', 'vitest', '@testing-library', "'react'", '"react"']):
            return ''
        return txt
    cleaned = re.sub(import_from_pattern, repl_from, code)

    # 2. Match side-effect imports like import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
    side_pattern = r'import\s+[\'"][^\'"]+[\'"];?'
    def repl_side(m):
        txt = m.group(0)
        if any(pkg in txt for pkg in ['./Component', 'vitest', '@testing-library']):
            return ''
        return txt
    cleaned = re.sub(side_pattern, repl_side, cleaned)

    return re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', cleaned).strip()


def generate_test_file_content(
    test_code: str,
    all_symbols: List[str],
    primary_symbol: Optional[str]
) -> str:
    """
    Assembles the Vitest + Testing Library test file with proper imports,
    global bindings, and fallback support for default exports.
    """
    bindings = []
    for sym in all_symbols:
        # Auto-bind named export, with fallback to default export if named export was omitted
        if sym == primary_symbol:
            bindings.append(f"const {sym} = (__Mod as any).{sym} ?? (__Mod as any).default;")
        else:
            bindings.append(f"const {sym} = (__Mod as any).{sym};")

    bindings_code = "\n".join(bindings)

    # If test_code contains @playwright/test, wrap or guard it
    if "@playwright/test" in test_code:
        return f"""// Playwright-specific test skipped in Vitest jsdom harness
import {{ describe, it }} from 'vitest';
describe('Playwright browser test (skipped in jsdom)', () => {{
  it.skip('requires real browser for focus-visible styles', () => {{}});
}});
"""

    cleaned_test_code = strip_test_imports(test_code)

    return f"""import React, {{ useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback }} from 'react';
import {{ render, screen, fireEvent, act, renderHook, waitFor, within }} from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import {{ vi, describe, it, test, expect, beforeEach, afterEach }} from 'vitest';
import '@testing-library/jest-dom';

import * as __Mod from './Component';

// Injected component bindings
{bindings_code}

// Test case
{cleaned_test_code}
"""



def get_stratified_sample(
    items: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    n: int,
    seed: int = 42
) -> List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]]:
    """
    Returns a stratified sample of n items preserving category proportions.
    Returns list of (original_index, item).
    """
    import random
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    
    by_category: Dict[str, List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]]] = {}
    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
        cat = item.get("check", "tsc_and_render")
        by_category.setdefault(cat, []).append((idx, item))

    total = len(items)
    if n >= total:
        return list(enumerate(items))

    sampled: List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]] = []
    for cat, group in by_category.items():
        # Proportional count, at least 1 per category if available
        cat_n = max(1, round(len(group) / total * n))
        cat_n = min(cat_n, len(group))
        sampled.extend(rng.sample(group, cat_n))

    # Adjust if slight rounding discrepancy
    if len(sampled) > n:
        sampled = rng.sample(sampled, n)
    elif len(sampled) < n:
        remaining = [item for item in enumerate(items) if item not in sampled]
        sampled.extend(rng.sample(remaining, min(n - len(sampled), len(remaining))))

    return sorted(sampled, key=lambda x: x[0])


def generate_mock_code(item: Dict[str, Any], primary_symbol: Optional[str]) -> str:
    """
    Mock code generator for testing the test harness end-to-end without loading GPU models.
    """
    name = primary_symbol or "Component"
    prompt = item["prompt"]
    test_code = item["test_code"]

    # Reducer mock
    if "cartReducer" in prompt or "cartReducer" in test_code:
        return """import React, { useReducer } from 'react';
export type CartState = { items: Array<{ id: string; qty: number }> };
export type CartAction = { type: 'ADD_ITEM'; item: { id: string; qty: number } } | { type: 'REMOVE_ITEM'; id: string } | { type: 'CLEAR' };
export function cartReducer(state: CartState, action: CartAction): CartState {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'ADD_ITEM': return { items: [...state.items, action.item] };
    case 'REMOVE_ITEM': return { items: state.items.filter(i => i.id !== action.id) };
    case 'CLEAR': return { items: [] };
    default: return state;
  }
}
export function useCart() {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(cartReducer, { items: [] });
  return { state, dispatch };
}
"""

    if name == "Modal":
        return """import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
export function Modal({ isOpen, onClose, children }: any) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && onClose) onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;
  return (
    <div>
      <div data-testid="modal-backdrop" onClick={onClose} />
      <div>{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}
"""

    if name == "Chip":
        return """import React from 'react';
export function Chip({ label, onRemove }: any) {

    <div>
      <span>{label}</span>
      {onRemove && (
        <button aria-label="remove" onClick={onRemove}>x</button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
"""

    if name == "Breadcrumbs":
        return """import React from 'react';
export function Breadcrumbs({ items }: any) {
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">
      {items.map((item: any, i: number) => {
        const isLast = i === items.length - 1;

    # Toast mock
    if "Toast" in name or "useToast" in test_code:
        return """import React, { createContext, useContext, useState } from 'react';
const ToastCtx = createContext<any>(null);
export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {

  return useContext(ToastCtx);

    # Hook mock
    if name.startswith("use"):
        return f"""import React, {{ useState }} from 'react';

  const [state, setState] = useState<any>(args[0] || 'red');

def _resolve_executable(exe: str) -> str:
    """Resolves executable path, ensuring .cmd/.exe shims on Windows are found for shell=False."""
    resolved = shutil.which(exe)
    if resolved:
        return resolved
    if os.name == "nt" and not exe.lower().endswith((".cmd", ".exe", ".bat")):
        for ext in (".cmd", ".exe", ".bat"):
            candidate = shutil.which(exe + ext)
            if candidate:
                return candidate
    return exe


def run_command(cmd: List[str], cwd: Optional[Path] = None, timeout: Optional[int] = 30) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    """Executes a command safely with shell=False, resolving .cmd/.exe shims on Windows to prevent shell injection."""
    actual_cwd = str(cwd) if cwd is not None else str(Path.cwd())
    cmd_list = list(cmd) if isinstance(cmd, (list, tuple)) else [cmd]

    if cmd_list:
        cmd_list[0] = _resolve_executable(str(cmd_list[0]))

    try:
        return subprocess.run(
            cmd_list,
            cwd=actual_cwd,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            shell=False,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            timeout=timeout
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(
            args=cmd,
            returncode=-1,
            stdout=e.stdout or "",
            stderr=f"Command timed out after {timeout} seconds."
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(
            args=cmd,
            returncode=-1,
            stdout="",
            stderr=f"Failed to execute command: {exc}"
        )


def write_typecheck_config(config_dir: Path, component_dirs: List[Path]) -> Path:
    """Creates a self-contained, strict TypeScript project for generated code.

    Running ``tsc`` with a source filename ignores the root tsconfig while running
    it without one can accidentally include unrelated generated cases. This small
    project makes batch and sequential scoring equivalent.
    """
    css_declarations = Path.cwd() / "css.d.ts"
    files = [os.path.relpath(css_declarations, config_dir)]
    files.extend(os.path.relpath(case_dir / "Component.tsx", config_dir) for case_dir in component_dirs)
    config = {
        "compilerOptions": {
            "target": "ES2022",
            "lib": ["DOM", "DOM.Iterable", "ES2022"],
            "module": "ESNext",
            "moduleResolution": "bundler",
            "jsx": "react-jsx",
            "strict": True,
            "esModuleInterop": True,
            "skipLibCheck": True,
            "noEmit": True,
        },
        "files": files,
    }
    config_path = config_dir / "tsconfig.eval.json"
    config_path.write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return config_path


def run_typecheck(config_dir: Path, component_dirs: List[Path]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    config_path = write_typecheck_config(config_dir, component_dirs)
    return run_command(["npx", "tsc", "--project", str(config_path)], cwd=config_dir)


class ModelEvaluator:
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name: str,
        max_seq_length: int = 1024,
        is_mock: bool = False,
        agent_protocol: bool = False,
    ):
        self.model_name = model_name
        self.max_seq_length = max_seq_length
        self.is_mock = is_mock
        self.agent_protocol = agent_protocol
        self.model = None
        self.tokenizer = None

        if not is_mock:
            self._init_model()

    def _init_model(self):
        print(f"Loading model: {self.model_name}...")
        try:
            from unsloth import FastLanguageModel
            self.model, self.tokenizer = FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained(
                model_name=self.model_name,
                max_seq_length=self.max_seq_length,
                load_in_4bit=True,
            )
            FastLanguageModel.for_inference(self.model)
            print("Model loaded successfully with Unsloth.")
        except ImportError:
            print("Unsloth not installed or failed, attempting standard transformers...")
            from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
            import torch
            self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model_name)
            self.model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
                self.model_name,
                torch_dtype=torch.float16,
                device_map="auto"
            )
            print("Model loaded with transformers.")

    def generate(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        max_new_tokens: int = 768,
        temperature: float = 0.2
    ) -> str:
        if self.is_mock:
            return ""

        import torch
        if self.agent_protocol:
            from agent_protocol import AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, WriteComponentAction, format_chatml, parse_agent_output

            instruction = prompt
            if "### Instruction:\n" in instruction:
                instruction = instruction.split("### Instruction:\n", 1)[1]
            if "\n\n### Response:" in instruction:
                instruction = instruction.split("\n\n### Response:", 1)[0]
            prompt = format_chatml(
                [
                    {"role": "system", "content": AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
                    {"role": "user", "content": instruction},
                ],
                add_generation_prompt=True,
            )

        inputs = self.tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt").to("cuda")
        with torch.no_grad():
            output = self.model.generate(
                **inputs,
                max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
                temperature=temperature,
                do_sample=(temperature > 0),
                pad_token_id=self.tokenizer.eos_token_id
            )
        completion_tokens = output[0][inputs.input_ids.shape[1]:]
        generated = self.tokenizer.decode(completion_tokens, skip_special_tokens=True)
        if self.agent_protocol:
            turn = parse_agent_output(generated)
            if isinstance(turn.action, WriteComponentAction):
                if turn.action.css:
                    return f"{turn.action.tsx}\n/* Component.module.css */\n{turn.action.css}"
                return turn.action.tsx
            return ""
        if "### Response:\n" in generated:
            return generated.split("### Response:\n")[-1].strip()
        return generated.strip()


def evaluate_batch(
    eval_items: List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]],
    evaluator: ModelEvaluator,
    workspace_dir: Path,
    max_new_tokens: int = 768,
    temperature: float = 0.2
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    High-speed batch evaluation:
    1. Generates all code outputs.
    2. Writes all test files to workspace.
    3. Runs tsc --noEmit once.
    4. Runs vitest run once with JSON reporter.
    """
    print(f"\n[Batch Mode] Preparing {len(eval_items)} evaluation cases...")
    test_dirs: List[Path] = []
    item_metadata: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    for i, (orig_idx, item) in enumerate(eval_items):
        prompt = item["prompt"]
        test_code = item["test_code"]
        check_variant = item.get("check", "tsc_and_render")

        all_symbols, primary_symbol = resolve_expected_exports(item)
        aug_prompt = build_augmented_prompt(prompt, primary_symbol, all_symbols)

        # 1. Model inference or mock
        if evaluator.is_mock:
            raw_generated = generate_mock_code(item, primary_symbol)
        else:
            print(f"[{i+1}/{len(eval_items)}] Generating response for Item #{orig_idx+1} ({primary_symbol})...")
            raw_generated = evaluator.generate(aug_prompt, max_new_tokens, temperature)

        tsx_code, css_code = split_code_and_css(raw_generated)
        test_file_code = generate_test_file_content(test_code, all_symbols, primary_symbol)

        case_dir = workspace_dir / f"case_{orig_idx:03d}"
        case_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        test_dirs.append(case_dir)

        # Write Component.tsx
        (case_dir / "Component.tsx").write_text(tsx_code, encoding="utf-8")
        # Write CSS module
        css_content = css_code if css_code else "/* empty styles */"
        (case_dir / "Component.module.css").write_text(css_content, encoding="utf-8")
        # Write Component.test.tsx
        (case_dir / "Component.test.tsx").write_text(test_file_code, encoding="utf-8")

        item_metadata.append({
            "index": orig_idx,
            "check": check_variant,
            "primary_symbol": primary_symbol,
            "all_symbols": all_symbols,
            "prompt": prompt,
            "generated_code": raw_generated,
            "case_dir": case_dir,
            "test_file": case_dir / "Component.test.tsx"
        })

    # Step 1: Typecheck all cases with tsc
    print("\n[Step 1/2] Running isolated strict TypeScript check...")
    tsc_res = run_typecheck(workspace_dir, test_dirs)
    tsc_output = tsc_res.stdout + "\n" + tsc_res.stderr

    # Map tsc errors per case
    for meta in item_metadata:
        case_folder_name = meta["case_dir"].name
        # If folder name appears in tsc output with an error, mark failed
        has_tsc_error = f"{case_folder_name}/" in tsc_output or f"{case_folder_name}\\" in tsc_output
        meta["tsc_passed"] = not has_tsc_error
        meta["tsc_error"] = "\n".join([l for l in tsc_output.splitlines() if case_folder_name in l]) if has_tsc_error else ""

    # Step 2: Run Vitest across workspace with JSON reporter
    print("[Step 2/2] Running Vitest suite (concurrent execution across all files)...")
    report_file = workspace_dir / "vitest_results.json"
    if report_file.exists():
        report_file.unlink()

    vitest_cmd = [
        "npx", "vitest", "run",
        "--config", "vitest.config.ts",
        "--reporter=json",
        f"--outputFile={report_file}",
        str(workspace_dir.relative_to(Path.cwd()))
    ]
    vitest_proc = run_command(vitest_cmd, cwd=Path.cwd())

    # Parse Vitest results
    vitest_data = {}
    if report_file.exists():
        try:
            vitest_data = json.loads(report_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Warning: could not parse vitest JSON report: {e}")

    # Map test results per test file
    test_results_by_path = {}
    for test_result in vitest_data.get("testResults", []):
        file_path = Path(test_result.get("name", "")).resolve()
        status = test_result.get("status", "failed")
        msg = test_result.get("message", "").strip()
        if not msg and test_result.get("assertionResults"):
            for ar in test_result["assertionResults"]:
                if ar.get("status") == "failed" and ar.get("failureMessages"):
                    msg = "\n".join(ar["failureMessages"])
                    break
        test_results_by_path[file_path] = (status == "passed", msg)

    results = []
    for meta in item_metadata:
        test_file_resolved = meta["test_file"].resolve()
        vitest_passed, vitest_err = test_results_by_path.get(test_file_resolved, (False, "Test did not complete"))

        # A skipped browser test is not a passing test. Keep it visible in the
        # report rather than silently inflating the pass rate.
        skipped = False
        if "@playwright/test" in meta["prompt"] or "Playwright" in meta["test_file"].read_text(encoding="utf-8"):
            vitest_passed = False
            vitest_err = "Playwright browser test skipped in jsdom; excluded from pass rate"
            skipped = True

        check = meta["check"]
        tsc_passed = meta["tsc_passed"]

        # Apply check variant rules
        if check == "tsc_only":
            overall_passed = tsc_passed and vitest_passed
        elif check in ("tsc_and_render", "tsc_render_a11y", "tsc_render_interact"):
            overall_passed = tsc_passed and vitest_passed
        else:
            overall_passed = tsc_passed and vitest_passed

        results.append({
            "index": meta["index"],
            "check": check,
            "primary_symbol": meta["primary_symbol"],
            "tsc_passed": tsc_passed,
            "vitest_passed": vitest_passed,
            "overall_passed": overall_passed,
            "skipped": skipped,
            "tsc_error": meta["tsc_error"],
            "vitest_error": vitest_err,
            "prompt": meta["prompt"],
            "generated_code": meta["generated_code"]
        })

    return results


def evaluate_sequential(
    eval_items: List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]],
    evaluator: ModelEvaluator,
    workspace_dir: Path,
    max_new_tokens: int = 768,
    temperature: float = 0.2
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Sequential evaluation mode: executes each item in isolation with live progress reporting.
    """
    print(f"\n[Sequential Mode] Evaluating {len(eval_items)} test cases one by one...")
    results = []

    for i, (orig_idx, item) in enumerate(eval_items):
        prompt = item["prompt"]
        test_code = item["test_code"]
        check_variant = item.get("check", "tsc_and_render")

        all_symbols, primary_symbol = resolve_expected_exports(item)
        aug_prompt = build_augmented_prompt(prompt, primary_symbol, all_symbols)

        if evaluator.is_mock:
            raw_generated = generate_mock_code(item, primary_symbol)
        else:
            print(f"[{i+1}/{len(eval_items)}] Generating response for Item #{orig_idx+1} ({primary_symbol})...")
            raw_generated = evaluator.generate(aug_prompt, max_new_tokens, temperature)

        tsx_code, css_code = split_code_and_css(raw_generated)
        test_file_code = generate_test_file_content(test_code, all_symbols, primary_symbol)

        case_dir = workspace_dir / f"case_{orig_idx:03d}"
        case_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        (case_dir / "Component.tsx").write_text(tsx_code, encoding="utf-8")
        (case_dir / "Component.module.css").write_text(css_code or "/* styles */", encoding="utf-8")
        test_file = case_dir / "Component.test.tsx"
        test_file.write_text(test_file_code, encoding="utf-8")

        # Use the identical isolated strict compiler project as batch mode.
        tsc_res = run_typecheck(case_dir, [case_dir])
        tsc_passed = (tsc_res.returncode == 0)

        # Run vitest on this test file
        skipped = False
        if "@playwright/test" in test_code:
            vitest_passed = False
            vitest_err = "Playwright test skipped; excluded from pass rate"
            skipped = True
        else:
            vitest_res = run_command(
                ["npx", "vitest", "run", "--config", "vitest.config.ts", str(test_file)],
                cwd=Path.cwd()
            )
            vitest_passed = (vitest_res.returncode == 0)
            vitest_err = vitest_res.stderr if not vitest_passed else ""

        overall_passed = tsc_passed and vitest_passed
        status_sym = "[PASS]" if overall_passed else "[FAIL]"
        print(f"[{i+1}/{len(eval_items)}] {status_sym} #{orig_idx+1} {primary_symbol} ({check_variant}) | tsc={tsc_passed}, vitest={vitest_passed}")

        results.append({
            "index": orig_idx,
            "check": check_variant,
            "primary_symbol": primary_symbol,
            "tsc_passed": tsc_passed,
            "vitest_passed": vitest_passed,
            "overall_passed": overall_passed,
            "skipped": skipped,
            "tsc_error": tsc_res.stderr if not tsc_passed else "",
            "vitest_error": vitest_err,
            "prompt": prompt,
            "generated_code": raw_generated
        })

    return results


def print_summary_report(results: List[Dict[str, Any]]):
    """Prints compile, unit-test, and end-to-end rates without relabeling tests."""
    by_category: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for r in results:
        by_category.setdefault(r["check"], []).append(r)

    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print("                 EVALUATION RESULTS SUMMARY REPORT                 ")
    print("=" * 78)
    print(f"{'Category':<24} {'Count':<8} {'Passed':<8} {'Pass %':<10} {'TSC %':<10} {'Vitest %':<10}")
    print("-" * 78)

    categories = ["tsc_only", "tsc_and_render", "tsc_render_a11y", "tsc_render_interact"]
    for cat in categories:
        group = by_category.get(cat, [])
        if not group:
            continue
        scored = [r for r in group if not r.get("skipped", False)]
        total = len(scored)
        skipped = len(group) - total
        if not total:
            print(f"{cat:<24} {'0':<8} {'0':<8} {'n/a':<10} {'n/a':<10} {'n/a':<10} ({skipped} skipped)")
            continue
        passed = sum(1 for r in scored if r["overall_passed"])
        tsc_pass = sum(1 for r in scored if r["tsc_passed"])
        vitest_pass = sum(1 for r in scored if r["vitest_passed"])
        suffix = f" ({skipped} skipped)" if skipped else ""
        print(f"{cat:<24} {total:<8} {passed:<8} {100*passed/total:>6.1f}%   {100*tsc_pass/total:>6.1f}%   {100*vitest_pass/total:>6.1f}%{suffix}")

    print("-" * 78)
    scored_all = [r for r in results if not r.get("skipped", False)]
    total_all = len(scored_all)
    passed_all = sum(1 for r in scored_all if r["overall_passed"])
    tsc_all = sum(1 for r in scored_all if r["tsc_passed"])
    vitest_all = sum(1 for r in scored_all if r["vitest_passed"])
    if total_all:
        print(f"{'OVERALL':<24} {total_all:<8} {passed_all:<8} {100*passed_all/total_all:>6.1f}%   {100*tsc_all/total_all:>6.1f}%   {100*vitest_all/total_all:>6.1f}%")
    else:
        print(f"{'OVERALL':<24} {'0':<8} {'0':<8} {'n/a':<10} {'n/a':<10} {'n/a':<10}")
    print("=" * 78)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Vitest + jsdom + RTL evaluation driver for React TS CSS SLM.")
    parser.add_argument("--model", type=str, default="./base-model", help="Path or HuggingFace ID of model.")
    parser.add_argument("--eval-set", type=str, default="react_ts_css_eval_set_combined.jsonl", help="Path to JSONL eval set.")
    parser.add_argument("--subset", type=int, default=None, help="Sample N items using stratified sampling.")
    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=["batch", "sequential"], default="batch", help="Execution mode (default: batch for 10x speed).")
    parser.add_argument("--mock", action="store_true", help="Run mock generator without loading GPU weights.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--agent-protocol",
        action="store_true",
        help="Prompt the model with the same ChatML/XML contract used by agent.py (one-shot only).",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=str, default="eval_results.json", help="Path to save output report JSON.")
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=768, help="Max tokens to generate per example.")
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.2, help="Sampling temperature.")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42, help="Random seed for sampling.")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    eval_file = Path(args.eval_set)
    if not eval_file.exists():
        print(f"Error: Evaluation set not found at {eval_file}")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Loading evaluation dataset: {eval_file}")
    with open(eval_file, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        all_items = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

    print(f"Total examples in dataset: {len(all_items)}")

    # Subsetting
    if args.subset and args.subset < len(all_items):
        selected_items = get_stratified_sample(all_items, args.subset, seed=args.seed)
        print(f"Sampled {len(selected_items)} examples across all 4 check categories (stratified).")
    else:
        selected_items = list(enumerate(all_items))

    # Initialize evaluator
    evaluator = ModelEvaluator(
        model_name=args.model,
        is_mock=args.mock,
        agent_protocol=args.agent_protocol,
    )

    # Prepare temp eval workspace
    workspace_dir = Path.cwd() / ".eval_workspace"
    if workspace_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(workspace_dir)
    workspace_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    start_time = time.time()

    try:
        if args.mode == "batch":
            results = evaluate_batch(
                eval_items=selected_items,
                evaluator=evaluator,
                workspace_dir=workspace_dir,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                temperature=args.temperature
            )
        else:
            results = evaluate_sequential(
                eval_items=selected_items,
                evaluator=evaluator,
                workspace_dir=workspace_dir,
                max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens,
                temperature=args.temperature
            )
    finally:
        # Keep workspace for inspection or clean up as needed
        pass

    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    print(f"\nEvaluation completed in {elapsed:.1f} seconds.")

    # Print summary
    print_summary_report(results)

    # Save output JSON
    output_path = Path(args.output)
    scored_results = [r for r in results if not r.get("skipped", False)]
    report_data = {
        "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "model": args.model,
        "mode": args.mode,
        "is_mock": args.mock,
        "agent_protocol": args.agent_protocol,
        "total_evaluated": len(results),
        "total_scored": len(scored_results),
        "skipped": len(results) - len(scored_results),
        "overall_pass_rate": sum(1 for r in scored_results if r["overall_passed"]) / len(scored_results) if scored_results else 0,
        "typecheck_pass_rate": sum(1 for r in scored_results if r["tsc_passed"]) / len(scored_results) if scored_results else 0,
        "unit_test_pass_rate": sum(1 for r in scored_results if r["vitest_passed"]) / len(scored_results) if scored_results else 0,
        "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
        "results": results
    }
    output_path.write_text(json.dumps(report_data, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\nDetailed JSON report saved to: {output_path.resolve()}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

### 3.6 Trajectory & Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline

#### `generate_teacher.py`

- **Path**: `file:///c:/Users/AYUSH/Documents/slm/generate_teacher.py`
- **Lines**: 1,546 | **Size**: 53,606 bytes

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
generate_trajectories.py - Agentic Trajectory Generator for Code SLMs
Generates, validates, and curates multi-turn self-correction datasets for training
Qwen2.5-Coder-3B into an autonomous agent.

Features:
- Teacher LLM support: OpenAI (gpt-4o), Anthropic (claude-3-5-sonnet), OpenRouter, or DeepSeek.
- Offline verified seed generator (--generate-seed) with rich React+TS+CSS self-correction episodes.
- Trajectory replayer & verifier (--verify) ensuring 100% of training data passes Vitest.
- Exports to standard ChatML / OpenAI message format ready for Unsloth SFT fine-tuning.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import random
import socket
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from agent_protocol import (
    AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
    RunTestsAction,
    WriteComponentAction,
    format_chatml,
    format_observation,
    parse_agent_output,
    prune_stack_trace,
)
from agent import execute_test_suite
from evaluate import extract_expected_symbols, generate_test_file_content


# Pricing per 1M tokens (USD): (input_price, output_price)
MODEL_PRICING = {
    "gpt-4o": (2.50, 10.00),
    "gpt-4o-mini": (0.15, 0.60),
    "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022": (3.00, 15.00),
    "gemini-2.5-flash": (0.075, 0.30),
    "gemini-1.5-pro": (1.25, 5.00),
    "deepseek-chat": (0.14, 0.28),
    "deepseek-reasoner": (0.55, 2.19),
}

def estimate_generation_cost(count: int, model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash", avg_turns: int = 3) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculates approximate token usage and dollar cost for a teacher generation run."""
    avg_in = 2500
    avg_out = 800
    total_turns = count * avg_turns
    total_in = total_turns * avg_in
    total_out = total_turns * avg_out
    in_rate, out_rate = MODEL_PRICING.get(model, (1.00, 3.00))
    cost = (total_in / 1_000_000 * in_rate) + (total_out / 1_000_000 * out_rate)
    return {
        "count": count,
        "model": model,
        "total_turns": total_turns,
        "estimated_input_tokens": total_in,
        "estimated_output_tokens": total_out,
        "estimated_cost_usd": round(cost, 4),
    }


# ==============================================================================
# 1. Teacher Model Client (OpenAI / Claude / OpenRouter / DeepSeek)
# ==============================================================================

class TeacherClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        provider: str = "openai",
        model: str = "gpt-4o",
        api_key: Optional[str] = None,
        base_url: Optional[str] = None
    ):
        self.provider = provider.lower()
        self.model = model
        self.base_url = base_url

        if self.provider == "anthropic":
            self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
        elif self.provider == "gemini":
            self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY")
            if self.model in ("gpt-4o", "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"):
                self.model = "gemini-2.5-flash"
        elif self.provider == "deepseek":
            self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY")
            self.base_url = self.base_url or "https://api.deepseek.com/v1"
        elif self.provider == "openrouter":
            self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY")
            self.base_url = self.base_url or "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
        else:
            self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
            self.base_url = self.base_url or "https://api.openai.com/v1"

    def generate(self, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], temperature: float = 0.2) -> str:
        if not self.api_key:
            raise ValueError(f"API key missing for provider '{self.provider}'. Set {self.provider.upper()}_API_KEY.")

        if self.provider == "gemini":
            return self._call_gemini(messages, temperature)
        elif self.provider == "anthropic":
            return self._call_anthropic(messages, temperature)
        return self._call_openai_compatible(messages, temperature)

    def _execute_with_retry(self, req: urllib.request.Request, max_retries: int = 5) -> bytes:
        """Executes an HTTP request with exponential backoff + jitter on rate limits (429) and 5xx errors."""
        for attempt in range(max_retries):
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60.0) as resp:
                    return resp.read()
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                err_body = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                if e.code in (429, 500, 502, 503, 504) and attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    delay = (2 ** attempt) + random.uniform(0.2, 1.0)
                    print(f"[{self.provider.upper()}] HTTP {e.code} received. Retrying in {delay:.1f}s (attempt {attempt+1}/{max_retries})...")
                    time.sleep(delay)
                    continue
                # Redact potential API key substrings from error message
                safe_err = re.sub(r'[\w\-]{20,}', '[REDACTED]', err_body)
                raise RuntimeError(f"{self.provider.upper()} API Error ({e.code}): {safe_err}")
            except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, socket.timeout) as e:
                if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                    delay = (2 ** attempt) + random.uniform(0.2, 1.0)
                    print(f"[{self.provider.upper()}] Network error: {e}. Retrying in {delay:.1f}s (attempt {attempt+1}/{max_retries})...")
                    time.sleep(delay)
                    continue
                safe_err = re.sub(r'[\w\-]{20,}', '[REDACTED]', str(e))
                raise RuntimeError(f"{self.provider.upper()} Network Error: {safe_err}")
        raise RuntimeError(f"{self.provider.upper()} failed after {max_retries} attempts.")

    def _call_openai_compatible(self, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], temperature: float) -> str:
        url = f"{self.base_url.rstrip('/')}/chat/completions"
        payload = {
            "model": self.model,
            "messages": messages,
            "temperature": temperature,
            "max_tokens": 1500
        }
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
            headers={
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"
            },
            method="POST"
        )
        raw_resp = self._execute_with_retry(req)
        data = json.loads(raw_resp.decode("utf-8"))
        return data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]

    def _call_anthropic(self, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], temperature: float) -> str:
        url = "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages"
        # Extract system message
        system_content = ""
        user_assistant_msgs = []
        for m in messages:
            if m["role"] == "system":
                system_content = m["content"]
            else:
                user_assistant_msgs.append(m)

        payload = {
            "model": self.model,
            "system": system_content,
            "messages": user_assistant_msgs,
            "temperature": temperature,
            "max_tokens": 1500
        }
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
            headers={
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "x-api-key": self.api_key,
                "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01"
            },
            method="POST"
        )
        raw_resp = self._execute_with_retry(req)
        data = json.loads(raw_resp.decode("utf-8"))
        return data["content"][0]["text"]

    def _call_gemini(self, messages: List[Dict[str, str]], temperature: float) -> str:
        url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{self.model}:generateContent"
        system_content = ""
        contents = []

        for m in messages:
            if m["role"] == "system":
                system_content = m["content"]
            else:
                gemini_role = "model" if m["role"] == "assistant" else "user"
                contents.append({
                    "role": gemini_role,
                    "parts": [{"text": m["content"]}]
                })

        gen_config: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "temperature": temperature,
            "maxOutputTokens": 4096
        }
        if "json" in system_content.lower():
            gen_config["responseMimeType"] = "application/json"

        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "contents": contents,
            "generationConfig": gen_config
        }
        if system_content:
            payload["systemInstruction"] = {
                "parts": [{"text": system_content}]
            }

        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
            headers={
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "x-goog-api-key": self.api_key
            },
            method="POST"
        )
        raw_resp = self._execute_with_retry(req)
        data = json.loads(raw_resp.decode("utf-8"))
        candidates = data.get("candidates", [])
        if not candidates:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Gemini returned no response candidates: {data}")
        parts = candidates[0].get("content", {}).get("parts", [])
        if not parts:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Gemini candidate has no content parts: {candidates[0]}")
        return parts[0].get("text", "")

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';

interface ModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function Modal({ isOpen, onClose, children }: ModalProps) {
  useEffect(() => {

      if (event.key === 'Escape') {

      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true">

      </div>

  );

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import styles from './Component.module.css';

interface TooltipProps {
  content: string;
  delayMs?: number;
  placement?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right';
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function Tooltip({ content, delayMs = 300, placement = 'top', children }: TooltipProps) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const handleMouseEnter = () => {
    timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setVisible(true);
    }, delayMs);
  };

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }
    setVisible(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleMouseLeave();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
      onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
    >
      {children}
      {visible && (
        <div role="tooltip" className={`${styles.tooltip} ${styles[placement]}`}>
          {content}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</tsx>

.top { bottom: 100%; left: 50%; }
.bottom { top: 100%; left: 50%; }
.left { right: 100%; top: 50%; }
.right { left: 100%; top: 50%; }
</css>

<tool_call name="write_component">
<tsx>
import { useReducer } from 'react';

export interface CartItem {
  id: string;
  qty: number;
}

export interface CartState {
  items: CartItem[];
}

export type CartAction =
  | { type: 'ADD_ITEM'; item: CartItem }
  | { type: 'REMOVE_ITEM'; id: string }
  | { type: 'CLEAR' };

export function cartReducer(state: CartState, action: CartAction): CartState {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'ADD_ITEM':
      return { items: [...state.items, action.item] };
    case 'REMOVE_ITEM':
      return { items: state.items.filter(item => item.id !== action.id) };
    case 'CLEAR':
      return { items: [] };
    default:
      return state;
  }
}

export function useCart() {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(cartReducer, { items: [] });
  return { state, dispatch };
}
</tsx>
</tool_call>"""

import React, { useState } from 'react';

interface AccordionItem {
  title: string;
  content: string;
}

interface AccordionProps {
  items: AccordionItem[];
  allowMultiple?: boolean;
}

export function Accordion({ items, allowMultiple = true }: AccordionProps) {
  const [openIndices, setOpenIndices] = useState<number[]>([]);

  const toggle = (index: number) => {
    setOpenIndices(prev => {
      const isOpen = prev.includes(index);
      if (!allowMultiple) {
        return isOpen ? [] : [index];
      }
      return isOpen ? prev.filter(i => i !== index) : [...prev, index];
    });
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {items.map((item, idx) => (
        <div key={idx}>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => toggle(idx)}>{item.title}</button>
          {openIndices.includes(idx) && <div>{item.content}</div>}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';

interface SearchInputProps {
  onSearch: (query: string) => void;
  isLoading?: boolean;
}

export function SearchInput({ onSearch, isLoading }: SearchInputProps) {
  const [val, setVal] = useState('');
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const next = e.target.value;
    setVal(next);

    if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      onSearch(next);
    }, 300);
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    setVal('');
    if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    onSearch('');
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div>
      <input
        role="textbox"
        value={val}
        onChange={handleChange}
      />
      {isLoading && <span role="status">Loading...</span>}
      {val && <button type="button" onClick={handleClear}>x</button>}
    </div>
  );
}
</tsx>

import React, { useState } from 'react';

interface AvatarProps {
  src?: string;
  name: string;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
}

export function Avatar({ src, name, size = 'md' }: AvatarProps) {
  const [hasError, setHasError] = useState(false);

  const getInitials = (str: string) => {
    return str
      .trim()
      .split(/\\s+/)
      .map(part => part[0])
      .slice(0, 2)
      .join('')
      .toUpperCase();
  };

  if (src && !hasError) {
    return <img src={src} alt={name} onError={() => setHasError(true)} />;
  }

  return (
    <div role="img" aria-label={name}>
      {getInitials(name)}
    </div>
  );
}
</tsx>

interface SwitchProps {
  checked: boolean;
  onChange: (checked: boolean) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function Switch({ checked, onChange, disabled }: SwitchProps) {
  return (
    <div
      role="switch"
      tabIndex={disabled ? -1 : 0}
      aria-checked={checked}
      aria-disabled={disabled}
      onClick={() => {
        if (!disabled) onChange(!checked);
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (!disabled && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {
          e.preventDefault();
          onChange(!checked);
        }

      style={{
        cursor: disabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center'
      }}
    >
      <span>{checked ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}</span>

  );

# 3. Main Generator Engine

def generate_seed_dataset(output_file: Path) -> int:
    """Writes the curated seed trajectories to a JSONL file."""
    seeds = get_curated_seed_trajectories()
    print(f"Generating {len(seeds)} verified agentic self-correction seed trajectories...")

    with open(output_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for item in seeds:
            f.write(json.dumps(item) + "\n")

    print(f"Successfully saved seed dataset to: {output_file.resolve()}")
    return len(seeds)


def generate_trajectories_with_teacher(
    eval_set_path: Path,
    output_file: Path,
    teacher: TeacherClient,
    count: int = 20,
    max_turns: int = 4
):
    """
    Executes tasks using teacher LLM, verifies each turn with the Vitest harness,
    and saves only 100% verified multi-turn trajectories to output_file.
    """
    with open(eval_set_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        tasks = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

    workspace_dir = Path.cwd() / ".trajectory_workspace"
    if workspace_dir.exists():
        import shutil
        shutil.rmtree(workspace_dir)
    workspace_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    saved_count = 0
    print(f"Starting teacher trajectory generation ({teacher.provider}:{teacher.model}) on {count} tasks...")

    with open(output_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as out_f:
        for idx, task in enumerate(tasks[:count]):
            prompt = task["prompt"]
            test_code = task["test_code"]
            all_symbols, primary_symbol = extract_expected_symbols(prompt, test_code)
            target_name = primary_symbol or "Component"

            case_dir = workspace_dir / f"case_{idx:03d}"
            case_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

            test_file_code = generate_test_file_content(test_code, all_symbols, primary_symbol)
            test_file = case_dir / "Component.test.tsx"
            test_file.write_text(test_file_code, encoding="utf-8")

            user_prompt = f"{prompt}\nIMPORTANT: Export the component as a named export called `{target_name}`."
            messages: List[Dict[str, str]] = [
                {"role": "system", "content": AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
                {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt}
            ]

            print(f"\n[Task {idx+1}/{count}] {target_name}...")
            passed_at_end = False

            for turn in range(1, max_turns + 1):
                try:
                    assistant_resp = teacher.generate(messages)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Teacher generation error on turn {turn}: {e}")
                    break

                messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": assistant_resp})
                parsed = parse_agent_output(assistant_resp)

                if parsed.is_finish:
                    passed_at_end = True
                    break

                if parsed.is_tool_call and isinstance(parsed.action, WriteComponentAction):
                    (case_dir / "Component.tsx").write_text(parsed.action.tsx, encoding="utf-8")
                    css_c = parsed.action.css if parsed.action.css else "/* styles */"
                    (case_dir / "Component.module.css").write_text(css_c, encoding="utf-8")

                    tsc_ok, vit_ok, tsc_out, vit_out = execute_test_suite(case_dir, test_file)
                    passed = (tsc_ok and vit_ok)
                    obs = format_observation(tsc_ok, vit_ok, tsc_out, vit_out)
                    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": obs})

                    if passed:
                        passed_at_end = True

                elif parsed.is_tool_call and isinstance(parsed.action, RunTestsAction):
                    tsc_ok, vit_ok, tsc_out, vit_out = execute_test_suite(case_dir, test_file)
                    passed = (tsc_ok and vit_ok)
                    obs = format_observation(tsc_ok, vit_ok, tsc_out, vit_out)
                    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": obs})
                    if passed:
                        passed_at_end = True
                else:
                    obs = "<observation status=\"info\">Please output a tool_call or finish.</observation>"
                    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": obs})

            # Save if verified
            if passed_at_end:
                out_f.write(json.dumps({
                    "task_id": f"task_{idx:03d}",
                    "primary_symbol": target_name,
                    "messages": messages
                }) + "\n")
                out_f.flush()
                saved_count += 1
                print(f"  -> Successfully verified and recorded trajectory #{saved_count}!")

    print(f"\nCompleted! Saved {saved_count} verified trajectories to: {output_file.resolve()}")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate agentic trajectory training data.")
    parser.add_argument("--generate-seed", action="store_true", help="Generate verified offline seed trajectories.")
    parser.add_argument("--provider", choices=["openai", "anthropic", "openrouter", "deepseek", "gemini"], default="gemini")
    parser.add_argument("--model", type=str, default="gemini-2.5-flash", help="Teacher model name (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-1.5-pro, gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022).")
    parser.add_argument("--api-key", type=str, default=None, help="API key for teacher provider.")
    parser.add_argument("--eval-set", type=str, default="react_ts_css_eval_set_combined.jsonl")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=str, default="train_trajectories.jsonl", help="Output trajectory file.")
    parser.add_argument("--count", type=int, default=20, help="Number of teacher trajectories to generate.")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Simulate generation without calling paid teacher APIs.")
    parser.add_argument("--cost-estimate", action="store_true", help="Print estimated token usage and dollar cost then exit.")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    output_path = Path(args.output)

    if args.cost_estimate or args.dry_run:
        est = estimate_generation_cost(count=args.count, model=args.model)
        print("=" * 60)
        print("          TEACHER GENERATION COST ESTIMATE              ")
        print("=" * 60)
        print(f"  Target Trajectories:     {est['count']}")
        print(f"  Teacher Model:           {est['model']}")
        print(f"  Estimated Model Turns:   {est['total_turns']}")
        print(f"  Estimated Input Tokens:  {est['estimated_input_tokens']:,}")
        print(f"  Estimated Output Tokens: {est['estimated_output_tokens']:,}")
        print(f"  Estimated Cost (USD):    ${est['estimated_cost_usd']:.4f}")
        print("=" * 60)
        if args.cost_estimate or args.dry_run:
            if args.dry_run:
                print("Dry-run complete. Exiting without making API calls.")
            sys.exit(0)

    if args.generate_seed:
        generate_seed_dataset(output_path)
        sys.exit(0)

    teacher = TeacherClient(
        provider=args.provider,
        model=args.model,
        api_key=args.api_key
    )
    generate_trajectories_with_teacher(
        eval_set_path=Path(args.eval_set),
        output_file=output_path,
        teacher=teacher,
        count=args.count
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
generate_star_trajectories.py - Self-Taught Reasoner (STaR) & Rejection Sampling Pipeline
Generates authentic, empirical multi-turn self-correction episodes by running the fine-tuned
model through agent.py against live Vitest & TSC test harnesses on held-out tasks.

Features:
- Bank of realistic, held-out UI component tasks (completely separate from eval benchmark).
- Harvests genuine, unedited test failures and raw DOM dumps from Vitest.
- Retains only trajectories that achieved 100% verified passing tests (especially 2+ turns).
- Automatically converts rollouts into ChatML format ready for Unsloth SFT fine-tuning.

Usage:
  # Run STaR generation on held-out tasks with mock or trained model:
  python generate_star_trajectories.py --model my-react-agent-lora --tasks 5

  # Rebuild the leak-free corpus after harvesting passing trajectories:
  python generate_star_trajectories.py --model my-react-agent-lora --tasks 5 --merge
"""

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Rollout Extraction & Conversion to ChatML Trajectory
# ==============================================================================

def convert_rollout_to_trajectory(task_id: str, history: List[Dict[str, str]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Converts the agent's multi-turn conversational history into a clean training trajectory."""
    return {
        "task_id": f"star_{task_id}",
        "source": "rejection_sampling_star",
        "messages": history
    }


# ==============================================================================
# 3. Main STaR Generation Loop
# ==============================================================================

def run_star_pipeline(
    model_path: str = "my-react-agent-lora",
    num_tasks: int = 150,
    max_turns: int = 5,
    merge_output: bool = True,
    resume: bool = True,
    output_file: str = "star_trajectories.jsonl"
):
    task_bank_file = Path("star_task_bank.jsonl")
    if task_bank_file.exists():
        with open(task_bank_file, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            tasks = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]
    else:
        tasks = STAR_TASKS

    out_path = Path(output_file)
    completed_task_ids = set()
    if resume and out_path.exists():
        with open(out_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f_in:
            for line in f_in:
                if line.strip():
                    try:
                        data = json.loads(line)
                        completed_task_ids.add(data.get("task_id", "").lower())
                    except Exception as parse_err:
                        print(f"Warning: Failed to parse line in {out_path.name}: {parse_err}")
        print(f"Resuming STaR run: found {len(completed_task_ids)} existing trajectories in {out_path.name}")
    elif not resume and out_path.exists():
        out_path.unlink()

    print("=" * 75)
    print("      SELF-TAUGHT REASONER (STaR) / REJECTION SAMPLING PIPELINE        ")
    print("=" * 75)
    print(f"Target Model: {model_path}")
    print(f"Task Bank Size: {len(tasks)} (running first {min(num_tasks, len(tasks))})")
    print(f"Max Turns: {max_turns}")
    print(f"Output File: {out_path.resolve()}")
    print("=" * 75)

    if model_path == "mock":
        runner = MockAgentEngine()
    else:
        runner = AgentModelRunner(model_path=model_path, max_seq_length=DEFAULT_INFERENCE_MAX_SEQ_LENGTH)

    harvested_trajectories = []
    total_passed = len(completed_task_ids)
    total_self_corrected = 0

    for i, task in enumerate(tasks[:num_tasks]):
        symbol = task["symbol"]
        traj_id = f"star_{symbol.lower()}"
        if traj_id in completed_task_ids:
            print(f"\n[STaR Skipped]: Task #{i+1} {symbol} already completed. Skipping.")
            continue

        prompt = task["prompt"]
        test_code = task["test_code"]

        res = run_agent_on_example(
            orig_idx=i,
            item=task,
            runner=runner,
            workspace_root=Path.cwd() / ".agent_workspace",
            max_turns=max_turns,
            temperature=0.20,
            best_of_2=True
        )

        final_passed = res.get("final_passed", False)
        self_corrected = res.get("self_corrected", False)
        turns_used = res.get("turns_used", 1)

        if final_passed:
            total_passed += 1
            if self_corrected or turns_used > 1:
                total_self_corrected += 1
                print(f"  >>> [STaR Harvested]: Task #{i+1} {symbol} self-corrected on Turn {turns_used}! Kept.")
            else:
                print(f"  >>> [STaR Harvested]: Task #{i+1} {symbol} passed on Turn 1.")

            # Preserve the authentic, genuine multi-turn rollout from agent_loop
            raw_trajectory = res.get("trajectory", [])
            history = [dict(m) for m in raw_trajectory]

            # Ensure dialogue finishes with an assistant finish tag if tests passed
            if history and history[-1].get("role") == "user":
                history.append({
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "content": (
                        "<thought>\n"
                        "All TypeScript typechecks and Vitest unit test assertions have passed successfully.\n"
                        "</thought>\n"
                        "<finish>\n"
                        f"{symbol} component fully verified and all unit tests passed.\n"
                        "</finish>"
                    )
                })

            traj = convert_rollout_to_trajectory(symbol.lower(), history)
            harvested_trajectories.append(traj)

            # Flush immediately to disk after every passing task
            with open(out_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f_out:
                f_out.write(json.dumps(traj, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                f_out.flush()

    print("\n" + "=" * 75)
    print("                     STaR HARVEST SUMMARY                             ")
    print("=" * 75)
    print(f"Total Evaluated: {min(num_tasks, len(tasks))}")
    print(f"Total Verified Passing Trajectories in Bank: {total_passed}")
    print(f"New Self-Corrected Multi-Turn Episodes: {total_self_corrected}")

    if merge_output and out_path.exists():
        from dataset_build_expanded import build_clean_dataset

        clean, stats = build_clean_dataset(
            core_path=Path("train_trajectories_hybrid.jsonl"),
            star_path=out_path,
            eval_path=Path("react_ts_css_eval_set_combined.jsonl"),
        )
        clean_path = Path("train_trajectories_agentic.jsonl")
        with clean_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            for item in clean:
                handle.write(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        print(f"Rebuilt leak-free training corpus: {len(clean)} trajectories at {clean_path.resolve()}")
        print(f"Filter statistics: {stats}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="STaR & Rejection Sampling for Agentic SLMs")
    parser.add_argument("--model", type=str, default="my-react-agent-lora", help="Model path or 'mock'")
    parser.add_argument("--tasks", type=int, default=150, help="Number of held-out tasks to run (default: 150)")
    parser.add_argument("--max-turns", type=int, default=5, help="Max turns per task")
    parser.add_argument("--merge", action="store_true", default=True, help="Rebuild train_trajectories_agentic.jsonl through leak checks.")
    parser.add_argument("--no-merge", dest="merge", action="store_false", help="Do not merge into train_trajectories_agentic.jsonl")
    parser.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true", default=True, help="Resume from existing star_trajectories.jsonl")
    parser.add_argument("--no-resume", dest="resume", action="store_false", help="Overwrite star_trajectories.jsonl")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=str, default="star_trajectories.jsonl", help="Output file path")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_star_pipeline(
        model_path=args.model,
        num_tasks=args.tasks,
        max_turns=args.max_turns,
        merge_output=args.merge,
        resume=args.resume,
        output_file=args.output
    )
```

```python
Only trajectories that follow the agent protocol and do not overlap the held-out
evaluation prompts are eligible for the default output.  The older synthetic and
generic TypeScript generators remain below for experimentation, but are
deliberately not included: they are not task-verified agent rollouts.

def create_episode(task_id, user_prompt, t1_thought, t1_tsx, t1_obs, t2_thought, t2_tsx, finish_summary):
    return {
        "task_id": task_id,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
            {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt},
            {
                "role": "assistant",
                "content": f"<thought>\n{t1_thought}\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_component\">\n<tsx>\n{t1_tsx.strip()}\n</tsx>\n</tool_call>"
            },
            {"role": "user", "content": t1_obs},
            {
                "role": "assistant",
                "content": f"<thought>\n{t2_thought}\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_component\">\n<tsx>\n{t2_tsx.strip()}\n</tsx>\n</tool_call>"
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "<observation status=\"passed\">\n[TSC]: Passed (0 errors)\n[Vitest]: All tests passed successfully!\n</observation>"
            },
            {
                "role": "assistant",
                "content": f"<thought>\nAll test assertions and typechecks have passed.\n</thought>\n<finish>\n{finish_summary}\n</finish>"
            }
        ]
    }


def generate_imperative_episodes():

        task_id="imperative_use_confirm",

Render 'OK' and 'Cancel' buttons in the dialog.\nIMPORTANT: Export the following named export(s): `ConfirmDialog`, `useConfirm`.",
        t1_thought="I'll create a useConfirm hook that renders a ConfirmDialog in local JSX.",
        t1_tsx="""import React, { useState } from 'react';

interface DialogState {
  isOpen: boolean;
  message: string;
  resolve?: (val: boolean) => void;
}

export function ConfirmDialog({ isOpen, message, onConfirm, onCancel }: any) {
  if (!isOpen) return null;
  return (
    <div role="dialog">
      <p>{message}</p>
      <button onClick={onConfirm}>OK</button>
      <button onClick={onCancel}>Cancel</button>
    </div>
  );
}

export function useConfirm() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<DialogState>({ isOpen: false, message: '' });

  const confirm = (message: string) => {
    return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
      setState({ isOpen: true, message, resolve });
    });
  };

  return confirm;
}""",
        t1_obs="""<observation status="failed">
[TSC]: Passed (0 syntax/type errors)
[PRIMARY TEST FAILURE - FIX REQUIRED]:
--> TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an element with the text: Are you sure?

[Vitest Test Failure Details]:
Test harness calls confirm = useConfirm() but does not render ConfirmDialog in its own JSX. The dialog must be mounted into document.body via ReactDOM.createPortal so it is visible whenever confirm() is active.
</observation>""",
        t2_thought="Looking at the failure observation, the test caller invokes confirm = useConfirm() without explicitly rendering ConfirmDialog in their component JSX. Therefore, useConfirm must use the Imperative DOM Dynamic Container pattern: dynamically creating a container element, appending it to document.body, rendering ConfirmDialog via createRoot, and cleaning up the container upon promise resolution.",
        t2_tsx="""import React from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';

export interface ConfirmDialogProps {
  message: string;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export function ConfirmDialog({ message, onConfirm, onCancel }: ConfirmDialogProps) {
  return (
    <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" data-testid="confirm-dialog" style={{ position: 'fixed', top: '20%', left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #ccc', padding: 20, zIndex: 9999 }}>
      <p>{message}</p>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 16 }}>
        <button onClick={onConfirm}>OK</button>
        <button onClick={onCancel}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function useConfirm() {
  return (message: string): Promise<boolean> => {
    return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
      const container = document.createElement('div');
      document.body.appendChild(container);
      const root = createRoot(container);
      const cleanup = (val: boolean) => {
        root.unmount();
        container.remove();
        resolve(val);
      };
      root.render(
        <ConfirmDialog
          message={message}
          onConfirm={() => cleanup(true)}
          onCancel={() => cleanup(false)}
        />
      );
    });
  };
}""",
        finish_summary="Implemented useConfirm and ConfirmDialog with dynamic DOM container mounting into document.body and promise-based OK/Cancel resolution."

export function useToast() {

    if (!toastRegion) {
      toastRegion = document.createElement('div');
      toastRegion.setAttribute('role', 'region');
      toastRegion.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Notifications');
      toastRegion.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:16px;right:16px;z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;';
      document.body.appendChild(toastRegion);
    }

    const itemContainer = document.createElement('div');
    toastRegion.appendChild(itemContainer);
    const root = createRoot(itemContainer);

    const close = () => {
      root.unmount();
      itemContainer.remove();
    };

    root.render(<Toast message={message} onClose={close} />);

    if (duration > 0) {
      setTimeout(close, duration);
    }
  };
}""",

        t2_tsx="""import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';

export function PromptDialog({ question, defaultValue = '', onResolve }: any) {
  const [val, setVal] = useState(defaultValue);
  return (
    <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 9999 }}>
      <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); onResolve(val); }} style={{ background: '#fff', padding: 24, borderRadius: 8, minWidth: 300 }}>
        <p>{question}</p>
        <input
          type="text"
          value={val}
          onChange={(e) => setVal(e.target.value)}
          autoFocus
          style={{ width: '100%', marginBottom: 16 }}
        />
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => onResolve(null)}>Cancel</button>
          <button type="submit">Submit</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

export function usePrompt() {
  return (question: string, defaultValue: string = ''): Promise<string | null> => {
    return new Promise<string | null>((resolve) => {
      const container = document.createElement('div');
      document.body.appendChild(container);
      const root = createRoot(container);
      const cleanup = (val: string | null) => {
        root.unmount();
        container.remove();
        resolve(val);
      };
      root.render(<PromptDialog question={question} defaultValue={defaultValue} onResolve={cleanup} />);
    });
  };
}""",

        t2_tsx="""import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

export function useModal() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const open = useCallback(() => setIsOpen(true), []);
  const close = useCallback(() => setIsOpen(false), []);

  function Modal({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    useEffect(() => {
      if (!isOpen) return;
      const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') close();
      };
      window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    }, [isOpen]);

    if (!isOpen || typeof document === 'undefined') return null;

    return createPortal(
      <div
        data-testid="modal-backdrop"
        onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) close(); }}
        style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', zIndex: 9999, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}
      >
        <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" style={{ background: '#fff', padding: 20, borderRadius: 8 }}>
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>,
      document.body
    );
  }

  return { isOpen, open, close, Modal };
}""",

export function useAsyncValidation(value: string, validateFn: any) {
  const [isValidating, setIsValidating] = useState(false);

--> AssertionError: expected "spy" to not be called at all, but actually been called 3 times
</observation>"""
                t2_thought = "The test expects validation to be debounced so rapid rerenders do not invoke the validator until timers advance. I must wrap validateFn in a setTimeout and return a cleanup function that clears the timeout."
                t2_tsx = """import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export function useAsyncValidation(
  value: string,
  validateFn: (v: string) => Promise<boolean>,
  delay: number = 300
) {
  const [isValidating, setIsValidating] = useState(false);
  const [isValid, setIsValid] = useState<boolean | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setIsValidating(true);
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await validateFn(value);
        if (active) {
          setIsValid(res);
          setIsValidating(false);
        }
      } catch {
        if (active) {
          setIsValid(false);
          setIsValidating(false);
        }
      }
    }, delay);

    return () => {
      active = false;
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [value, validateFn, delay]);

  return { isValidating, isValid };
}"""

                t2_thought = f"The button element did not attach onClick to call the onAction or onClick handler passed via props. I will wire up the click event handler."

export function {cat_name}(props: any) {{

  return (
    <button
      role="{role}"
      aria-label="{cat_name}"
      onClick={{handleClick}}
    >
      {desc}
    </button>
  );
}}"""
            else:
                t1_tsx = f"""import React from 'react';
export function {cat_name}(props: any) {{
  return <div role="{role}" onClick={{props.onClose}}>{desc}</div>;
}}"""
                t1_obs = f"""<observation status="failed">
[TSC]: Passed (0 syntax/type errors)
[PRIMARY TEST FAILURE - FIX REQUIRED]:
--> AssertionError: expected onClose to be called on Escape keydown, but it was not called
</observation>"""
                t2_thought = f"I must add a window keydown event listener inside useEffect to handle the Escape key and trigger props.onClose."
                t2_tsx = f"""import React, {{ useEffect }} from 'react';

export function {cat_name}(props: any) {{
  useEffect(() => {{
    const handleKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {{
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && props.onClose) props.onClose();
    }};
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
  }}, [props.onClose]);

  return (
    <div role="{role}" aria-label="{cat_name}" onClick={{props.onClose}}>
      {desc}
      {{props.children}}
```
