value: string; }\n\nconst STATS: Stat[] = [\n  { label: 'Acres Reforested', value: '42,000+' },\n  { label: 'Trees Planted', value: '1.8M' },\n  { label: 'Local Partners', value: '63' },\n  { label: 'Volunteer Hours', value: '210,000' },\n];\n\nexport function Impact() {\n  return (\n    <section className=\"gh-impact\" id=\"impact\" aria-labelledby=\"gh-impact-heading\">\n      <div className=\"gh-impact__inner\">\n        <div className=\"gh-impact__header\">\n          <p className=\"gh-impact__eyebrow\">Our Impact</p>\n          <h2 id=\"gh-impact-heading\" className=\"gh-impact__title\">Numbers That Matter</h2>\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"gh-impact__grid\">\n          {STATS.map(s => (\n            <li key={s.label} className=\"gh-stat\">\n              <span className=\"gh-stat__value\">{s.value}</span>\n              <span className=\"gh-stat__label\">{s.label}</span>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Impact.css\">\n.gh-impact {\n  padding: 6.5rem 2rem;\n  background: #0f2a1c;\n  border-top: 1px solid rgba(132,204,22,0.1);\n}\n.gh-impact__inner { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }\n.gh-impact__header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3.5rem; }\n.gh-impact__eyebrow {\n  font-size: 0.75rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  letter-spacing: 0.2em;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  color: #84cc16;\n  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;\n}\n.gh-impact__title {\n  font-family: 'Merriweather', serif;\n  font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem);\n  color: #f0fdf4;\n  margin: 0;\n}\n.gh-impact__grid {\n  display: grid;\n  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);\n  gap: 1.5rem;\n  list-style: none;\n  margin: 0;\n  padding: 0;\n}\n.gh-stat {\n  text-align: center;\n  padding: 2rem 1rem;\n  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);\n  border: 1px solid rgba(132,204,22,0.12);\n  border-radius: 12px;\n  transition: transform 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;\n}\n.gh-stat:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgba(132,204,22,0.35); }\n.gh-stat__value {\n  display: block;\n  font-family: 'Merriweather', serif;\n  font-size: 2.2rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  color: #a3e635;\n  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;\n  letter-spacing: -0.02em;\n}\n.gh-stat__label {\n  display: block;\n  font-size: 0.85rem;\n  color: #9cb0a1;\n  font-weight: 500;\n}\n@media (max-width: 800px) { .gh-impact__grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }\n@media (max-width: 480px) { .gh-impact__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Impact.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Impact.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Footer section: dark green footer with org name, address, contact email, donate note, and copyright. text-decoration: none; }\n.gh-footer__link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }\n.gh-footer__note { font-size: 0.8rem; color: #5c7263; }\n.gh-footer__bottom {\n  max-width: 1080px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 1.5rem 0;\n  text-align: center;\n  font-size: 0.78rem;\n  color: #24352b;\n}\n@media (max-width: 640px) {\n  .gh-footer__inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; ' hv-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"hv-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"hv-header__logo\">Harbor View Realty</a>\n        <nav className=\"hv-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"hv-header__link\">Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#listings\" className=\"hv-header__link\">Featured Listings</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"hv-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n        <a href=\"mailto:info@harborviewrealty.com\" className=\"hv-header__cta\">Schedule a Showing</a>\n      </div>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.hv-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(12, 30, 46, 0.9);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 164, 0.15);\n  transition: box-shadow 0.3s;\n}\n.hv-header--scrolled { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }\n.hv-header__inner {\n  max-width: 1200px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 74px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  gap: 1.5rem;\n}\n.hv-header__logo {\n  font-family: 'Libre Baskerville', serif;\n  font-size: 1.15rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  color: #f0f9f9;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n.hv-header__nav { display: flex; {"task_id": "star_127", "symbol": "useLocalStorageState", "category": "hooks_state", "check": "tsc_render_interact", "prompt": "Write a React TypeScript custom hook `useLocalStorageState<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): [T, (val: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void]`. {"task_id": 76, "primary_symbol": "useFetch", "prompt": "Write a generic custom hook `useFetch<T>(url: string): {data: T | null, error: Error | null, loading: boolean}` using `fetch` with `AbortController` cleanup on unmount or url change.", "chosen": "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\n\nexport function useFetch<T>(url: string): { data: T | null, error: any, loading: boolean } {\n  const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null);\n  const [error, setError] = useState<any>(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    let isActive = true;\n    const abortController = new AbortController();\n\n    fetch(url, { signal: abortController.signal })\n      .then((res) => res.json())\n      .then((d) => {\n        if (isActive) {\n          setData(d);\n          setLoading(false);\n        }\n      })\n      .catch((err) => {\n        if (isActive) {\n          setError(err);\n          setLoading(false);\n        }\n      });\n\n    return () => {\n      isActive = false;\n      abortController.abort();\n    };\n  }, [url]);\n\n  return { data, error, loading };\n}", "rejected": "import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\n\nexport function useFetch<T>(url: string): { data: T | null; error: Error | null; loading: boolean } {\n  const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null);\n  const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    let isActive = true;\n    const abortController = new AbortController();\n\n    async function fetchData() {\n      try {\n        const response = await fetch(url, { signal: abortController.signal });\n        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP error! {"prompt": "Build a `ThemeToggle` button that switches between light/dark by toggling a `data-theme` attribute on `document.documentElement` and persists the choice to `localStorage`.", "check": "tsc_render_interact", "test_code": "it('toggles the data-theme attribute on the document element', async () => {\n  const user = userEvent.setup();\n  document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme');\n  render(<ThemeToggle />);\n  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button'));\n  expect(document.documentElement).toHaveAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');\n  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button'));\n  expect(document.documentElement).toHaveAttribute('data-theme', 'light');\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a `CookieConsentBanner` component shown until the user clicks 'Accept', persisting dismissal to `localStorage` so it doesn't reappear.", "check": "tsc_render_interact", "test_code": "it('hides itself after Accept is clicked and stays hidden on remount', async () => {\n  const user = userEvent.setup();\n  localStorage.clear();\n  const { unmount } = render(<CookieConsentBanner />);\n  expect(screen.getByText(/cookie/i)).toBeInTheDocument();\n  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /accept/i }));\n  expect(screen.queryByText(/cookie/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n  unmount();\n  render(<CookieConsentBanner />);\n  expect(screen.queryByText(/cookie/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n});"}

{"prompt": "Write a `QuantityStepper` numeric input with +/- buttons (accessible names '+' and '-') that clamps the value to `min`/`max` and disables the relevant button at each bound.", "check": "tsc_render_interact", "test_code": "it('disables the decrement button at the min bound and calls onChange on increment', async () => {\n  const user = userEvent.setup();\n  const onChange = vi.fn();\n  render(<QuantityStepper value={1} min={1} max={10} onChange={onChange} />);\n  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '-' })).toBeDisabled();\n  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '+' }));\n  expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(2);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Build a `PromoCodeInput` field with an 'Apply' button that calls an async `validateCode(code: string): Promise<boolean>` prop and shows an inline success or error message.", "check": "tsc_render_interact", "test_code": "it('shows a success message when validateCode resolves true', async () => {\n  const user = userEvent.setup();\n  const validateCode = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true);\n  render(<PromoCodeInput validateCode={validateCode} />);\n  await user.type(screen.getByRole('textbox'), 'SAVE10');\n  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /apply/i }));\n  expect(validateCode).toHaveBeenCalledWith('SAVE10');\n  expect(await screen.findByText(/applied|success/i)).toBeInTheDocument();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a `useConfirm()` hook plus a reusable `ConfirmDialog` component so any code can call `await confirm('Are you sure?')` and get a boolean result. Render 'OK' and 'Cancel' buttons in the dialog.", "check": "tsc_render_interact", "test_code": "function TestHarness() {\n  const confirm = useConfirm();\n  const [result, setResult] = React.useState('');\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <button onClick={async () => setResult(String(await confirm('Are you sure?')))}>Ask</button>\n      <p>Result: {result}</p>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nit('resolves true when OK is clicked', async () => {\n  const user = userEvent.setup();\n  render(<TestHarness />);\n  await user.click(screen.getByText('Ask'));\n  expect(screen.getByText('Are you sure?')).toBeInTheDocument();\n  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'OK' }));\n  expect(await screen.findByText('Result: true')).toBeInTheDocument();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Build a `SegmentedControl` component (tab-styled radio group) with `options`, `value`, `onChange`, highlighting the selected pill. Implement each option as a `role=\"radio\"` element inside a `role=\"radiogroup\"` container.", "check": "tsc_render_interact", "test_code": "it('calls onChange with the clicked option value', async () => {\n  const user = userEvent.setup();\n  const onChange = vi.fn();\n  render(\n    <SegmentedControl\n      options={[{ label: 'Day', value: 'day' }, { label: 'Week', value: 'week' }]}\n      value=\"day\"\n      onChange={onChange}\n    />\n  );\n  await user.click(screen.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Week' }));\n  expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith('week');\n});"}

{"prompt": "Build a `WishlistButton` heart-icon toggle component with a controlled `isSaved` boolean and a brief CSS scale/pulse animation on click.", "check": "tsc_render_interact", "test_code": "it('toggles isSaved when clicked', async () => {\n  const user = userEvent.setup();\n  const onChange = vi.fn();\n  render(<WishlistButton isSaved={false} onChange={onChange} />);\n  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button'));\n  expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(true);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a `ShareButtonGroup` component rendering share links for a given `url` and `title` (copy-link, and two placeholder social buttons), with copy-link showing a 'Copied' tooltip.", "check": "tsc_render_interact", "test_code": "it('copies the url and shows a Copied tooltip', async () => {\n  const user = userEvent.setup();\n  const writeText = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);\n  Object.assign(navigator, { clipboard: { writeText } });\n  render(<ShareButtonGroup url=\"https://example.com/post\" title=\"My Post\" />);\n  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /copy/i }));\n  expect(writeText).toHaveBeenCalledWith('https://example.com/post');\n  expect(await screen.findByText(/copied/i)).toBeInTheDocument();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useThrottledCallback<Args extends unknown[]>(fn: (...args: Args) => void, limitMs: number)` that returns a throttled version of `fn`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('only invokes fn once within the limit window', () => {\n  vi.useFakeTimers();\n  const fn = vi.fn();\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useThrottledCallback(fn, 200));\n  act(() => { result.current('a'); result.current('b'); });\n  expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n  expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a');\n  vi.advanceTimersByTime(200);\n  act(() => result.current('c'));\n  expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);\n  vi.useRealTimers();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useLocalStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): [T, (value: T) => void]` synced to `localStorage`, handling JSON parse errors gracefully by falling back to `initialValue`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('persists the value to localStorage and falls back on bad JSON', () => {\n  localStorage.clear();\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useLocalStorage('count', 0));\n  act(() => result.current[1](5));\n  expect(localStorage.getItem('count')).toBe('5');\n\n  localStorage.setItem('broken', '{not json');\n  const { result: result2 } = renderHook(() => useLocalStorage('broken', 42));\n  expect(result2.current[0]).toBe(42);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useSessionStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T)` analogous to `useLocalStorage` but backed by `sessionStorage`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('persists the value to sessionStorage', () => {\n  sessionStorage.clear();\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useSessionStorage('draft', ''));\n  act(() => result.current[1]('hello'));\n  expect(sessionStorage.getItem('draft')).toBe(JSON.stringify('hello'));\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `usePrevious<T>(value: T): T | undefined` that returns the value from the previous render.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('returns the value from the previous render', () => {\n  const { result, rerender } = renderHook(({ value }) => usePrevious(value), { initialProps: { value: 1 } });\n  expect(result.current).toBeUndefined();\n  rerender({ value: 2 });\n  expect(result.current).toBe(1);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useToggle(initial?: boolean): [boolean, () => void]` for toggling a boolean flag.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('toggles the boolean value', () => {\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useToggle(false));\n  expect(result.current[0]).toBe(false);\n  act(() => result.current[1]());\n  expect(result.current[0]).toBe(true);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useCounter(initial?: number, options?: {min?: number, max?: number, step?: number})` returning `{count, increment, decrement, reset}`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('increments and clamps to max', () => {\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useCounter(0, { min: 0, max: 2 }));\n  act(() => result.current.increment());\n  act(() => result.current.increment());\n  act(() => result.current.increment());\n  expect(result.current.count).toBe(2);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useWindowSize(): {width: number, height: number}` that updates on window resize via a debounced listener.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('updates when the window is resized', () => {\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useWindowSize());\n  const initialWidth = result.current.width;\n  Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerWidth', { value: initialWidth + 200, configurable: true });\n  act(() => { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); });\n  expect(result.current.width).toBe(initialWidth + 200);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useMediaQuery(query: string): boolean` wrapping `window.matchMedia` and updating on change events.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('reflects matchMedia and updates on change', () => {\n  let changeHandler: (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => void = () => {};\n  window.matchMedia = vi.fn().mockImplementation((query: string) => ({\n    matches: false,\n    media: query,\n    addEventListener: (_: string, cb: any) => { changeHandler = cb; },\n    removeEventListener: () => {},\n  })) as any;\n\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useMediaQuery('(min-width: 768px)'));\n  expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n  act(() => changeHandler({ matches: true } as MediaQueryListEvent));\n  expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useOnClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement>(ref: RefObject<T>, handler: () => void)` that attaches and cleans up a document click listener.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('calls the handler only on outside clicks', () => {\n  const handler = vi.fn();\n  function Harness() {\n    const ref = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n    useOnClickOutside(ref, handler);\n    return (\n      <div>\n        <div data-testid=\"inside\" ref={ref}>Inside</div>\n        <div data-testid=\"outside\">Outside</div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n  render(<Harness />);\n  fireEvent.mouseDown(screen.getByTestId('inside'));\n  expect(handler).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  fireEvent.mouseDown(screen.getByTestId('outside'));\n  expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useHover<T extends HTMLElement>(): [RefObject<T>, boolean]` tracking whether the ref'd element is currently hovered.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('tracks hover state on the referenced element', () => {\n  function Harness() {\n    const [ref, isHovered] = useHover<HTMLDivElement>();\n    return <div ref={ref} data-testid=\"target\">{isHovered ? 'hovered' : 'idle'}</div>;\n  }\n  render(<Harness />);\n  const target = screen.getByTestId('target');\n  expect(target).toHaveTextContent('idle');\n  fireEvent.mouseEnter(target);\n  expect(target).toHaveTextContent('hovered');\n  fireEvent.mouseLeave(target);\n  expect(target).toHaveTextContent('idle');\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useKeyPress(targetKey: string): boolean` that returns whether the given key is currently held down.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('reflects whether the target key is held down', () => {\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useKeyPress('Escape'));\n  expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n  act(() => { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })); });\n  expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n  act(() => { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key: 'Escape' })); });\n  expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useCopyToClipboard(): [copiedText: string | null, copy: (text: string) => Promise<boolean>]`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('copies text and stores the copied value', async () => {\n  const writeText = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);\n  Object.assign(navigator, { clipboard: { writeText } });\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useCopyToClipboard());\n  await act(async () => { await result.current[1]('hello world'); });\n  expect(writeText).toHaveBeenCalledWith('hello world');\n  expect(result.current[0]).toBe('hello world');\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a generic custom hook `useAsync<T>(asyncFn: () => Promise<T>, deps: unknown[]): {data: T | null, error: Error | null, loading: boolean}` that re-runs when `deps` change.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('resolves with data and clears the loading flag', async () => {\n  const asyncFn = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('done');\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useAsync(asyncFn, []));\n  expect(result.current.loading).toBe(true);\n  await act(async () => {});\n  expect(result.current.data).toBe('done');\n  expect(result.current.loading).toBe(false);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a generic custom hook `useFetch<T>(url: string): {data: T | null, error: Error | null, loading: boolean}` using `fetch` with `AbortController` cleanup on unmount or url change.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('fetches data for the given url', async () => {\n  global.fetch = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ json: async () => ({ id: 1 }) }) as any;\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useFetch<{ id: number }>('/api/item'));\n  await act(async () => {});\n  expect(result.current.data).toEqual({ id: 1 });\n  expect(result.current.loading).toBe(false);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useInterval(callback: () => void, delayMs: number | null)` where passing `null` pauses the interval, cleaning it up on unmount.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('calls the callback every delayMs and pauses when delay is null', () => {\n  vi.useFakeTimers();\n  const callback = vi.fn();\n  const { rerender } = renderHook(({ delay }) => useInterval(callback, delay), { initialProps: { delay: 100 as number | null } });\n  vi.advanceTimersByTime(300);\n  expect(callback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);\n  rerender({ delay: null });\n  callback.mockClear();\n  vi.advanceTimersByTime(300);\n  expect(callback).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  vi.useRealTimers();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useIsMounted(): () => boolean` returning a stable function for checking whether the component is still mounted before calling `setState`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('returns false after unmount', () => {\n  const { result, unmount } = renderHook(() => useIsMounted());\n  expect(result.current()).toBe(true);\n  unmount();\n  expect(result.current()).toBe(false);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a generic custom hook `useEventListener<K extends keyof WindowEventMap>(eventName: K, handler: (e: WindowEventMap[K]) => void)` attached to `window`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('attaches and cleans up the window event listener', () => {\n  const handler = vi.fn();\n  const { unmount } = renderHook(() => useEventListener('resize', handler));\n  act(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')));\n  expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n  unmount();\n  handler.mockClear();\n  act(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')));\n  expect(handler).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useIntersectionObserver(ref: RefObject<Element>, options?: IntersectionObserverInit): boolean` returning whether the element is currently in view.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('reflects the intersection state of the observed element', () => {\n  let cb: IntersectionObserverCallback = () => {};\n  class MockIO {\n    constructor(c: IntersectionObserverCallback) { cb = c; }\n    observe() {}\n    unobserve() {}\n    disconnect() {}\n  }\n  // @ts-expect-error test stub\n  window.IntersectionObserver = MockIO;\n  const ref = { current: document.createElement('div') };\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useIntersectionObserver(ref));\n  expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n  act(() => cb([{ isIntersecting: true } as IntersectionObserverEntry], {} as IntersectionObserver));\n  expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useScrollPosition(): {x: number, y: number}` tracking `window.scrollX`/`scrollY` with a passive scroll listener.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('tracks window scroll position', () => {\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useScrollPosition());\n  expect(result.current).toEqual({ x: 0, y: 0 });\n  Object.defineProperty(window, 'scrollY', { value: 250, configurable: true });\n  act(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll')));\n  expect(result.current.y).toBe(250);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useOnlineStatus(): boolean` tracking `navigator.onLine` with `online`/`offline` window event listeners.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('reflects navigator.onLine and updates on offline/online events', () => {\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useOnlineStatus());\n  expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n  act(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('offline')));\n  expect(result.current).toBe(false);\n  act(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('online')));\n  expect(result.current).toBe(true);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useGeolocation(): {coords: GeolocationCoordinates | null, error: string | null, loading: boolean}` wrapping `navigator.geolocation.watchPosition`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('reports coords from watchPosition', () => {\n  const watchPosition = vi.fn((success: PositionCallback) => {\n    success({ coords: { latitude: 1, longitude: 2 } } as GeolocationPosition);\n    return 1;\n  });\n  Object.assign(navigator, { geolocation: { watchPosition, clearWatch: vi.fn() } });\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useGeolocation());\n  expect(result.current.coords).toEqual({ latitude: 1, longitude: 2 });\n  expect(result.current.loading).toBe(false);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useDarkMode(): [boolean, (value: boolean) => void]` that defaults to `prefers-color-scheme` and persists any manual override to `localStorage`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('persists a manual override to localStorage', () => {\n  localStorage.clear();\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useDarkMode());\n  act(() => result.current[1](true));\n  expect(result.current[0]).toBe(true);\n  expect(localStorage.getItem('dark-mode')).toBe('true');\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a generic custom hook `usePagination<T>(items: T[], pageSize: number)` returning `{currentPageItems, page, totalPages, nextPage, prevPage, goToPage}`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('slices items by page and reports totalPages', () => {\n  const items = Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => i);\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => usePagination(items, 10));\n  expect(result.current.currentPageItems).toEqual(items.slice(0, 10));\n  expect(result.current.totalPages).toBe(3);\n  act(() => result.current.nextPage());\n  expect(result.current.currentPageItems).toEqual(items.slice(10, 20));\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a generic custom hook `useForm<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(initialValues: T)` returning `{values, errors, handleChange, handleSubmit, reset}` with a pluggable `validate` function. Accept the `validate` function as `useForm(initialValues, validate)`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('updates values on change and surfaces validation errors on submit', () => {\n  const { result } = renderHook(() =>\n    useForm({ email: '' }, (values: { email: string }) => (values.email ? {} : { email: 'Required' }))\n  );\n  act(() => result.current.handleChange('email', 'a@b.com'));\n  expect(result.current.values.email).toBe('a@b.com');\n  act(() => result.current.handleSubmit(vi.fn())());\n  expect(result.current.errors).toEqual({});\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a generic custom hook `useUndo<T>(initialPresent: T)` returning `{state, set, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo}`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('supports undo and redo of state changes', () => {\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useUndo(0));\n  act(() => result.current.set(1));\n  act(() => result.current.set(2));\n  expect(result.current.state).toBe(2);\n  act(() => result.current.undo());\n  expect(result.current.state).toBe(1);\n  act(() => result.current.redo());\n  expect(result.current.state).toBe(2);\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a generic custom hook `useQueryParams<T extends Record<string, string>>(): [T, (params: Partial<T>) => void]` reading and writing `URLSearchParams` and syncing to browser history.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('reads and writes URLSearchParams', () => {\n  window.history.pushState({}, '', '/?page=1');\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useQueryParams<{ page: string }>());\n  expect(result.current[0].page).toBe('1');\n  act(() => result.current[1]({ page: '2' }));\n  expect(window.location.search).toContain('page=2');\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useAbortableFetch<T>(url: string)` that cancels the previous in-flight request whenever `url` changes before the prior one resolves.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('aborts the previous request when the url changes', () => {\n  const abort = vi.fn();\n  global.fetch = vi.fn().mockImplementation(() => new Promise(() => {})) as any;\n  const OriginalController = global.AbortController;\n  // @ts-expect-error test stub\n  global.AbortController = vi.fn().mockImplementation(() => ({ signal: {}, abort }));\n  const { rerender } = renderHook(({ url }) => useAbortableFetch(url), { initialProps: { url: '/a' } });\n  rerender({ url: '/b' });\n  expect(abort).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n  global.AbortController = OriginalController;\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useIdleTimer(timeoutMs: number, onIdle: () => void)` that resets a timer on mouse/keyboard activity and calls `onIdle` after `timeoutMs` of inactivity.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('calls onIdle after timeoutMs of inactivity and resets on activity', () => {\n  vi.useFakeTimers();\n  const onIdle = vi.fn();\n  renderHook(() => useIdleTimer(1000, onIdle));\n  vi.advanceTimersByTime(999);\n  expect(onIdle).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  act(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('mousemove')));\n  vi.advanceTimersByTime(999);\n  expect(onIdle).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  vi.advanceTimersByTime(2);\n  expect(onIdle).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n  vi.useRealTimers();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useLongPress(callback: () => void, ms?: number)` returning event handlers `{onMouseDown, onMouseUp, onMouseLeave, onTouchStart, onTouchEnd}` to spread onto an element.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('fires the callback after a sustained press', () => {\n  vi.useFakeTimers();\n  const callback = vi.fn();\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useLongPress(callback, 500));\n  function Harness() {\n    return <button {...result.current}>Press</button>;\n  }\n  render(<Harness />);\n  fireEvent.mouseDown(screen.getByText('Press'));\n  vi.advanceTimersByTime(500);\n  expect(callback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n  fireEvent.mouseUp(screen.getByText('Press'));\n  vi.useRealTimers();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a generic custom hook `useResizeObserver<T extends HTMLElement>(): [RefObject<T>, DOMRectReadOnly | null]` tracking an element's size changes.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('reports the observed element size on resize', () => {\n  let cb: ResizeObserverCallback = () => {};\n  class MockRO {\n    constructor(c: ResizeObserverCallback) { cb = c; }\n    observe() {}\n    unobserve() {}\n    disconnect() {}\n  }\n  // @ts-expect-error test stub\n  window.ResizeObserver = MockRO;\n  function Harness() {\n    const [ref, rect] = useResizeObserver<HTMLDivElement>();\n    return <div ref={ref}>{rect ? `${rect.width}x${rect.height}` : 'none'}</div>;\n  }\n  render(<Harness />);\n  act(() => cb([{ contentRect: { width: 200, height: 100 } } as ResizeObserverEntry], {} as ResizeObserver));\n  expect(screen.getByText('200x100')).toBeInTheDocument();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `usePortal(id: string): HTMLElement` that creates (or reuses) a DOM node appended to `document.body`, cleaning it up on unmount if it created it.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('creates a DOM node under document.body and removes it on unmount', () => {\n  const { result, unmount } = renderHook(() => usePortal('my-portal'));\n  expect(document.getElementById('my-portal')).toBe(result.current);\n  unmount();\n  expect(document.getElementById('my-portal')).toBeNull();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useLockBodyScroll(locked: boolean)` that sets `document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'` while `locked` is true, restoring the previous value on cleanup.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('locks and restores document.body overflow', () => {\n  document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';\n  const { rerender } = renderHook(({ locked }) => useLockBodyScroll(locked), { initialProps: { locked: true } });\n  expect(document.body.style.overflow).toBe('hidden');\n  rerender({ locked: false });\n  expect(document.body.style.overflow).toBe('auto');\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useCountdown(targetTimestamp: number): {days: number, hours: number, minutes: number, seconds: number, isExpired: boolean}` that recalculates every second.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('counts down and reports isExpired once the target is reached', () => {\n  vi.useFakeTimers();\n  const target = Date.now() + 2000;\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useCountdown(target));\n  expect(result.current.isExpired).toBe(false);\n  act(() => { vi.advanceTimersByTime(2100); });\n  expect(result.current.isExpired).toBe(true);\n  vi.useRealTimers();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useStopwatch(): {elapsedMs: number, isRunning: boolean, start: () => void, pause: () => void, reset: () => void}`.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('accumulates elapsed time while running and stops on pause', () => {\n  vi.useFakeTimers();\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useStopwatch());\n  act(() => result.current.start());\n  act(() => { vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000); });\n  expect(result.current.elapsedMs).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1000);\n  act(() => result.current.pause());\n  const paused = result.current.elapsedMs;\n  act(() => { vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000); });\n  expect(result.current.elapsedMs).toBe(paused);\n  vi.useRealTimers();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a custom hook `useStep(totalSteps: number)` returning `{currentStep, next, back, goTo, isFirst, isLast}`, clamped to the valid `[0, totalSteps - 1]` range.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('clamps step navigation to the valid range', () => {\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useStep(3));\n  expect(result.current.isFirst).toBe(true);\n  act(() => result.current.back());\n  expect(result.current.currentStep).toBe(0);\n  act(() => result.current.goTo(2));\n  expect(result.current.isLast).toBe(true);\n  act(() => result.current.next());\n  expect(result.current.currentStep).toBe(2);\n});"}

{"prompt": "Build a `FormContext`, `FormProvider`, and `useFormContext()` hook trio using React Context, throwing a runtime error if `useFormContext` is called outside of `FormProvider`.", "check": "tsc_and_render", "test_code": "it('throws when useFormContext is used outside FormProvider', () => {\n  const spy = vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});\n  function Consumer() {\n    useFormContext();\n    return null;\n  }\n  expect(() => render(<Consumer />)).toThrow();\n  spy.mockRestore();\n});\n\nit('provides context values inside FormProvider', () => {\n  function Consumer() {\n    const ctx = useFormContext();\n    return <p>{JSON.stringify(ctx.values)}</p>;\n  }\n  render(\n    <FormProvider initialValues={{ name: '' }}>\n      <Consumer />\n    </FormProvider>\n  );\n  expect(screen.getByText('{\"name\":\"\"}')).toBeInTheDocument();\n});"}
{"prompt": "Write a `cartReducer(state: CartState, action: CartAction)` reducer with a discriminated-union `CartAction` type (`'ADD_ITEM' | 'REMOVE_ITEM' | 'CLEAR'`), plus a `useReducer`-based `useCart()` hook wrapping it.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('adds and removes items via the reducer', () => {\n  const state1 = cartReducer({ items: [] }, { type: 'ADD_ITEM', item: { id: '1', qty: 1 } });\n  expect(state1.items).toHaveLength(1);\n  const state2 = cartReducer(state1, { type: 'REMOVE_ITEM', id: '1' });\n  expect(state2.items).toHaveLength(0);\n});\n\nit('useCart exposes dispatchable cart state', () => {\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useCart());\n  act(() => result.current.dispatch({ type: 'ADD_ITEM', item: { id: '1', qty: 2 } }));\n  expect(result.current.state.items).toEqual([{ id: '1', qty: 2 }]);\n});"}

{"prompt": "Build an `ErrorBoundary` typed with `componentDidCatch` and a `fallback: React.ReactNode | ((error: Error) => React.ReactNode)` prop that supports both a static node and a render function.", "check": "tsc_and_render", "test_code": "function Bomb(): JSX.Element {\n  throw new Error('boom');\n}\n\nit('supports both a static fallback node and a fallback render function', () => {\n  const spy = vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});\n  const { rerender } = render(\n    <ErrorBoundary fallback={<p>Static fallback</p>}>\n      <Bomb />\n    </ErrorBoundary>\n  );\n  expect(screen.getByText('Static fallback')).toBeInTheDocument();\n\n  rerender(\n    <ErrorBoundary fallback={(error: Error) => <p>Error: {error.message}</p>}>\n      <Bomb />\n    </ErrorBoundary>\n  );\n  expect(screen.getByText('Error: boom')).toBeInTheDocument();\n  spy.mockRestore();\n});"}

Cycle red -> green -> yellow -> red; `transition(next)` takes the target state and is typed to only accept the valid next state.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('cycles red -> green -> yellow -> red', () => {\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useTrafficLight());\n  expect(result.current.state).toBe('red');\n  act(() => result.current.transition('green'));\n  expect(result.current.state).toBe('green');\n  act(() => result.current.transition('yellow'));\n  expect(result.current.state).toBe('yellow');\n  act(() => result.current.transition('red'));\n  expect(result.current.state).toBe('red');\n});"}

{"prompt": "Write a generic `useLocalReducer<S, A>(reducer: (state: S, action: A) => S, initialState: S)` wrapper hook that adds a `dispatchLogged` function logging every action before dispatching it.", "check": "tsc_only", "test_code": "it('logs every action before dispatching it', () => {\n  const spy = vi.spyOn(console, 'log').mockImplementation(() => {});\n  const reducer = (state: number, _action: { type: 'inc' }) => state + 1;\n  const { result } = renderHook(() => useLocalReducer(reducer, 0));\n  act(() => result.current.dispatchLogged({ type: 'inc' }));\n  expect(result.current.state).toBe(1);\n  expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ type: 'inc' });\n  spy.mockRestore();\n});"}

))}\n          </ul>\n        </Convoy>\n      ))}\n      {orphans.map((fleetShip: IFleetShip) => (\n        <li key={fleetShip.ship.name}>\n          {fleetShip.ship.isDestroyed ? (\n            <DestroyedShip fleetShip={fleetShip} />\n          ) : (\n            <ActiveShip fleetShip={fleetShip} isCurrent={!!(activeShip && activeShip.ship.id === fleetShip.ship.id)} />\n          )}\n        </li>\n      ))}\n    </NavigationList>\n  );\n};\n\ninterface IProps {\n  fleetShips: IFleetShip[];\n}\n\ninterface IItemProps {\n  fleetShip: IFleetShip;\n  isCurrent?: }\n`;\n\nconst StyledDestroyedShip = styled.div`\n  height: ${NAV_ITEM_HEIGHT};\n  display: flex;\n  opacity: 0.3;\n  font-style: italic;\n  align-items: center;\n  padding: 0 {year} Priya Sharma. {"role": "user", "content": "Build a complete website for the following brief.\n\n<content_brief>\n  <business_name>Miso & Soul</business_name>\n  <tagline>Broth-first ramen, made from scratch daily</tagline>\n  <business_type>restaurant</business_type>\n  <primary_color>#0d0d0d</primary_color>\n  <accent_color>#dc2626</accent_color>\n  <font_heading>Noto Serif JP</font_heading>\n  <font_body>Inter</font_body>\n  <sections>header, hero, menu, footer</sections>\n  <menu_category name=\"Ramen\">\n    <item name=\"Tonkotsu Classic\" price=\"$16\">18-hour pork bone broth, chashu, ajitama, nori</item>\n    <item name=\"Spicy Miso\" price=\"$17\">Fermented miso broth, ground pork, chili oil, corn</item>\n    <item name=\"Shoyu Chicken\" price=\"$15\">Clear soy broth, roast chicken, menma, scallion</item>\n    <item name=\"Vegan Shiitake\" price=\"$14\">Shiitake-kombu broth, tofu, mushrooms, seasonal greens</item>\n  </menu_category>\n  <menu_category name=\"Sides\">\n    <item name=\"Karaage\" price=\"$9\">Japanese fried chicken thigh, yuzu kosho mayo</item>\n    <item name=\"Gyoza (5pc)\" price=\"$8\">Pan-seared pork dumplings, chili vinegar</item>\n    <item name=\"Steamed Bao (2pc)\" price=\"$7\">Pork belly, hoisin, pickled cucumber</item>\n  </menu_category>\n  <menu_category name=\"Drinks\">\n    <item name=\"Ramune\" price=\"$4\">Classic Japanese marble soda</item>\n    <item name=\"Asahi Draft\" price=\"$8\">Japanese lager, 425ml</item>\n    <item name=\"Iced Genmaicha\" price=\"$5\">Roasted brown rice green tea</item>\n  </menu_category>\n  <contact>\n    <address>88 Ramen Row, Sydney NSW 2000</address>\n    <phone>+61 2 9333 8888</phone>\n    <email>hello@misoandsoul.com.au</email>\n    <hours>Mon-Sun 11am-11pm</hours>\n  </contact>\n</content_brief>\n\nYou will build the site ONE SECTION AT A TIME. Start with the first section now.\n\nFIRST SECTION REQUIRED: Write the Header section: a sticky navigation bar with the business name/logo on the left and navigation links (Home, Menu, About, Contact) on the right. Files: src/components/Header.tsx + src/components/Header.css"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "<thought>\nBuilding the Miso & Soul header. Ramen bars benefit from a dark, moody, restaurant-noir feel, so I'm using near-black background with a subtle red accent border that appears on scroll. The logo uses the Noto Serif JP heading font for an authentic Japanese typographic touch, while nav links stay in Inter for legibility.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 16);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`ms-header${scrolled ? ' ms-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"ms-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"ms-header__logo\">Miso &amp; Soul</a>\n        <nav className=\"ms-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"ms-header__link\">Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#menu\" className=\"ms-header__link\">Menu</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"ms-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n      </div>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.ms-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(13, 13, 13, 0.9);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.15);\n  transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;\n}\n.ms-header--scrolled {\n  background: rgba(13, 13, 13, 0.98);\n  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);\n}\n.ms-header__inner {\n  max-width: 1180px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 70px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n}\n.ms-header__logo {\n  font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif;\n  font-size: 1.3rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  color: #f5f5f4;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  letter-spacing: 0.02em;\n}\n.ms-header__nav {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 2rem;\n}\n.ms-header__link {\n  color: #a8a29e;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  font-size: 0.88rem;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  letter-spacing: 0.04em;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  transition: color 0.2s;\n  position: relative;\n}\n.ms-header__link:hover { color: #dc2626; }\n@media (max-width: 700px) {\n  .ms-header__nav { gap: 1.1rem; }\n  .ms-header__logo { font-size: 1.1rem; }\n}\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Hero section: a full-width banner with a background image or gradient, the business tagline as an h1, a subheading, and a prominent CTA button. Files: src/components/Hero.tsx + src/components/Hero.css\nWrite ONE <tool_call name=\"write_site\"> with exactly one .tsx file and one .css file for this section.\n</observation>"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "<thought>\nThe hero needs to feel warm and appetizing despite the dark palette, so I'm using a moody ramen photograph with a red-tinted gradient overlay rather than flat color. The tagline from the brief becomes the h1 in the Noto Serif JP font, and a single strong red CTA drives straight to the menu.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Hero.tsx\">\nimport React from 'react';\nimport './Hero.css';\n\nexport function Hero() {\n  return (\n    <section className=\"ms-hero\" id=\"hero\">\n      <div className=\"ms-hero__overlay\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n      <div className=\"ms-hero__content\">\n        <p className=\"ms-hero__eyebrow\">Sydney &middot; Est. Ramen Bar</p>\n        <h1 className=\"ms-hero__title\">Broth-first ramen,<br />made from scratch daily</h1>\n        <p className=\"ms-hero__subtitle\">\n          Every bowl starts with a broth simmered for up to 18 hours. No shortcuts,\n          no powders &mdash; just bones, time, and patience.\n        </p>\n        <a href=\"#menu\" className=\"ms-hero__cta\">View the Menu</a>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Hero.css\">\n.ms-hero {\n  position: relative;\n  min-height: 92vh;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: center;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  background:\n    linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(13,13,13,0.92) 0%, rgba(13,13,13,0.7) 55%, rgba(220,38,38,0.18) 100%),\n    url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1569718212165-3a8278d5f624?w=1600&q=80') center/cover no-repeat;\n}\n.ms-hero__overlay {\n  position: absolute;\n  inset: 0;\n  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 60%, rgba(220,38,38,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%);\n  pointer-events: none;\n}\n.ms-hero__content {\n  position: relative;\n  z-index: 1;\n  max-width: 720px;\n  padding: 2rem;\n  text-align: center;\n}\n.ms-hero__eyebrow {\n  font-size: 0.78rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  letter-spacing: 0.22em;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  color: #dc2626;\n  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n}\n.ms-hero__title {\n  font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif;\n  font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5.5vw, 4rem);\n  font-weight: 700;\n  color: #fafaf9;\n  line-height: 1.15;\n  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;\n}\n.ms-hero__subtitle {\n  font-size: 1.05rem;\n  color: #a8a29e;\n  line-height: 1.7;\n  margin: 0 auto 2.25rem;\n  max-width: 520px;\n}\n.ms-hero__cta {\n  display: inline-block;\n  padding: 0.85rem 2.1rem;\n  background: #dc2626;\n  color: #fafaf9;\n  border-radius: 6px;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  font-size: 0.95rem;\n  letter-spacing: 0.03em;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;\n}\n.ms-hero__cta:hover { background: #ef4444; transform: translateY(-2px); }\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Hero.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Hero.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Menu section: display the menu categories and items from the content brief. Files: src/components/Menu.tsx + src/components/Menu.css\nWrite ONE <tool_call name=\"write_site\"> with exactly one .tsx file and one .css file for this section.\n</observation>"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "<thought>\nWith three menu categories in the brief (Ramen, Sides, Drinks), a tabbed interface keeps things scannable instead of one long scroll. Prices stay in the red accent color for quick visual scanning, and cards get a subtle red glow on hover to tie back to the header/hero palette.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Menu.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport './Menu.css';\n\ninterface MenuItem { name: string; price: string; description: string; }\ninterface MenuCategory { name: string; items: MenuItem[]; }\n\nconst MENU_DATA: MenuCategory[] = [\n  {\n    name: 'Ramen',\n    items: [\n      { name: 'Tonkotsu Classic', price: '$16', description: '18-hour pork bone broth, chashu, ajitama, nori' },\n      { name: 'Spicy Miso', price: '$17', description: 'Fermented miso broth, ground pork, chili oil, corn' },\n      { name: 'Shoyu Chicken', price: '$15', description: 'Clear soy broth, roast chicken, menma, scallion' },\n      { name: 'Vegan Shiitake', price: '$14', description: 'Shiitake-kombu broth, tofu, mushrooms, seasonal greens' },\n    ],\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'Sides',\n    items: [\n      { name: 'Karaage', price: '$9', description: 'Japanese fried chicken thigh, yuzu kosho mayo' },\n      { name: 'Gyoza (5pc)', price: '$8', description: 'Pan-seared pork dumplings, chili vinegar' },\n      { name: 'Steamed Bao (2pc)', price: '$7', description: 'Pork belly, hoisin, pickled cucumber' },\n    ],\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'Drinks',\n    items: [\n      { name: 'Ramune', price: '$4', description: 'Classic Japanese marble soda' },\n      { name: 'Asahi Draft', price: '$8', description: 'Japanese lager, 425ml' },\n      { name: 'Iced Genmaicha', price: '$5', description: 'Roasted brown rice green tea' },\n    ],\n  },\n];\n\nexport function Menu() {\n  const [active, setActive] = useState('Ramen');\n  const current = MENU_DATA.find(c => c.name === active) ?? MENU_DATA[0];\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"ms-menu\" id=\"menu\" aria-labelledby=\"ms-menu-heading\">\n      <div className=\"ms-menu__inner\">\n        <div className=\"ms-menu__header\">\n          <p className=\"ms-menu__eyebrow\">The Menu</p>\n          <h2 id=\"ms-menu-heading\" className=\"ms-menu__title\">Bowls Worth the Wait</h2>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"ms-menu__tabs\" role=\"tablist\" aria-label=\"Menu categories\">\n          {MENU_DATA.map(cat => (\n            <button\n              key={cat.name}\n              role=\"tab\"\n              aria-selected={active === cat.name}\n              className={`ms-menu__tab${active === cat.name ? ' ms-menu__tab--active' : ''}`}\n              onClick={() => setActive(cat.name)}\n            >\n              {cat.name}\n            </button>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"ms-menu__grid\" role=\"tabpanel\" aria-label={current.name}>\n          {current.items.map(item => (\n            <article key={item.name} className=\"ms-menu__card\">\n              <div className=\"ms-menu__card-top\">\n                <h3 className=\"ms-menu__item-name\">{item.name}</h3>\n                <span className=\"ms-menu__item-price\">{item.price}</span>\n              </div>\n              <p className=\"ms-menu__item-desc\">{item.description}</p>\n            </article>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Menu.css\">\n.ms-menu {\n  padding: 6.5rem 2rem;\n  background: #141414;\n}\n.ms-menu__inner { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }\n.ms-menu__header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3rem; }\n.ms-menu__eyebrow {\n  font-size: 0.75rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  letter-spacing: 0.2em;\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  color: #dc2626;\n  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;\n}\n.ms-menu__title {\n  font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif;\n  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.8vw, 2.75rem);\n  color: #fafaf9;\n  margin: 0;\n}\n.ms-menu__tabs {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: center;\n  gap: 0.5rem;\n  margin-bottom: 3rem;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n}\n.ms-menu__tab {\n  padding: 0.55rem 1.4rem;\n  border: 2px solid #292524;\n  background: transparent;\n  color: #a8a29e;\n  border-radius: 2rem;\n  font-size: 0.88rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  transition: all 0.2s;\n}\n.ms-menu__tab:hover { border-color: #dc2626; color: #dc2626; }\n.ms-menu__tab--active { background: #dc2626; border-color: #dc2626; color: #fafaf9; }\n.ms-menu__grid {\n  display: grid;\n  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));\n  gap: 1.1rem;\n}\n.ms-menu__card {\n  background: #1c1917;\n  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  padding: 1.4rem;\n  transition: transform 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;\n}\n.ms-menu__card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.3); }\n.ms-menu__card-top {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  gap: 1rem;\n  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;\n}\n.ms-menu__item-name {\n  font-family: 'Noto Serif JP', serif;\n  font-size: 1.05rem;\n  color: #fafaf9;\n  margin: 0;\n}\n.ms-menu__item-price { font-weight: 700; color: #dc2626; white-space: nowrap; }\n.ms-menu__item-desc { font-size: 0.87rem; color: #78716c; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; }\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Menu.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Menu.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Footer section: a dark background footer with the business name, brief nav links, contact info (address, phone, email, hours), and a copyright notice. Files: src/components/Header.tsx + src/components/Header.css"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "<thought>\nFor a developer conference the header should feel technical and confident: near-black background, a bold two-tone logo (name in white, year in the blue accent), and a single high-contrast 'Get Tickets' CTA since ticket conversion is the header's main job.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 12);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`ds-header${scrolled ? ' ds-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"ds-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"ds-header__logo\">DevSummit<span className=\"ds-header__year\">2025</span></a>\n        <nav className=\"ds-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#speakers\" className=\"ds-header__link\">Speakers</a>\n          <a href=\"#schedule\" className=\"ds-header__link\">Schedule</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"ds-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n        <a href=\"mailto:tickets@devsummit.io\" className=\"ds-header__cta\">Get Tickets</a>\n      </div>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.ds-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(3, 7, 18, 0.85);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15);\n  transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;\n}\n.ds-header--scrolled {\n  background: rgba(3, 7, 18, 0.97);\n  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);\n}\n.ds-header__inner {\n  max-width: 1240px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 68px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  gap: 1.5rem;\n}\n.ds-header__logo {\n  font-weight: 800;\n  font-size: 1.1rem;\n  color: #f8fafc;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  letter-spacing: -0.02em;\n}\n.ds-header__year { color: #2563eb; margin-left: 0.25rem; }\n.ds-header__nav { display: flex; gap: 1.75rem; align-items: center; }\n.ds-header__link {\n  color: #94a3b8;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  font-size: 0.9rem;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  transition: color 0.2s;\n}\n.ds-header__link:hover { color: #f8fafc; }\n.ds-header__cta {\n  padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;\n  background: #2563eb;\n  color: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 6px;\n  font-size: 0.85rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;\n}\n.ds-header__cta:hover { background: #3b82f6; role: string; }\n\nconst SPEAKERS: Speaker[] = [\n  { name: 'Sarah Chen', role: 'Staff Engineer, Stripe' },\n  { name: 'Marcus Odom', role: 'VP Engineering, Vercel' },\n  { name: 'Ayesha Khan', role: 'Principal Researcher, DeepMind' },\n  { name: 'Diego Fuentes', role: 'Founder, OpenRuntime' },\n];\n\nfunction initials(name: string): string {\n  return name.split(' ').map(p => p[0]).join('');\n}\n\nexport function Speakers() {\n  return (\n    <section className=\"ds-speakers\" id=\"speakers\" aria-labelledby=\"ds-speakers-heading\">\n      <div className=\"ds-speakers__inner\">\n        <div className=\"ds-speakers__header\">\n          <p className=\"ds-speakers__eyebrow\">Line-up</p>\n          <h2 id=\"ds-speakers-heading\" className=\"ds-speakers__title\">Speakers</h2>\n        </div>\n        <ul className=\"ds-speakers__grid\">\n          {SPEAKERS.map(s => (\n            <li key={s.name} className=\"ds-speaker-card\">\n              <div className=\"ds-speaker-card__avatar\" aria-hidden=\"true\">{initials(s.name)}</div>\n              <h3 className=\"ds-speaker-card__name\">{s.name}</h3>\n              <p className=\"ds-speaker-card__role\">{s.role}</p>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Speakers.css\">\n.ds-speakers {\n  padding: 6.5rem 2rem;\n  background: #050914;\n  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);\n}\n.ds-speakers__inner { max-width: 1160px; ' bl-header--solid' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"bl-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"bl-header__logo\">BLANC STUDIO</a>\n        <nav className=\"bl-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"bl-header__link\">Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#products\" className=\"bl-header__link\">Collection</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"bl-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n      </div>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.bl-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(250, 250, 249, 0.6);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;\n  transition: background 0.3s, border-color 0.3s;\n}\n.bl-header--solid {\n  background: rgba(250, 250, 249, 0.96);\n  border-bottom-color: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.08);\n}\n.bl-header__inner {\n  max-width: 1200px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 84px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n}\n.bl-header__logo {\n  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;\n  font-size: 1.4rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  letter-spacing: 0.18em;\n  color: #1c1917;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n.bl-header__nav { display: flex; Nothing competes with the work shown further down the page.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  return (\n    <header className=\"mb-header\" role=\"banner\">\n      <div className=\"mb-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"mb-header__name\">Marcus Bell</a>\n        <nav className=\"mb-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#projects\" className=\"mb-header__link\">Projects</a>\n          <a href=\"#contact\" className=\"mb-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n      </div>\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.mb-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(12, 12, 12, 0.85);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.12);\n}\n.mb-header__inner {\n  max-width: 980px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 66px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n}\n.mb-header__name {\n  font-weight: 700;\n  font-size: 1.05rem;\n  color: #f5f5f4;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  letter-spacing: -0.01em;\n}\n.mb-header__nav { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; }\n.mb-header__link {\n  padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem;\n  color: #a3a3a3;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  font-size: 0.88rem;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  border-radius: 6px;\n  transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s;\n}\n.mb-header__link:hover { color: #f97316; background: rgba(249,115,22,0.08); }\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Header.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Hero section: name/title intro with an animated typing role text that cycles through 3 roles using pure CSS, a short bio, and CTA buttons. Files: src/components/Hero.tsx + src/components/Hero.css\nWrite ONE <tool_call name=\"write_site\"> with exactly one .tsx file and one .css file for this section.\n</observation>"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "<thought>\nThe animated role text is built with a pure-CSS vertical-cycle animation: three role labels stacked in a fixed-height, overflow-hidden container, translated up on a keyframe loop with steps(1) so each role holds fully before the next appears (no third-party libraries needed). I kept the visible aria-label static for accessibility so screen readers get the full role list.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Hero.tsx\">\nimport React from 'react';\nimport './Hero.css';\n\nexport function Hero() {\n  return (\n    <section className=\"mb-hero\" id=\"hero\" aria-labelledby=\"mb-hero-name\">\n      <div className=\"mb-hero__inner\">\n        <p className=\"mb-hero__greeting\">Hi, I&apos;m</p>\n        <h1 id=\"mb-hero-name\" className=\"mb-hero__name\">Marcus Bell</h1>\n        <p className=\"mb-hero__roles\" aria-label=\"UX Designer, Product Strategist, Design Systems Lead\">\n          <span className=\"mb-hero__role-cycle\">\n            <span>UX Designer</span>\n            <span>Product Strategist</span>\n            <span>Design Systems Lead</span>\n          </span>\n        </p>\n        <p className=\"mb-hero__bio\">\n          I turn ambiguous product problems into clear, usable interfaces &mdash;\n          from early strategy through pixel-level execution.\n        </p>\n        <div className=\"mb-hero__actions\">\n          <a href=\"#projects\" className=\"mb-hero__btn mb-hero__btn--primary\">View Projects</a>\n          <a href=\"#contact\" className=\"mb-hero__btn mb-hero__btn--secondary\">Get in Touch</a>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Hero.css\">\n.mb-hero {\n  padding: 8rem 2rem 5.5rem;\n  background: #0c0c0c;\n  text-align: center;\n}\n.mb-hero__inner { max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; }\n.mb-hero__greeting {\n  font-size: 0.95rem;\n  color: #f97316;\n  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n.mb-hero__name {\n  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 3.75rem);\n  font-weight: 800;\n  color: #f5f5f4;\n  margin: 0 0 1rem;\n  letter-spacing: -0.03em;\n}\n.mb-hero__roles {\n  height: 1.8rem;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  margin: 0 0 1.75rem;\n}\n.mb-hero__role-cycle {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  animation: mb-cycle 6s steps(1) infinite;\n}\n.mb-hero__role-cycle span {\n  font-size: 1.2rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  color: #d4d4d4;\n  height: 1.8rem;\n  line-height: 1.8rem;\n}\n@keyframes mb-cycle {\n  0%, 30% { transform: translateY(0); }\n  33%, 63% { transform: translateY(-1.8rem); }\n  66%, 96% { transform: translateY(-3.6rem); }\n  100% { transform: translateY(0); }\n}\n.mb-hero__bio {\n  font-size: 1.02rem;\n  color: #737373;\n  line-height: 1.75;\n  margin: 0 auto 2.25rem;\n  max-width: 480px;\n}\n.mb-hero__actions { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }\n.mb-hero__btn {\n  padding: 0.75rem 1.6rem;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  font-size: 0.9rem;\n  text-decoration: none;\n  transition: all 0.2s;\n}\n.mb-hero__btn--primary { background: #f97316; color: #d4d4d4; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); }\n.mb-hero__btn--secondary:hover { border-color: #f97316; color: #f97316; }\n</file>\n</tool_call>"}, {"role": "user", "content": "<observation status=\"ok\">\n[Files accepted]:\n  \u2713 src/components/Hero.tsx\n  \u2713 src/components/Hero.css\n\n[NEXT SECTION REQUIRED]: Write the Projects section: all 4 case studies from the brief as large cards with project name, role, and outcome. It needs to reflect the podcast brand identity: deep background (#0b0e17) with crisp contrast, the elegant Space Grotesk typography for the wordmark, and the signature #a855f7 accent for the CTA button. I'll also implement a scroll listener to trigger glassmorphism and subtle border illumination on scroll.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 15);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`fs-header${scrolled ? ' fs-header--scrolled' : ''}`} role=\"banner\">\n      <div className=\"fs-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#\" className=\"fs-header__logo\" aria-label=\"The Future Syntax Home\">\n          The Future Syntax\n        </a>\n\n        <nav className=\"fs-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main Navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"fs-header__link\">Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#episodes\" className=\"fs-header__link\">Latest Episodes</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"fs-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n\n        <div className=\"fs-header__actions\">\n          <a href=\"mailto:producers@futuresyntaxpodcast.com\" className=\"fs-header__cta\">\n            Listen on Spotify\n          </a>\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            className=\"fs-header__toggle\"\n            aria-label=\"Toggle navigation menu\"\n            aria-expanded={menuOpen}\n            onClick={() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}\n          >\n            <span className=\"fs-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"fs-header__bar\" />\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"is-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#services\" onClick={() => {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"ad-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#treatments\" onClick={() => 'ar-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"ar-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"ar-header__logo\" aria-label=\"Apex Heart Rhythm Institute Home\">\n          Apex {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"ar-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#procedures\" onClick={() => 'mb-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"mb-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"mb-header__logo\" aria-label=\"Maison Botanique Home\">\n          Maison Botanique\n className=\"mb-header__toggle\"\n            aria-label=\"Toggle navigation menu\"\n            aria-expanded={menuOpen}\n            onClick={() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}\n          >\n            <span className=\"mb-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"mb-header__bar\" />\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"mb-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#extraits\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Signature Extraits</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n\n</file>\n<file {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"vh-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#vault\" onClick={() => {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"kc-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#blades\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Master Blades</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n\n</file>\n<file For the Header, I'll implement a modern sticky navbar with the brand wordmark 'Atelier Lumos ArchViz', anchor links to the main sections (#hero, #portfolio, #footer), and a prominent CTA button 'Commission Renderings'. I'll use #121417 for the dark header background, with an accent color #38bdf8 for hover highlights.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handleScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 20);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`al-header ${scrolled ? 'al-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"al-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"al-header__logo\" aria-label=\"Atelier Lumos ArchViz Home\">\n          Atelier Lumos className=\"al-header__link\">Portfolio Studies</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"al-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n\n        <div className=\"al-header__actions\">\n className=\"al-header__toggle\"\n            aria-label=\"Toggle navigation menu\"\n            aria-expanded={menuOpen}\n            onClick={() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}\n          >\n            <span className=\"al-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"al-header__bar\" />\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"al-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#portfolio\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Portfolio Studies</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n\n</file>\n<file I'll use #0f0f12 for the dark header background, with an accent color #fafafa for hover highlights.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handleScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 20);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`mc-header ${scrolled ? 'mc-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"mc-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"mc-header__logo\" aria-label=\"Monolith Brand Collective Home\">\n          Monolith Brand Collective\n        </a>\n\n        <nav className=\"mc-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main Navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"mc-header__link\">Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#cases\" className=\"mc-header__link\">Selected Case Studies</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"mc-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n\n        <div className=\"mc-header__actions\">\n          <a href=\"mailto:hello@monolithcollective.design\" className=\"mc-header__cta\">\n            Inquire for Q3\n          </a>\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            className=\"mc-header__toggle\"\n            aria-label=\"Toggle navigation menu\"\n            aria-expanded={menuOpen}\n            onClick={() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}\n          >\n            <span className=\"mc-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"mc-header__bar\" />\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"mc-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#cases\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Selected Case Studies</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n\n</file>\n<file border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);\n  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);\n}\n\n.mc-header--scrolled {\n  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);\n box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.35);\n}\n\n.mc-header__toggle {\n  display: none;\n  background: transparent;\n  border: none;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  padding: 6px;\n  flex-direction: For the Header, I'll implement a modern sticky navbar with the brand wordmark 'Lumen & Shade Lighting', anchor links to the main sections (#hero, #projects, #footer), and a prominent CTA button 'Consult Lighting Team'. I'll use #121110 for the dark header background, with an accent color #f59e0b for hover highlights.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handleScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 20);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`ls-header ${scrolled ? 'ls-header--scrolled' : ''}`}>\n      <div className=\"ls-header__inner\">\n        <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"ls-header__logo\" aria-label=\"Lumen & Shade Lighting Home\">\n          Lumen & Shade Lighting\n        </a>\n\n        <nav className=\"ls-header__nav\" aria-label=\"Main Navigation\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" className=\"ls-header__link\">Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#projects\" className=\"ls-header__link\">Signature Projects</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" className=\"ls-header__link\">Contact</a>\n        </nav>\n\n        <div className=\"ls-header__actions\">\n          <a href=\"mailto:lighting@lumenshade.com\" className=\"ls-header__cta\">\n            Consult Lighting Team\n          </a>\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            className=\"ls-header__toggle\"\n            aria-label=\"Toggle navigation menu\"\n            aria-expanded={menuOpen}\n            onClick={() => setMenuOpen(!menuOpen)}\n          >\n            <span className=\"ls-header__bar\" />\n            <span className=\"ls-header__bar\" />\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"ls-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#projects\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Signature Projects</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.css\">\n.ls-header {\n  position: sticky;\n  top: 0;\n  z-index: 100;\n  width: 100%;\n  background: rgba(18, 17, 16, 0.92);\n  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);\n  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);\n  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);\n}\n\n.ls-header--scrolled {\n  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);\n  border-bottom-color: #f59e0b;\n}\n\n.ls-header__inner {\n  max-width: 1240px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 2rem;\n  height: 74px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  gap: 1.5rem;\n}\n\n.ls-header__logo {\n  font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;\n  font-size: 1.35rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n  color: #fafafa;\n  text-decoration: none;\n text-decoration: none;\n  font-size: 1rem;\n  padding: 0.5rem 0;\n}\n\n@media (max-width: 768px) {\n  .ls-header__nav { display: none; }\n  .ls-header__toggle { display: flex; </section>\n  );\n}\n\n</file>\n<file path=\"src/components/SignatureProjects.css\">\n.ls-catalog {\n  padding: 6.5rem 2rem;\n  background: #121110;\n  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"sc-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#experiences\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Lodge Experiences</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n\n</file>\n<file {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"cp-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#programs\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Sanctuary Programs</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n\n</file>\n<file {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"sa-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#highlights\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Resort Highlights</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n\n</file>\n<file I'll use #0e1014 for the dark header background, with an accent color #f59e0b for hover highlights.\n</thought>\n<tool_call name=\"write_site\">\n<file path=\"src/components/Header.tsx\">\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport './Header.css';\n\nexport function Header() {\n  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handleScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 20);\n    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);\n    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);\n  }, []);\n\n  return (\n    <header className={`dz-header ${scrolled ? {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"dz-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#services\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Engineering Services</a>\n          <a href=\"#footer\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Contact</a>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </header>\n  );\n}\n\n</file>\n<file {menuOpen && (\n        <div className=\"mr-header__mobile-menu\">\n          <a href=\"#hero\" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}>Home</a>\n          <a href=\"#microlots\" onClick={() =>
